Aucune crise ni évolution majeure n'est visible, si bien que le score reste proche du niveau de référence habituel.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum entspricht einem gewöhnlichen Nachrichtentag in Island: politische und gesellschaftliche Streitigkeiten (eine Entschuldigung für eine Äußerung zu Bangkok, ein Konflikt im Gemeinderat von Kópavogur, Sorgen wegen Schimmel in Wohnungen), dazu Kultur, Designpreise und Tourismuswerbung. Es sind keine Krise und keine größere Veränderung erkennbar, daher liegt der Wert nahe der üblichen Grundlinie.
summary.pt: O período corresponde a um dia noticioso de rotina na Islândia: disputas políticas e sociais (um pedido de desculpas por uma declaração sobre Bangkok, um conflito no conselho municipal de Kópavogur, preocupações com bolor em habitações), além de cultura, prémios de design e promoção turística. Não se observa qualquer crise ou mudança relevante, pelo que a pontuação se situa perto do nível de referência habitual.
summary.it: Il periodo è una giornata di notizie ordinaria in Islanda: scontri politici e sociali (le scuse per un commento su Bangkok, una disputa nel consiglio comunale di Kópavogur, preoccupazioni per la muffa negli alloggi), oltre a cultura, premi di design e promozione turistica. Non si notano crisi o cambiamenti importanti, quindi il punteggio si colloca vicino alla linea di base ordinaria.
summary.ru: Период представляет собой обычный новостной день в Исландии: политические и социальные споры (извинения за высказывание о Бангкоке, спор в городском совете Коупавогюра, опасения по поводу плесени в жилье), а также культура, дизайнерские премии и продвижение туризма. Никакого кризиса или значительного сдвига не наблюдается, поэтому оценка находится около обычного базового уровня.
summary.ar: تمثل الفترة يوماً إخبارياً اعتيادياً في آيسلندا: خلافات سياسية واجتماعية (اعتذار عن تصريح يخص بانكوك، وخلاف في مجلس بلدية كوبافوغور، ومخاوف بشأن العفن في المساكن)، إضافة إلى أخبار الثقافة وجوائز التصميم والترويج السياحي. لا توجد أزمة أو تحول كبير واضح، لذلك تقع الدرجة قريبة من خط الأساس المعتاد.
summary.fa: این دوره یک روز خبری عادی در ایسلند است: اختلافات سیاسی و اجتماعی (عذرخواهی برای اظهارنظری درباره بانکوک، اختلاف در شورای شهر کوپاووگور، و نگرانی‌ها درباره کپک در مسکن)، همراه با اخبار فرهنگ، جوایز طراحی و تبلیغات گردشگری. هیچ بحران یا تغییر بزرگی دیده نمی‌شود، بنابراین امتیاز نزدیک به خط مبنای معمول است.
summary.zh: 该时段是冰岛一个普通的新闻日：政治和社会争端（就一条关于曼谷的言论道歉、科帕沃古尔市议会的一项争议、住房霉菌问题的担忧），以及文化、设计奖项和旅游推广新闻。未见危机或重大转变，因此评分接近普通基线。
summary.ja: この期間はアイスランドの日常的なニュースの日です。政治と社会の論争（バンコクでの発言に対する謝罪、Kópavogbit市議会の紛争、住宅のカビへの懸念）に加え、文化、デザイン賞、観光プロモーションが報じられました。危機や大きな変化は見られないため、スコアは通常の基準値付近にあります。
summary.ko: 이 기간은 아이슬란드의 평범한 뉴스 기간입니다. 정치·사회 논란(방콕 발언에 대한 사과, Kópavogbit 시의회 분쟁, 주택 곰팡이 우려)과 함께 문화, 디자인 어워드, 관광 홍보 소식이 있었습니다. 위기나 큰 변화는 보이지 않아 점수는 일반적인 기준선 근처에 머물러 있습니다.
summary.hi: यह अवधि आइसलैंड में एक सामान्य समाचार दिन है: राजनीतिक और सामाजिक विवाद (बैंकॉक की एक टिप्पणी पर माफ़ी, Kópavogbit नगर परिषद का विवाद, आवास में फफूंद की चिंताएँ), साथ ही संस्कृति, डिज़ाइन पुरस्कार और पर्यटन प्रचार। कोई संकट या बड़ा बदलाव दिखाई नहीं देता, इसलिए स्कोर सामान्य आधार रेखा के आसपास है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος είναι μια συνηθισμένη ειδησεογραφική μέρα στην Ισλανδία: πολιτικές και κοινωνικές διαμάχες (συγγνώμη για δήλωση σχετική με τη Μπανγκόκ, διαμάχη στο δημοτικό συμβούλιο Kópavogbit, ανησυχίες για μούχλα σε κατοικίες), καθώς και πολιτισμός, βραβεία σχεδιασμού και προώθηση τουρισμού. Δεν διακρίνεται κρίση ή σημαντική αλλαγή, επομένως το σκορ βρίσκεται κοντά στη συνήθη βάση αναφοράς.

en: Routine domestic political disputes and public apologies, with no institutional crisis
Culture and tourism news (Airwaves, Design Awards, tourism promotion) gives mild positive tone
Foreign coverage is mostly unrelated to Iceland, so it adds little signal
tr: Rutin iç siyasi tartışmalar ve kamuoyuna yapılan özürler; kurumsal bir kriz yok
Kültür ve turizm haberleri (Airwaves, Tasarım Ödülleri, turizm tanıtımı) hafif olumlu bir ton sağlıyor
Yurt dışı haberlerinin çoğu İzlanda ile ilgili değil, bu nedenle çok az sinyal içeriyor
es: Disputas políticas internas rutinarias y disculpas públicas, sin crisis institucional
Las noticias de cultura y turismo (Airwaves, Premios de Diseño, promoción turística) aportan un tono levemente positivo
La cobertura extranjera en su mayoría no guarda relación con Islandia, por lo que aporta poca señal
fr: Querelles politiques intérieures courantes et excuses publiques, sans crise institutionnelle
L'actualité culturelle et touristique (Airwaves, Prix du design, promotion touristique) donne un ton légèrement positif
La couverture étrangère est en grande partie sans rapport avec l'Islande et apporte donc peu de signal
de: Routinemäßige innenpolitische Streitigkeiten und öffentliche Entschuldigungen, ohne institutionelle Krise
Kultur- und Tourismusnachrichten (Airwaves, Design Awards, Tourismuswerbung) sorgen für einen leicht positiven Ton
Die Auslandsberichterstattung betrifft größtenteils nicht Island und liefert daher wenig Signal
pt: Disputas políticas internas de rotina e pedidos públicos de desculpa, sem crise institucional

it: Dispute politiche interne di routine e scuse pubbliche, senza una crisi istituzionale

La copertura estera è per lo più non correlata all'Islanda, quindi aggiunge poco segnale
ru: Рутинные внутриполитические споры и публичные извинения без институционального кризиса

أخبار الثقافة والسياحة (Airwaves وجوائز التصميم والترويج السياحي) تضفي نبرة إيجابية خفيفة

summary.en: A landslide and collapse at an illegal gold mine killed 14 people and injured 7. Separately, a Black Hawk helicopter crashed in Cauca, the investigation into the assassination of Miguel Uribe is in the news, debate over militarizing Bogotá is ongoing, and the stock market fell 2.15% in a day. In contrast, Bogotá, Cali and Medellín ranked among the top 10 in Latin America for economic performance, received tourism awards, and economy and infrastructure news was calm, so the score did not drop much.

en: Collapse at an illegal gold mine with 14 deaths
Military helicopter crash in Cauca
Daily stock market decline of 2.15%
Investigation into the assassination of Miguel Uribe and debate over militarization in Bogotá
Positive news on the economic performance and tourism awards of major cities

summary.en: The period mixes security tension (an alleged ELN attempt on the president, a planned offensive against armed groups, prison transfers) with a deadly illegal mine landslide that killed 14 and protests over museum removals. Positives include a signed US-Colombia critical minerals and nuclear cooperation arrangement, while the stock index was roughly flat and the news tone was more negative than the global average.

en: Alleged ELN assassination attempt against President De la Espriella
Illegal gold mine landslide kills 14 people
US-Colombia critical minerals and civil nuclear arrangements signed

summary.en: The period is dominated by a cabinet shake-up after the Presidency's budget setback, plus protests over the removal of museum artworks and warnings about gas prices and a blackout bill. Offsetting this are a record cocaine seizure, a routine IMF mission and port throughput above target, so the day sits slightly below an ordinary period.

en: Interior minister Rodrigo Lara removed after budget setback
Protests over removal of art exhibits deemed communist
Record 7.6-tonne cocaine seizure at Cartagena port

summary.en: The day mixed a positive corporate rescue (700 jobs saved at Presto) and IDB financing with a cabinet resignation, a deadly military strike on an ELN camp, a journalist's murder by dissidents, and a 0.74% stock decline. Overall this is a somewhat tense but otherwise routine day, slightly below an ordinary one.

en: Interior Minister Rodrigo Lara resigned after two months in office
Air strike killed nine ELN members in Cauca
Journalist Mateo Pérez Rueda's murder by dissidents, forensic details released

summary.en: The period is mixed: the central bank raised rates to 12.25% and the government postponed over 10 trillion pesos in debt payments, while security and institutional items (an extradition, an anti-ELN seizure, stable homicide levels) were routine or mildly positive. The COLCAP index is down 2.9% over the month, and the news tone is slightly less negative than the world average.

en: Central bank raises policy rate to 12.25%, signalling inflation pressure
Government postpones over 10 trillion pesos in debt payments
Extradition and anti-ELN seizure show routine security enforcement

summary.en: The period looks mostly routine: post-election politics, a fiscal adjustment outlook, and regional flooding, alongside a police officer's killing in Cali and an arrest of FARC dissidents. The stock index is flat to slightly down over the month and the news tone is slightly more negative than the world average, so the score sits just below neutral.

en: Killing of a police officer in Cali and government response
Capture of four FARC dissident members
Flooding and traffic chaos in the Caribbean region

summary.en: The period mixes security gains, with several outlets reporting the killing of ELN commanders and fighters, against fiscal and climate strain: a delayed $3.3 billion debt payment, $855 million pledged to avert blackouts, El Niño saving campaigns, and Caribbean flood alerts. Cabinet churn and a fiscal-rescue law announcement add political uncertainty, and the stock index is down over the month.

en: Delayed US$3.3B debt payment and US$855M blackout-prevention pledge
Caribbean floods and Santa Marta red alert
Military operation killing ELN commanders and about ten fighters

summary.en: The period is dominated by the assassination of a mayoral pre-candidate in Cúcuta, a deadly attack killing at least six in southwestern Colombia, and a hospital killing in Cauca, all signalling widespread violence. The stock index fell about 2% and news tone is more negative than the world average, partly offset by the return of a global bond sale and the government's pledge to pursue the killers.

en: Assassination of mayoral pre-candidate Miguel Castellanos in Cúcuta
At least six killed in attack in southwestern Colombia
Armed killing of patient at Suárez, Cauca hospital

summary.en: The period is dominated by armed-group violence: a bombing near the Venezuelan border injured at least four police, a drone attack by FARC dissidents killed a marine, and six people died in an attack in the southwest. Political and institutional tensions also rose, with a court-ordered asset freeze on the Pacto Histórico and disputes over the presidency rules. Markets were mixed, with a small daily gain but weaker weekly and monthly performance.

en: Deadly FARC dissident drone attack kills a marine
At least six killed in southwestern Colombia attack
Bomb blast near Venezuelan border injures police

summary.en: The period is mostly routine news: court-ordered restitution of museum works, RTVC media governance changes, and health investment announcements. Offsetting this are a sixth military bombing campaign against armed groups with reported child deaths, a 0.5% peso slip, and a weak month for the COLCAP index.

en: Sixth bombing against armed groups; six dead, eight minors reported
Military control operations in Sumapaz and Usme ordered
Weak COLCAP month (-3.34%) and peso slip

summary.en: The period is dominated by security escalation: troops ordered into Cúcuta after a violence wave, drone strikes displacing about 1,447 people in El Tarra, and foreign reports of US troop deployment. Fiscal and economic stress adds to the strain, with a contested US$13B 'Rescue Law' facing Congress and the COLCAP index slipping. Routine news (sports, lifestyle, local incidents) fills much of the flow.

en: Militarization of Cúcuta ordered after a violence wave
Drone strikes displace 1,447 people in El Tarra
Rescue Law with new taxes faces congressional opposition

summary.en: The period mixes positive economic and infrastructure news, including falling unemployment, rising factory confidence, new jobs and the UN mission's renewal, with negatives such as a 1.83% peso drop, violence in Ataco and cuts threatening a human rights court. On balance it reads as a routine day, slightly positive.

en: Unemployment falls to 8%, factory confidence climbs
Peso falls 1.83% and stock index declines
Violence and disputes by armed dissidents in Ataco, Tolima

summary.en: The period is mostly routine governance news: a contested fiscal adjustment and rescue law, and the closing of the pension reform debate. Offsetting this, a reported Venezuelan strike on an ELN guerrilla camp left several dead, and the COLCAP index fell over the week and month, so the score sits slightly below a typical day.

en: Contested fiscal adjustment and rescue law with IVA changes pending
Pension reform definitively settled, giving institutional clarity
Reported Venezuelan strike on ELN leaves several dead

summary.en: The period is dominated by armed attacks, including a drone and explosives bombing in Planadas, Tolima that killed four people, among them a two-month-old baby, plus a police officer killed in Huila. Economic signals are also weak: the COLCAP fell over the month, Cúcuta lost 11,000 jobs, a union called a national strike, and the government warned of default if a bill fails.

en: Planadas, Tolima drone-bomb attack kills four, including an infant
Police officer killed in Huila attack; Algeciras bombing kills officer
Union national strike call and default warning over a pending bill

summary.en: The period was dominated by a cluster of bombings and drone attacks that killed soldiers and civilians, including a baby, across several regions, alongside a UN decision narrowing the verification mission and a weaker stock market. Some positive signals, such as an arrest of a suspect abroad and ongoing legislative work, do not offset the widespread violence.

en: Truck bomb and attacks killed four civilians, including a baby
Drone attack killed two soldiers in Chocó
UN narrowed verification mission and dropped rural reform oversight

summary.en: The period mixes a legislative win, the approval of the submission law for armed groups, with serious security incidents, including drone and car-bomb attacks and a military base attack that killed four. Fiscal strain (a possible IMF loan, a proposed gasoline tax, a fuel shortage) and a weaker peso add to the pressure, so the score sits in the serious-problems range but not at crisis level.

en: Submission law approved by Congress and sent for presidential sanction
Drone and military base attacks leave several dead
Possible IMF loan and proposed 19% gasoline sales tax

summary.en: Mixed day: export growth, a Japan trade deal, an oil-restart plan and a Senate-approved vape tax sit alongside a called national strike against government reforms, military operations, an ELN kidnapping and criticism of the health-system plan. GDELT tone is quite negative, but no major crackdown or disaster appears in the headlines, so the score stays close to an ordinary day.

en: Nationwide strike called by unions against De la Espriella's reforms
Security operations, bombings and militarized cities criticized in first 90 days
Export growth of 16.4% and Japan trade deal planned

summary.en: Colombia's period is mixed but leans negative: security is tense, with reported bombings, militarized cities, a rebel seizure of an officer and a national strike called for November 19. Economic signals are soft (stock index down 0.88% on the day and 4.82% over the month), though the peso gained and some business and cultural news was positive.
summary.ja: コロンビアの情勢は好悪が入り混じっているものの、全体としては否定的な傾向にある。治安は緊張しており、爆撃の報告、都市の軍事化、反政府勢力による将校の拘束、11月19日に呼びかけられた全国ストライキなどが伝えられている。経済指標は軟調で、株価指数は当日0.88%、1か月で4.82%下落した。一方でペソは上昇し、企業や文化に関する一部のニュースは前向きだった。
summary.ko: 콜롬비아의 상황은 엇갈리지만 전반적으로 부정적인 쪽으로 기울어 있다. 보안 상황은 긴장된 상태로, 폭탄 공격 보도, 도시의 군사화, 반군의 장교 납치, 11월 19일로 예고된 전국 파업 등이 이어지고 있다. 경제 지표는 약세를 보여 주가지수는 당일 0.88%, 한 달 동안 4.82% 하락했다. 다만 페소화는 상승했고, 일부 기업 및 문화 관련 소식은 긍정적이었다.
summary.hi: कोलंबिया की स्थिति मिश्रित है, लेकिन इसका झुकाव नकारात्मक दिशा में है। सुरक्षा हालात तनावपूर्ण हैं, जिनमें बम विस्फोटों की रिपोर्ट, शहरों का सैन्यीकरण, विद्रोहियों द्वारा एक अधिकारी का अपहरण और 19 नवंबर के लिए बुलाई गई राष्ट्रव्यापी हड़ताल शामिल हैं। आर्थिक संकेत कमज़ोर हैं: शेयर सूचकांक दिन में 0.88% और महीने भर में 4.82% गिरा। हालांकि पेसो में बढ़त दर्ज हुई और कुछ व्यावसायिक व सांस्कृतिक समाचार सकारात्मक रहे।
summary.el: Η περίοδος στην Κολομβία είναι μικτή, με κλίση προς τα αρνητικά. Η ασφάλεια παραμένει τεταμένη, με αναφορές για βομβιστικές επιθέσεις, militarized πόλεις, την αρπαγή ενός αξιωματικού από αντάρτες και γενική απεργία που έχει προκηρυχθεί για τις 19 Νοεμβρίου. Οι οικονομικοί δείκτες είναι αδύναμοι: ο δείκτης του χρηματιστηρίου υποχώρησε κατά 0,88% μέσα στην ημέρα και κατά 4,82% μέσα στον μήνα, ενώ το πέσο κέρδισε έδαφος και ορισμένα επιχειρηματικά και πολιτιστικά νέα ήταν θετικά.
summary.tr: Kolombiya'nın dönemi karışık ancak olumsuza yakın: güvenlik durumu gergin; bildirilen bombalı saldırılar, askeri kontrol altındaki kentler, isyancıların bir subayı kaçırması ve 19 Kasım için çağrılan ulusal grev öne çıkıyor. Ekonomik göstergeler zayıf (borsa endeksi gün içinde %0,88, ay boyunca %4,82 düştü), ancak peso değer kazandı ve bazı iş dünyası ile kültür haberleri olumluydu.
summary.es: El periodo de Colombia es mixto, aunque con tendencia negativa: la seguridad está tensa, con bombardeos reportados, ciudades militarizadas, la captura de un oficial por parte de rebeldes y una huelga nacional convocada para el 19 de noviembre. Las señales económicas son débiles (el índice bursátil bajó un 0,88 % en el día y un 4,82 % en el mes), aunque el peso se apreció y algunas noticias empresariales y culturales fueron positivas.
summary.fr: La période en Colombie est contrastée mais penche vers le négatif : la sécurité est tendue, avec des attentats signalés, des villes militarisées, la prise d'un officier par des rebelles et une grève nationale annoncée pour le 19 novembre. Les indicateurs économiques sont faibles (l'indice boursier a baissé de 0,88 % sur la journée et de 4,82 % sur le mois), même si le peso s'est apprécié et que certaines nouvelles économiques et culturelles étaient positives.
summary.de: Die Lage in Kolumbien ist gemischt, tendiert aber ins Negative: Die Sicherheitslage ist angespannt, mit gemeldeten Bombenanschlägen, militarisierten Städten, der Entführung eines Offiziers durch Rebellen und einem für den 19. November ausgerufenen landesweiten Streik. Die Wirtschaftsindikatoren sind schwach (Aktienindex am Tag um 0,88 % und im Monat um 4,82 % gefallen), doch der Peso legte zu und einige Nachrichten aus Wirtschaft und Kultur fielen positiv aus.
summary.pt: O período na Colômbia é misto, mas inclina-se para o negativo: a segurança está tensa, com bombardeios relatados, cidades militarizadas, a captura de um oficial por rebeldes e uma greve nacional convocada para 19 de novembro. Os indicadores econômicos são fracos (o índice da bolsa caiu 0,88% no dia e 4,82% no mês), embora o peso tenha se valorizado e algumas notícias empresariais e culturais tenham sido positivas.
summary.it: Il periodo della Colombia è contrastante ma tende al negativo: la sicurezza è tesa, con attentati segnalati, città militarizzate, il sequestro di un ufficiale da parte di ribelli e uno sciopero nazionale indetto per il 19 novembre. I segnali economici sono deboli (indice di borsa in calo dello 0,88% nella giornata e del 4,82% nel mese), anche se il peso si è rafforzato e alcune notizie su imprese e cultura sono state positive.
summary.ru: Период в Колумбии неоднозначен, но склоняется к негативу: обстановка в сфере безопасности напряжённая, сообщается о взрывах, городах с военным присутствием, захвате повстанцами офицера и общенациональной забастовке, назначенной на 19 ноября. Экономические показатели слабые (фондовый индекс снизился на 0,88% за день и на 4,82% за месяц), хотя песо укрепился, а некоторые новости из бизнеса и культуры были позитивными.
summary.ar: الفترة في كولومبيا مختلطة لكنها تميل إلى السلبية: الوضع الأمني متوتر، مع تقارير عن تفجيرات ومدن تحت الطابع العسكري، واختطاف متمردين لضابط، والدعوة إلى إضراب وطني في 19 نوفمبر. المؤشرات الاقتصادية ضعيفة (انخفض مؤشر الأسهم بنسبة 0.88% خلال اليوم و4.82% خلال الشهر)، رغم ارتفاع البيزو وصدور أخبار إيجابية في بعض الأنشطة التجارية والثقافية.
summary.fa: وضعیت کلمبیا آمیخته است اما به سمت منفی گرایش دارد: امنیت متشنج است، با گزارش‌هایی از انفجارها، شهرهای تحت حضور نظامی، ربوده شدن یک افسر توسط شورشیان و اعتصاب سراسری که برای 19 نوامبر فراخوان داده شده است. شاخص‌های اقتصادی ضعیف‌اند (شاخص بورس در همان روز 0.88% و در طول ماه 4.82% کاهش یافته است)، هرچند پزو ارزش یافته و برخی اخبار مثبت تجاری و فرهنگی گزارش شده است.
summary.zh: 哥伦比亚的局势喜忧参半，但总体偏负面：安全形势紧张，有报道称发生爆炸、城市处于军事化管控之下，叛军扣押一名军官，并宣布11月19日举行全国性罢工。经济信号疲软（股指当日下跌0.88%，当月下跌4.82%），不过比索有所走强，部分商业和文化新闻则较为积极。

summary.en: The UN biodiversity conference COP17 has opened in Armenia, and the country is attracting international attention. However, routine domestic political tensions continue, including the nationalisation of the electricity grid, relations with the EU, opposition-church tensions, and claims of politically motivated dismissals. With no clear crisis or major positive breakthrough, the score remains neutral.

en: Opening of the UN biodiversity conference COP17 in Yerevan
Nationalisation of the electricity grid (ENA) and arbitration dispute
Reports on the possible consequences of withdrawal from the EU
Tension between opposition and government, church and dismissal claims
Uncertainty over the peace agenda with Azerbaijan

summary.en: The period mixes positive economic and diplomatic items (new Air Serbia flights, flower exports, the TRIPP copper deal) with serious political strain. Police detained 14 after searches at an opposition office, an EU rapporteur urged easing pressure on the Church, and an EAEU report warned of a 69% gas price rise if membership were suspended.

en: Police detentions after searches at opposition office in Stepanavan
EAEU report warning of 69% gas price rise if membership suspended
EU rapporteur urging easing of pressure on the Church

summary.en: The period is dominated by economic and political strain: threatened 69% gas price rises and possible EAEU membership suspension, planned power outages, and opposition arrests ahead of Stepanavan elections with vote-buying and electoral-violation allegations. Offsetting positives include TRIPP progress (US stake and Armenian veto rights) and a well-attended tourism festival, so the score sits modestly below an ordinary day.

en: Threatened 69% gas price increase and EAEU suspension costs
Opposition arrests and detentions ahead of Stepanavan elections
Vote-buying and electoral-violation allegations against officials

summary.en: The period is dominated by political tension: CSTO and EAEU membership threats, opposition detentions and house arrests, and allegations of election interference around municipal polls. Positives include Armenia approving the TRIPP route agreement and a 1.5x rise in exports to the EU, but no violence or institutional collapse is reported.

en: CSTO and EAEU membership threats against Armenia
Detentions and house arrests of opposition candidates and supporters
Allegations of unlawful election interference ahead of municipal votes

summary.en: The period mixes routine government activity, such as investment committee approvals, US border-security equipment and the TRIPP transit discussion, with heightened political tension. Tension centres on possible CSTO exit, a snap-election dispute, detentions of opposition supporters and a border incident. GDELT tone (-0.58) is slightly better than the world average, so the net picture is roughly ordinary with a tense political backdrop.

en: Possible CSTO membership decision scheduled for 11 November
Detentions of Samvel Karapetyan supporters and opposition confrontation
US border-security equipment delivery and TRIPP transit debate

summary.en: Pre-election tensions dominate, with several opposition candidates and council members detained and talk of early elections and a constitutional crisis. Economic and social strain shows in World Bank poverty figures, power cuts and gas price warnings, partly offset by cultural and sporting successes and a fatal road accident.

en: Opposition candidates and council members detained ahead of local elections
Talk of early elections and a constitutional crisis
World Bank poverty figures and electricity cuts

summary.en: Local government elections were held peacefully on 25 October, with high turnout and some observer-reported violations and uneven competition. Yerevan's hosting of the UN biodiversity COP17 and positive international coverage add to a mildly positive day, offset by scheduled power cuts and fatal traffic accidents.

en: Local self-government elections held with high turnout
COP17 biodiversity summit hosted in Yerevan
Observers reported violations and uneven competition in elections

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: diplomacy with the EU, Azerbaijan and COP17, post-election political rhetoric, and a diplomatic spat with Russia over a governor's remarks. Civil-society criticism of a legislative package and tension over EAEU membership add some strain, and GDELT tone is slightly more negative than the world average, but no acute crisis appears.

en: Post-election dispute over opposition and alleged pressure on institutions
Diplomatic row with Russian embassy over governor's remarks
Positive cooperation: EU joint working group, Azerbaijan environmental projects

summary.en: Armenia's day was dominated by political strain: a G7 report on foreign interference in its elections, Russian calls to expel it from the CSTO, and opposition resistance to the TRIPP deal. Economic signals were also cautious, with a central bank warning and scheduled power cuts, though no crackdown or violence was clearly reported.

en: G7 report on foreign interference targeting Armenia's elections
Calls in Russian media to expel Armenia from the CSTO
Central bank warning on accumulating economic risks; scheduled power outages

summary.en: Armenia's period mixes a notable institutional step, parliament ratifying the US-backed TRIPP framework agreement, with sharp tensions with Russia over CSTO and EAEU membership, a parliamentary brawl, and reports of an 8% export decline and a record trade deficit. Taken together this is a politically tense but largely routine day, so the score sits near the neutral baseline.

en: Parliament ratified the US-backed TRIPP agreement with 63 votes
Foreign ministry rules out CSTO return; Russian officials escalate rhetoric
Brawl between ruling and opposition deputies in parliament

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: COP17 events, the US-backed TRIPP route approval and planned constitutional change, offset by a parliamentary brawl, a fatal ground collapse in Yerevan, and talk of early elections. The minor earthquake and the negative news tone do not on their own justify a lower score.

en: US-backed TRIPP route project approved by the government
Parliamentary brawl between deputies during a session
Fatal ground collapse in Yerevan near Salty Lake

summary.en: A mostly routine day: new residence and biometric passport rules, an EU review of the Armenia-Turkey border crossing, and flooding in Yerevan and Kotayk. Political tension showed up in a parliamentary brawl and a postponed church-related court case, and GDELT tone (-0.49) is slightly less negative than the world average.

en: Flooding in Yerevan and Kotayk Province from heavy rain
Parliamentary brawl between majority and opposition
EU review of Armenia-Turkey border crossing work

summary.en: The period was mostly routine, anchored by the successful close of the COP17 biodiversity conference in Yerevan with the adopted Yerevan Pathway. Political friction (referendum debates, a parliamentary brawl, Moscow rejecting a new ambassador) and a reported Azerbaijani positional build-up are offset by a news tone that is less negative than the world average.

en: COP17 in Yerevan concluded with the Yerevan Pathway adopted
Domestic political friction over referendum and parliamentary brawl
Reported Azerbaijani force reinforcements near Lake Sevan area

summary.en: Armenia's period was positive overall, anchored by the COP17 presidency and the adoption of the Yerevan Pathway, plus preparatory steps on the TRIPP transit route and border handover to the border service. Routine frictions included scheduled power cuts, a rejected appeal to annul Stepanavan election results, and a Russian denial of an ambassador-nomination dispute.

en: Yerevan Pathway adopted at COP17 biodiversity summit
Preparatory work started on TRIPP railway and highway project
Border control being transferred to the border guard service

summary.en: The period looks routine: government steps on border control and investment, alongside ordinary domestic friction such as opposition clashes, vandalism, power cuts and a temporary airport schedule cut. Positive economic and institutional items roughly offset the mixed political tone.

en: Plan to transfer full border control to Armenian guards
UAE leads foreign investment; direct flights rise
Opposition-government tension over public pressure threats

summary.en: The day mixed positive EU-related developments (a possible 2027–2028 EU application, new EU trade preferences for Armenian goods) with police searches of opposition leaders' homes, which raise institutional-pressure concerns. Planned power cuts and a sharp cold snap add to the strain, and the negative news tone is more pronounced than the world average.

en: Searches of Karapetyan family and Strong Armenia leaders' homes
Planned power outages across multiple regions and Yerevan districts
Pashinyan's EU membership application timeline and EU trade preferences

summary.en: The period is dominated by court orders re-detaining opposition leader Samvel Karapetyan and extending Gagik Tsarukyan's detention, alongside criminal proceedings against 36 people and CSTO pressure over Armenia's membership. Positive items, such as the EU tax cooperation deal and the opposition's unity initiative, are minor by comparison, so the score sits in the serious-pressure range.

en: Samvel Karapetyan re-arrested for a month; second detention in six months
Tsarukyan detention extended by three months amid opposition pressure
Criminal proceedings against 36 people, including a former presidential administration head

summary.en: Armenia's news over the period is dominated by the arrest of opposition billionaire Karapetyan, with opposition figures alleging persecution, alongside Russian trade restrictions and EAEU/CSTO tensions. Scheduled electricity cuts across Yerevan and all regions add to the strain, though there is no violence or crisis, and some diplomatic and investment news is mildly positive.
summary.tr: Dönem boyunca Ermenistan haberlerinde muhalefet milyarderi Karapetyan'ın tutuklanması öne çıkıyor; muhalefet figürleri siyasi zulüm iddiasında bulunuyor. Bunun yanı sıra Rusya'nın ticaret kısıtlamaları ve EAEU ile CSTO üyeliğine ilişkin gerilimler de gündemde. Erivan'da ve tüm bölgelerde planlanan elektrik kesintileri bu baskıyı artırıyor, ancak herhangi bir şiddet olayı ya da kriz yok ve bazı diplomatik ile yatırım haberleri hafif olumlu.
summary.es: Las noticias de Armenia del periodo están dominadas por el arresto del multimillonario opositor Karapetyan, cuyas figuras de la oposición denuncian persecución, junto con las restricciones comerciales rusas y las tensiones en torno a la UEEA y la OTSC. Los cortes de electricidad programados en Ereván y en todas las regiones agravan la presión, aunque no hay violencia ni crisis, y algunas noticias diplomáticas y de inversión son ligeramente positivas.
summary.fr: L'actualité arménienne de la période est dominée par l'arrestation du milliardaire d'opposition Karapetyan, dont des figures de l'opposition dénoncent une persécution, ainsi que par les restrictions commerciales russes et les tensions liées à l'UEEE et à l'OTSC. Les coupures d'électricité programmées à Erevan et dans toutes les régions ajoutent à la pression, bien qu'il n'y ait ni violence ni crise, et certaines informations diplomatiques et d'investissement sont légèrement positives.
summary.de: Die Berichterstattung über Armenien in diesem Zeitraum wird von der Verhaftung des oppositionellen Milliardärs Karapetyan beherrscht, wobei Oppositionspolitiker von politischer Verfolgung sprechen. Hinzu kommen russische Handelsbeschränkungen und Spannungen im Zusammenhang mit der EAWU- und der OVKS-Mitgliedschaft. Geplante Stromabschaltungen in Jerewan und in allen Regionen verschärfen die Belastung, doch es gibt weder Gewalt noch eine Krise, und einige diplomatische und Investitionsmeldungen sind leicht positiv.
summary.pt: As notícias da Arménia no período são dominadas pela detenção do bilionário da oposição Karapetyan, com figuras da oposição a alegarem perseguição, juntamente com restrições comerciais russas e tensões em torno da UEEA e da OTSC. Os cortes de eletricidade programados em Erevan e em todas as regiões agravam a pressão, embora não haja violência nem crise, e algumas notícias diplomáticas e de investimento são ligeiramente positivas.
summary.it: Le notizie sull'Armenia nel periodo considerato sono dominate dall'arresto del miliardario d'opposizione Karapetyan, con esponenti dell'opposizione che parlano di persecuzione, insieme a restrizioni commerciali russe e tensioni legate all'UEEA e all'OTSC. Le interruzioni di corrente programmate a Erevan e in tutte le regioni aggravano la situazione, ma non si segnalano violenze o crisi, e alcune notizie diplomatiche e sugli investimenti sono moderatamente positive.
summary.ru: Новости Армении за этот период определяются арестом оппозиционного миллиардера Карапетяна, представители оппозиции заявляют о преследовании, а также российскими торговыми ограничениями и напряжённостью вокруг ЕАЭС и ОДКБ. Запланированные отключения электроэнергии в Ереване и во всех регионах добавляют нагрузки, однако насилия или кризиса нет, а некоторые дипломатические и инвестиционные новости умеренно позитивны.
summary.ar: تهيمن على أخبار أرمينيا خلال الفترة المعنية قضية اعتقال الملياردير المعارض كارابيتيان، إذ تتهم شخصيات معارضة السلطات بالاضطهاد، إلى جانب القيود التجارية الروسية والتوترات المتعلقة بالاتحاد الاقتصادي الأوراسي ومنظمة معاهدة الأمن الجماعي. وتزيد انقطاعات الكهرباء المجدولة في يريفان وجميع المناطق من الضغوط، غير أنه لا توجد أعمال عنف أو أزمة، وتبدو بعض الأخبار الدبلوماسية والاستثمارية إيجابية بدرجة طفيفة.
summary.fa: اخبار ارمنستان در این دوره عمدتاً تحت تأثیر بازداشت الیگارش مخالف کاراپتیان است و چهره‌های مخالف آن را آزار سیاسی می‌دانند. در کنار آن، محدودیت‌های تجاری روسیه و تنش‌ها بر سر عضویت در اتحادیه اقتصادی اوراسیا و سازمان پیمان امنیت جمعی نیز مطرح است. قطعی‌های برنامه‌ریزی‌شده برق در ایروان و همه مناطق بر فشارها می‌افزاید، اما خشونت یا بحران خاصی گزارش نشده و برخی اخبار دیپلماتیک و سرمایه‌گذاری اندکی مثبت‌اند.
summary.zh: 该时期亚美尼亚的新闻主要围绕反对派亿万富翁卡拉佩特扬被捕展开，反对派人士指称遭到迫害。此外还有俄罗斯的贸易限制，以及与欧亚经济联盟和集体安全条约组织相关的紧张关系。埃里温及所有州计划中的停电进一步加重了压力，但并未发生暴力或危机事件，部分外交和投资新闻略显积极。
summary.ja: この期間のアルメニアのニュースは、野党の富豪カラペチャン氏の逮捕が中心となっており、野党関係者は政治的迫害だと主張している。あわせてロシアの貿易制限や、ユーラシア経済連合(EAEU)および集団安全保障条約機構(CSTO)をめぐる緊張も報じられている。エレバンと全10州で計画停電が実施され、住民の負担が増している。ただし暴力や危機は起きておらず、外交と投資に関するニュースには穏やかな前向きな内容も含まれている。
summary.ko: 이 기간 아르메니아 뉴스는 야당 억만장자 카라페티안의 체포가 주를 이루며, 야당 인사들은 이를 정치적 탄압이라고 주장하고 있다. 아울러 러시아의 무역 제한과 EAEU 및 CSTO 가입을 둘러싼 긴장도 보도되었다. 예레반과 전국 10개 주에서 예정된 정전이 주민들의 부담을 더하고 있으나, 폭력이나 위기 상황은 없으며 일부 외교 및 투자 소식은 다소 긍정적이다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में अर्मेनिया की ख़बरों पर मुख्य रूप से विपक्षी अरबपति करापेतियन की गिरफ़्तारी छाई रही, और विपक्षी नेताओं ने इसे राजनीतिक उत्पीड़न बताया है। इसके साथ रूस के व्यापार प्रतिबंध और यूरेशियन आर्थिक संघ (EAEU) तथा सामूहिक सुरक्षा संधि संगठन (CSTO) की सदस्यता को लेकर तनाव भी रहे। येरेवान और सभी दस प्रांतों में निर्धारित बिजली कटौती से लोगों पर दबाव बढ़ा है, हालांकि कोई हिंसा या संकट नहीं हुआ, और कुछ कूटनीतिक व निवेश संबंधी समाचार हल्के सकारात्मक हैं।
summary.el: Οι ειδήσεις για την Αρμενία κατά την περίοδο κυριαρχούνται από τη σύλληψη του αντιπολιτευόμενου δισεκατομμυριούχου Καραπετιάν, με στελέχη της αντιπολίτευσης να καταγγέλλουν πολιτική δίωξη, παράλληλα με τους ρωσικούς εμπορικούς περιορισμούς και τις εντάσεις γύρω από την ΕΟΚ (EAEU) και τον ΟΣΣΑ (CSTO). Οι προγραμματισμένες διακοπές ρεύματος στο Ερεβάν και σε όλες τις περιφέρειες επιβαρύνουν περαιτέρω την κατάσταση, ωστόσο δεν υπάρχει βία ή κρίση, και ορισμένες διπλωματικές και επενδυτικές ειδήσεις είναι ήπια θετικές.

summary.en: War continues in Sudan. Drone attacks in Kordofan, Darfur, Khartoum and Abyei killed more than 100 civilians within 24 hours, including three children. A record parallel-market dollar rate and an increase in the customs dollar rate are deepening the economic collapse; the UN condemned the attacks.

en: Drone attacks in Kordofan, Darfur and Khartoum killed more than 100 civilians
An attack on a market in Abyei killed dozens of people and raised tensions with South Sudan
Drone attacks near Khartoum Airport; three children were killed and services were disrupted
The customs dollar rate rose to 5631 pounds, and the parallel-market exchange rate hit a record
Clashes in the Blue Nile and the continuing army-RSF war

summary.en: Sudan's period is dominated by mass drone strikes killing over 150 people at an Abyei market and more than 100 across Kordofan, Darfur and Khartoum, alongside child deaths, a severe bread shortage and famine warnings. Peace talks returning to Geneva are the only positive thread, which does not offset the ongoing mass violence.

en: Drone strike on Abyei market kills at least 153 people
Over 100 killed in drone attacks across Kordofan, Darfur, Khartoum
UN condemns drone strikes; warns of disrupted services nationwide

summary.en: Sudan's ongoing war continues with intensive drone strikes, including a reported market strike in Abyei killing at least 153, and UN peace talks ended without progress. Currency collapse past 10,000 per dollar and hunger reports deepen the humanitarian catastrophe, with only minor positives such as reopened exam windows and a revived oil corporation.

en: Drone strike on Abyei market reportedly kills at least 153
UN peace talks end without progress amid deepening war
Pound falls past 10,000 per dollar; hunger crisis widens

summary.en: Sudan's ongoing war is producing a major humanitarian crisis: 19.5 million people face food insecurity, drone strikes continue, and reports allege RSF attacks on hospitals in El-Fasher. Ceasefire talks in Geneva failed, and inflation is rising, with the dollar at SDG 10,300, though the army's recapture of Blue Nile areas is a minor counterpoint.

en: Ceasefire talks in Geneva failed again
19.5 million facing food insecurity amid violence
Reports of RSF deliberately targeting hospitals in El-Fasher

summary.en: Sudan's ongoing war continues with drone strikes killing at least 306 people in three weeks, reports of hospital attacks, an alleged massacre in Abyei, and a looming famine risk worsened by drought and aid shortfalls. Protests in army-held areas and market paralysis add to the picture, with only minor positives such as an army base retaken and press union recognition.

en: Drone strikes killed at least 306 people in three weeks
Famine risk warnings amid drought and declining aid
Alleged Abyei massacre and RSF attacks on hospitals

summary.en: Sudan's war is ongoing, with drone strikes causing mass casualties, reported massacres, and a strike on a senior RSF leader's residence. Modest positives, including RSF officer defections, army field gains, and renewed Quad diplomacy in Geneva, do not offset the widespread violence and humanitarian strain.

en: Drone attacks killed 306 people in October, per UN rights chief
Army strike on RSF leader's residence and reported commander deaths
Reported massacres and Amnesty torture allegations in El Fasher

summary.en: Sudan's war continues with famine warnings for 19.5 million people, drone strikes reported to have killed 306 in three weeks, and protests in Atbara. Diplomatic activity, including UN and Arab League efforts and expected dialogue steps, offers only a faint positive signal.

en: Famine risk rising; 19.5 million face acute hunger
Drone strikes reportedly killed 306 people in three weeks
Protests in Atbara on 25 October anniversary

summary.en: Sudan's 24 hours were dominated by continued war: drone strikes killing 21 in Nyala, power stations hit causing mass outages across several states, and famine warnings from major powers, with the anniversary of the El Fasher atrocities recalling mass violence. Limited positives such as a proposed one-month humanitarian truce, aid pledges and a government removal of customs on basic foods do not offset the severity.

en: Drone strikes kill 21 in Nyala and hit power stations causing outages
Famine warnings from US and allies; atrocities in El Fasher persist
UK sanctions on 15 commanders; US proposes one-month humanitarian truce

summary.en: Sudan's war continued over the last 24 hours with a drone strike on a South Darfur market reportedly killing over 100 people, drone attacks cutting power across Khartoum and other states, and Western governments warning of famine risk. No positive developments of note appear; the only offsetting item is a minor measure exempting basic foods from customs.

en: Drone strike on Nyala market reportedly kills 100+ civilians
Drone attacks on power stations cause widespread blackouts in several states
US, EU and 30 countries warn of famine risk

summary.en: Sudan's war continued with a drone strike on a Darfur market reported to have killed over 100 people, later put at 188, plus drone attacks on power stations and fresh displacement in Blue Nile. Famine warnings, rising bread prices and UN calls for an arms embargo point to a severe humanitarian crisis.

en: Nyala market drone strike, reported death toll of 100 to 188
Drone strikes on power stations and fuel depots cutting electricity
Fresh displacement from fighting in Blue Nile and El Obeid

summary.en: The 24-hour news flow is dominated by an ongoing war: drone strikes on civilians and infrastructure, a new 120,000-person displacement, looming famine, and reports of wartime sexual violence. Peace calls and a UAE arms-trafficking verdict are minor offsets, and GDELT tone is much more negative than the world average.

en: Drone strikes killing civilians and knocking out electricity and hospitals
Famine warnings and renewed displacement, including 120,000 people in Blue Nile
Investigation into commanders linked to wartime rape

summary.en: The 24-hour flow is dominated by the ongoing war: drone strikes knocked out power stations in Shendi and elsewhere, El Fasher humanitarian appeals continue, and Port Sudan faces water shortages. Modest positives, including a rail recovery plan, a polio campaign and an RSF commander's defection, do not offset the widespread violence and infrastructure damage.

en: Drone strikes disabling power stations and fuel depots in Shendi and other cities
El Fasher humanitarian crisis and appeals for international aid
Port Sudan water shortages and infrastructure strain

summary.en: Sudan's ongoing war continues to escalate, with drone strikes on power stations and civilian sites, shelling in Kordofan, a UN chief condemnation citing hundreds of deaths, and cross-border accusations against Ethiopia. Only minor positives appear, such as partial recovery of drug supply chains and EU-funded demining, which do not offset the widespread violence.

en: Drone strikes on power stations and civilian sites, hundreds reported killed
Cross-border accusations between Sudan and Ethiopia over drone launches
Displaced people in Blue Nile and Darfur face water and food shortages

summary.en: Sudan's war continued with drone strikes on power stations that left parts of the east under blackout and pushed the grid toward collapse, and the UN reported hundreds killed by drones. Sudan filed complaints against Ethiopia, and new displacement was reported in North Darfur, Blue Nile and Kordofan. A UN envoy's expectation of RSF talks within weeks and Egypt-Sudan water cooperation are modest positives.

en: Drone strikes knocked out power stations, causing blackouts and near grid collapse
UN reports drone attacks killed hundreds across Sudan
Sudan files complaints against Ethiopia over drone attacks

summary.en: Sudan's ongoing war continues with drone strikes on power stations causing widespread outages, civilian casualties, and famine warnings, alongside cross-border accusations against Ethiopia. Minor positives such as dissolution of RSF civilian administration are outweighed by mass violence and humanitarian deterioration.

en: Drone attacks hitting power stations and causing nationwide outages
Civilian deaths in Darfur drone strikes and famine warnings
Sudan accuses Ethiopia of backing RSF drone attacks

summary.en: Sudan's ongoing war dominated the period, with deadly drone strikes on civilians, a reported massacre in South Kordofan, a joint force commander killed, and a UN famine warning. Minor positives, such as Abyei community rapprochement and a peace envoy awaiting talks, do not offset the mass violence and humanitarian crisis.

en: Deadly RSF drone strikes causing civilian casualties and UN warnings
Reported massacre and fuel station strike with dozens of casualties in Kordofan
UN warns Sudan on brink of famine

summary.en: Sudan's ongoing war continues to drive civilian deaths from drone strikes, power and fuel infrastructure damage, bread shortages and hunger warnings from the UN and others. Diplomatic tensions also escalated, with Ethiopia and Sudan expelling diplomats and closing consulates, and Egypt threatening its defence pact.

en: Drone attacks killing civilians and crippling power infrastructure, per UN
Ethiopia-Sudan mutual diplomatic expulsions and consulate closures
Bread shortages and hunger threats amid war and inflation

summary.en: Sudan's war continues with fighting in Kordofan and Blue Nile, drone strikes in Abyei, and displacement of thousands. Acute hunger is spreading (20 million in severe food insecurity), and Sudan and Ethiopia have expelled diplomats and closed consulates, so the period falls in the war and humanitarian-catastrophe band.
summary.tr: Sudan'ın savaşı Kordofan ve Mavi Nil'de süren çatışmalar, Abyei'de İHA saldırıları ve binlerce kişinin yerinden edilmesiyle devam ediyor. Akut açlık yayılıyor (20 milyon kişi ciddi gıda güvensizliği altında), Sudan ve Etiyopya diplomatları sınır dışı etti ve konsoloslukları kapattı; bu dönem savaş ve insani felaket kuşağına giriyor.
summary.es: La guerra en Sudán continúa con combates en Kordofán y el Nilo Azul, ataques con drones en Abyei y el desplazamiento de miles de personas. El hambre aguda se extiende (20 millones en inseguridad alimentaria grave), y Sudán y Etiopía han expulsado diplomáticos y cerrado consulados, por lo que el periodo se sitúa en la franja de guerra y catástrofe humanitaria.
summary.fr: La guerre au Soudan se poursuit avec des combats au Kordofan et dans le Nil Bleu, des frappes de drones à Abyei et le déplacement de milliers de personnes. La faim aiguë gagne du terrain (20 millions de personnes en insécurité alimentaire grave), et le Soudan et l'Éthiopie ont expulsé des diplomates et fermé des consulats ; la période relève donc de la guerre et de la catastrophe humanitaire.
summary.de: Der Krieg im Sudan geht weiter, mit Kämpfen in Kordofan und am Blauen Nil, Drohnenangriffen in Abyei und der Vertreibung Tausender Menschen. Akuter Hunger breitet sich aus (20 Millionen Menschen von schwerer Ernährungsunsicherheit betroffen), und der Sudan und Äthiopien haben Diplomaten ausgewiesen und Konsulate geschlossen; der Zeitraum fällt damit in die Phase von Krieg und humanitärer Katastrophe.
summary.pt: A guerra no Sudão continua, com combates em Kordofão e no Nilo Azul, ataques com drones em Abyei e o deslocamento de milhares de pessoas. A fome aguda está a espalhar-se (20 milhões em insegurança alimentar grave), e o Sudão e a Etiópia expulsaram diplomatas e encerraram consulados, situando-se o período na faixa de guerra e catástrofe humanitária.
summary.ja: スーダンでは戦争が続いており、コルドファンとブルーナイルで戦闘が行われ、アビエイではドローン攻撃が発生し、数千人が避難を余儀なくされています。深刻な飢餓が広がっており(2000万人が深刻な食料不安に直面)、スーダンとエチオピアは外交官を追放し領事館を閉鎖しました。この期間は戦争と人道的大惨事の範囲に含まれます。
summary.ko: 수단에서는 전쟁이 계속되고 있으며, 코르도판과 청나일에서 전투가 벌어지고 있고, 아비에이에서는 드론 공격이 발생했으며, 수천 명이 피란을 떠나고 있습니다. 극심한 기아가 확산되고 있으며(2000만 명이 심각한 식량 불안정에 직면), 수단과 에티오피아는 외교관을 추방하고 영사관을 폐쇄했습니다. 이 기간은 전쟁 및 인도적 재난 범주에 해당합니다.
summary.hi: सूडान में युद्ध जारी है, कोर्डोफान और ब्लू नाइल में लड़ाई हो रही है, अबेई में ड्रोन हमले हुए हैं, और हज़ारों लोग विस्थापित हुए हैं। भीषण भुखमरी फैल रही है (20 मिलियन लोग गंभीर खाद्य असुरक्षा का सामना कर रहे हैं), और सूडान तथा इथियोपिया ने राजनयिकों को निष्कासित किया है और वाणिज्य दूतावास बंद कर दिए हैं, इसलिए यह अवधि युद्ध और मानवीय आपदा की श्रेणी में आती है।
summary.el: Ο πόλεμος στο Σουδάν συνεχίζεται, με μάχες στο Κορντοφάν και στο Μπλε Νείλο, επιθέσεις με drones στο Αμπέι και εκτόπιση χιλιάδων ανθρώπων. Η οξεία πείνα εξαπλώνεται (20 εκατομμύρια άνθρωποι σε σοβαρή επισιτιστική ανασφάλεια), ενώ το Σουδάν και η Αιθιοπία έχουν απελάσει διπλωμάτες και κλείσει προξενεία, οπότε η περίοδος εμπίπτει στην κατηγορία του πολέμου και της ανθρωπιστικής καταστροφής.
summary.it: La guerra in Sudan prosegue con combattimenti nel Kordofan e nel Nilo Azzurro, attacchi con droni ad Abyei e lo sfollamento di migliaia di persone. La fame acuta si sta diffondendo (20 milioni in condizioni di grave insicurezza alimentare), e Sudan ed Etiopia hanno espulso diplomatici e chiuso consolati, quindi il periodo rientra nella fascia della guerra e della catastrofe umanitaria.
summary.ru: Война в Судане продолжается: идут бои в Кордофане и Голубом Ниле, в Абьеи наносятся удары беспилотников, тысячи людей вынуждены покидать свои дома. Острый голод распространяется (20 миллионов человек находятся в условиях тяжёлой продовольственной незащищённости), Судан и Эфиопия высылают дипломатов и закрывают консульства, поэтому данный период относится к категории войны и гуманитарной катастрофы.
summary.ar: تتواصل الحرب في السودان مع استمرار القتال في كردفان والنيل الأزرق، وشن ضربات بالطائرات المسيّرة في أبيي، ونزوح الآلاف. ويتفشى الجوع الحاد (20 مليون شخص يعانون من انعدام الأمن الغذائي الحاد)، وقد طردت السودان وإثيوبيا دبلوماسيين وأغلقت قنصليات، لذا تندرج هذه الفترة ضمن نطاق الحرب والكارثة الإنسانية.
summary.fa: جنگ در سودان ادامه دارد، با درگیری‌ها در کردفان و نیل آبی، حملات پهپادی در ابیی و آوارگی هزاران نفر. گرسنگی شدید در حال گسترش است (۲۰ میلیون نفر با ناامنی غذایی شدید مواجه‌اند) و سودان و اتیوپی دیپلمات‌ها را اخراج و کنسولگری‌ها را تعطیل کرده‌اند، بنابراین این دوره در دسته جنگ و فاجعه بشردوستانه قرار می‌گیرد.
summary.zh: 苏丹战事持续，科尔多凡和青尼罗河州发生战斗，阿卜耶伊遭无人机袭击，数千人流离失所。严重饥饿正在蔓延（2000万人面临严重粮食不安全），苏丹与埃塞俄比亚驱逐了外交官并关闭了领事馆，因此该时期属于战争与人道主义灾难范畴。

summary.en: No crisis is observed in New Zealand in the past 24 hours; the main development is the entry into force of the free trade agreement with India and the strengthening of trade dialogues with Brazil and Canada. The decline in emergency shelter numbers in Rotorua and the health/biotechnology investments are positive, while the slight stock market decline and the political debates before the election are neutral. The tone of the news is markedly more positive than the global average.

en: Entry into force of the New Zealand-India free trade agreement
Trade dialogue with Brazil and Canada
Easing of the emergency housing crisis in Rotorua
Car-T facility and health investments in Christchurch
Slight stock market decline (-0.86% weekly)

summary.en: The period was mostly routine, with the India-New Zealand free trade agreement taking effect and a New Zealand-Canada trade dialogue announced, alongside a 0.95% daily gain on the NZX 50. Negatives were limited to a raised volcanic alert at White Island, a kindergarten closure over funding, and an Air NZ tarmac delay.

Offsetting concerns include an Air NZ safety review, criticism of health system policy, and an election campaign with pending fiscal and defence debates. The stock index was roughly flat.

summary.tr: Yeni Zelanda bugün sıkı ve olağan bir genel seçim yaptı; seçim kampanyası barışçıl geçti ve kurumsal bir gerilim bildirilmedi. Piyasalar mütevazı biçimde yükseldi ve genel hava hafif olumluydu; bunun karşısında geçim maliyetiyle ilgili kaygılar, bir konut piyasası durgunluğu ve ölümlü bir uçak kazası yer aldı.
summary.es: Nueva Zelanda celebró hoy unas elecciones generales reñidas y de rutina, con una campaña pacífica y sin tensiones institucionales reportadas. Los mercados subieron modestamente y el tono fue levemente positivo, contrarrestado por las preocupaciones sobre el costo de vida, un estancamiento en el mercado inmobiliario y un accidente aéreo mortal.
summary.fr: La Nouvelle-Zélande a tenu aujourd'hui des élections générales serrées et de routine, avec une campagne pacifique et aucune tension institutionnelle signalée. Les marchés ont légèrement progressé et le ton était modérément positif, contrebalancé par les préoccupations liées au coût de la vie, un ralentissement du marché immobilier et un accident d'avion mortel.
summary.de: Neuseeland hielt heute eine knappe, routinemäßige Parlamentswahl ab; der Wahlkampf verlief friedlich und es wurden keine institutionellen Spannungen gemeldet. Die Märkte legten moderat zu und die Stimmung war leicht positiv, was durch Sorgen über die Lebenshaltungskosten, eine stagnierende Immobilienmarkt-Lage und einen tödlichen Flugzeugabsturz ausgeglichen wurde.
summary.pt: A Nova Zelândia realizou hoje uma eleição geral acirrada e de rotina, com campanha pacífica e nenhuma tensão institucional relatada. Os mercados subiram modestamente e o tom foi levemente positivo, contrabalançado por preocupações com o custo de vida, uma estagnação no mercado imobiliário e uma queda fatal de avião.
summary.ja: ニュージーランドでは本日、接戦となった定例の総選挙が行われた。選挙運動は平穏で、制度上の緊張は報告されていない。株式市場は小幅に上昇し、全体の論調はやや前向きだったが、生活費への懸念、住宅市場の停滞、そして死亡事故を伴う飛行機墜落事故がその効果を相殺した。
summary.ko: 뉴질랜드는 이날 접전 양상의 정례 총선을 치렀다. 선거운동은 평화롭게 진행되었고 제도적 긴장은 보고되지 않았다. 증시는 소폭 상승하고 전반적 분위기는 다소 긍정적이었으나, 생활비 우려와 부동산 시장의 정체, 그리고 사망자를 낸 비행기 추락 사고가 이를 상쇄했다.
summary.hi: न्यूज़ीलैंड में इस दिन एक कड़े मुकाबले वाला, नियमित आम चुनाव हुआ। प्रचार शांतिपूर्ण रहा और संस्थागत तनाव की कोई रिपोर्ट नहीं मिली। बाज़ार में मामूली बढ़त रही और माहौल हल्का सकारात्मक रहा, जिसे जीवन-यापन लागत की चिंताओं, संपत्ति बाज़ार के ठहराव और एक घातक विमान दुर्घटना ने संतुलित किया।
summary.el: Η Νέα Ζηλανδία διεξήγαγε σήμερα σφιχτές, συνήθεις γενικές εκλογές. Η προεκλογική εκστρατεία διεξήχθη ειρηνικά και δεν αναφέρθηκε καμία θεσμική πίεση. Οι αγορές σημείωσαν μέτρια άνοδο και ο γενικός τόνος ήταν ήπια θετικός, ωστόσο αντισταθμίστηκε από ανησυχίες για το κόστος ζωής, από τη στασιμότητα της αγοράς ακινήτων και από μια θανατηφόρα αεροπορική συντριβή.
summary.it: La Nuova Zelanda ha tenuto oggi elezioni generali serrate e di routine, con una campagna elettorale pacifica e nessuno stress istituzionale segnalato. I mercati sono saliti moderatamente e il tono è stato leggermente positivo, controbilanciato da preoccupazioni per il costo della vita, da una battuta d'arresto del mercato immobiliare e da un incidente aereo mortale.
summary.ru: Сегодня в Новой Зеландии прошли напряжённые, рутинные всеобщие выборы; предвыборная кампания проходила мирно, институциональных потрясений не сообщалось. Рынки немного выросли, общий тон был умеренно позитивным, что компенсировалось опасениями по поводу стоимости жизни, застоем на рынке недвижимости и смертельной авиакатастрофой.
summary.ar: شهدت نيوزيلندا اليوم انتخابات عامة تنافسية وروتينية، إذ جرت الحملة الانتخابية بسلام ولم تُسجَّل أي ضغوط مؤسسية. ارتفعت الأسواق بشكل طفيف واتسم الجو العام بالإيجابية المعتدلة، وقابل ذلك قلق بشأن تكلفة المعيشة، وتراجع في سوق العقارات، وحادث تحطم طائرة أودى بحياة أشخاص.
summary.fa: نیوزیلند امروز انتخابات عمومی فشرده و معمولی‌ای را برگزار کرد؛ کمپین انتخاباتی مسالمت‌آمیز بود و هیچ فشار نهادی گزارش نشد. بازارها اندکی بالا رفتند و فضای کلی ملایماً مثبت بود، اما نگرانی‌ها درباره هزینه زندگی، رکود بازار مسکن و سقوط مرگبار یک هواپیما این اثر را تعدیل کرد.
summary.zh: 新西兰今日举行了竞争激烈但按部就班的大选，竞选活动平和，未报告任何体制层面的紧张局势。市场小幅上涨，整体基调略显积极，但生活成本担忧、房地产市场停滞以及一起致命的飞机坠毁事件抵消了部分积极影响。

summary.en: Indonesia is experiencing its worst forest fire season since 2015. The fires have burned about two million hectares, smoke has spread, and 2,600 flights were disrupted. The stock market fell 18% in a month, one of its sharpest declines since 1998, and faces a possible MSCI downgrade. Today's 5,65% rebound does not reverse this picture. Protests are also taking place on Prabowo's second anniversary in office, with more than 9.000 security personnel deployed and falling public support.

en: The worst forest fire and smoke crisis since 2015, burning about two million hectares
A record two-day stock market collapse and MSCI pressure; an 18% monthly loss, with a partial rebound today
Protests on Prabowo's second anniversary, heavy security measures and declining public support
Suspension of foreign aid offers for the fires and tensions with neighbouring countries
KPK corruption investigations that also cover BNPB

summary.en: Indonesia faces several serious pressures at once: student protests over living costs and forest fires, a worsening haze crisis with Singapore's enforcement action, and a sharp equity sell-off (down about 11% in a week) tied to MSCI classification concerns. Positive items such as EU drought aid and a rediscovered primate are minor by comparison.

en: Student protests over living costs and fires; 9,505 security personnel deployed

summary.en: Indonesia faces a stock market rout of about 14% over a month after an MSCI downgrade threat, student protests over living costs and forest fires, fuel and power shortages in parts of the country, and a ferry fire. summary.en: The period is dominated by a widening haze crisis that has disrupted thousands of flights, plus an MSCI downgrade risk that has pushed the IDX down about 15% over the month. summary.en: The period is mostly routine local news, but a severe haze crisis is sparking student protests and fires in Papua and South Sumatra. summary.it: Il periodo dell'Indonesia è dominato da uno scandalo di intercettazioni telefoniche che coinvolge l'arresto di generali e un imponente dispiegamento di truppe a Giacarta, con i media stranieri che riportano un'elevata tensione. A complicare il quadro, gli incendi boschivi più intensi degli ultimi 11 anni si stanno diffondendo su diverse isole e l'indice di borsa è sceso di circa il 19% nel corso del mese, sebbene siano proseguite le notizie di routine su governance e commercio.
summary.ru: Период в Индонезии определяется скандалом с прослушиванием телефонных разговоров, связанным с арестами генералов, и масштабным развёртыванием войск в Джакарте; зарубежные СМИ сообщают о высокой напряжённости. Усугубляет ситуацию самая сильная за 11 лет волна лесных пожаров, охватывающая несколько островов, а фондовый индекс за месяц снизился примерно на 19%, при этом продолжались текущие новости о государственном управлении и торговле.
summary.ar: تهيمن على الفترة الراهنة في إندونيسيا فضيحة تنصت تتعلق باعتقال جنرالات، مع نشر قوات مكثف في جاكرتا، وتتحدث وسائل إعلام أجنبية عن توتر شديد. ويزيد الأمر تعقيدًا أن أعنف حرائق الغابات منذ 11 عامًا تمتد عبر عدة جزر، فيما انخفض مؤشر البورصة بنحو 19% خلال الشهر، رغم استمرار الأخبار الروتينية المتعلقة بالحوكمة والتجارة.
summary.fa: دوره کنونی اندونزی تحت تأثیر رسوایی شنود مکالمات مربوط به بازداشت ژنرال‌ها و استقرار گسترده نیروها در جاکارتا است و رسانه‌های خارجی از تنش بالا خبر می‌دهند. افزون بر این، شدیدترین آتش‌سوزی‌های جنگلی در ۱۱ سال گذشته در چند جزیره گسترش یافته و شاخص بورس طی یک ماه حدود ۱۹ درصد کاهش یافته است، هرچند اخبار معمول حکمرانی و تجارت همچنان ادامه داشته است.
summary.zh: 印度尼西亚近期局势主要受窃听丑闻影响，涉及将军被捕及雅加达大规模部署军队，外国媒体报道称局势高度紧张。此外，过去11年来最严重的森林火灾正在多个岛屿蔓延，股市指数一个月内下跌约19%，同时仍有常规的治理和贸易新闻。
summary.tr: Endonezya'nın bu dönemi, generallerin tutuklanmasını ve Cakarta'da yoğun asker konuşlandırmasını içeren bir dinleme skandalıyla şekilleniyor; yabancı medya yüksek gerilimi bildiriyor. Buna ek olarak, 11 yılın en yoğun orman yangınları birkaç adaya yayılıyor ve borsa endeksi bir ay içinde yaklaşık %19 düşerken, rutin yönetişim ve ticaret haberleri sürdü.
summary.es: El período de Indonesia está dominado por un escándalo de escuchas telefónicas que involucra el arresto de generales y un fuerte despliegue de tropas en Yakarta, mientras los medios extranjeros informan de una alta tensión. A esto se suman los incendios forestales más intensos en 11 años, que se extienden por varias islas, y el índice bursátil cae alrededor de un 19% en el mes, aunque continuaron las noticias rutinarias de gobernanza y comercio.
summary.fr: La période en Indonésie est dominée par un scandale d'écoutes téléphoniques impliquant l'arrestation de généraux et un important déploiement de troupes à Jakarta, les médias étrangers faisant état de fortes tensions. À cela s'ajoutent les incendies de forêt les plus intenses depuis 11 ans, qui se propagent sur plusieurs îles, et l'indice boursier recule d'environ 19 % sur le mois, bien que les informations courantes sur la gouvernance et le commerce se soient poursuivies.
summary.de: Indonesiens aktuelle Lage wird von einem Abhörskandal geprägt, der die Festnahme von Generälen und einen massiven Truppeneinsatz in Jakarta umfasst; ausländische Medien berichten von hohen Spannungen. Hinzu kommen die heftigsten Waldbrände seit 11 Jahren, die sich über mehrere Inseln ausbreiten, und der Aktienindex verliert im Monatsverlauf etwa 19 %, während routinemäßige Berichte zu Regierungsführung und Handel weiterliefen.
summary.pt: O período da Indonésia é dominado por um escândalo de escutas telefônicas que envolve a prisão de generais e uma forte mobilização de tropas em Jacarta, com a mídia estrangeira relatando alta tensão. Somam-se a isso os incêndios florestais mais intensos em 11 anos, que se espalham por várias ilhas, e o índice da bolsa cai cerca de 19% no mês, embora notícias rotineiras sobre governança e comércio tenham continuado.
summary.ja: インドネシアの情勢は、将軍らの逮捕を伴う盗聴スキャンダルと、ジャカルタへの大規模な部隊展開が中心となっており、海外メディアは高い緊張を報じている。これに加え、11年ぶりの激しさとなる山火事が複数の島々に広がっており、株価指数は1か月で約19%下落した一方、日常的な統治や貿易に関するニュースも続いている。

summary.hi: इंडोनेशिया की वर्तमान स्थिति में जनरलों की गिरफ्तारी से जुड़े एक वायरटैपिंग घोटाले और जकार्ता में भारी संख्या में सैनिकों की तैनाती का वर्चस्व है, और विदेशी मीडिया उच्च तनाव की रिपोर्ट कर रहा है। इसके साथ ही, 11 वर्षों में सबसे तीव्र जंगल की आग कई द्वीपों में फैल रही है, और शेयर सूचकांक एक महीने में लगभग 19% नीचे है, हालांकि शासन और व्यापार से जुड़ी नियमित खबरें जारी रहीं।
summary.el: Η περίοδος στην Ινδονησία κυριαρχείται από ένα σκάνδαλο υποκλοπών, που περιλαμβάνει τη σύλληψη στρατηγών και τη μαζική ανάπτυξη στρατευμάτων στην Τζακάρτα, ενώ τα ξένα μέσα ενημέρωσης αναφέρουν υψηλή ένταση. Επιπλέον, οι πιο έντονες πυρκαγιές των τελευταίων 11 ετών εξαπλώνονται σε αρκετά νησιά, και ο δείκτης μετοχών έχει υποχωρήσει κατά περίπου 19% μέσα στον μήνα, αν και οι συνήθεις ειδήσεις για τη διακυβέρνηση και το εμπόριο συνεχίστηκαν.

summary.fa: شورش‌های زندان در Renovación 1 و El Boquerón منجر به گروگان‌گیری نگهبانان شد، اما مقامات آن را مهار کردند و نگهبانان آزاد شدند. سایر اخبار متفاوت بود: قتل‌ها در Zacapa محکومیت گروه‌های حقوق بشری را برانگیخت، در حالی که قیمت سوخت کاهش یافت و اخبار مربوط به معدن و ترویج سرمایه‌گذاری مثبت بود.
summary.zh: Renovación 1和El Boquerón监狱发生骚乱，狱警被扣为人质，但当局已控制局势，狱警已获释。其他新闻喜忧参半：Zacapa的杀人事件引发人权组织谴责，而燃油价格有所回落，矿业和投资促进方面的报道则较为正面。
summary.tr: Renovación 1 ve El Boquerón cezaevlerinde çıkan isyanlarda gardiyanlar rehin alındı, ancak yetkililer olayları kontrol altına aldı ve gardiyanlar serbest bırakıldı. Diğer haberler karışık nitelikteydi: Zacapa'daki cinayetler insan hakları örgütlerinin kınamasına yol açtı, buna karşın akaryakıt fiyatları geriledi ve madencilik ile yatırım tanıtımına ilişkin haberler olumluydu.
summary.es: Motines en las cárceles de Renovación 1 y El Boquerón tomaron como rehenes a guardias, pero las autoridades los contuvieron y los guardias fueron liberados. Otras noticias fueron mixtas: los asesinatos en Zacapa suscitaron la condena de organizaciones de derechos humanos, mientras que los precios de los combustibles bajaron y las noticias sobre minería y promoción de inversiones fueron positivas.
summary.fr: Des émeutes dans les prisons de Renovación 1 et d'El Boquerón ont pris des gardiens en otage, mais les autorités ont maîtrisé la situation et les gardiens ont été libérés. Les autres informations étaient contrastées : les meurtres à Zacapa ont suscité la condamnation d'organisations de défense des droits humains, tandis que les prix des carburants ont baissé et que les nouvelles sur l'exploitation minière et la promotion des investissements étaient positives.
summary.de: Gefängnisaufstände in Renovación 1 und El Boquerón nahmen Wachleute als Geiseln, doch die Behörden brachten die Lage unter Kontrolle und die Wachleute wurden freigelassen. Andere Meldungen fielen gemischt aus: Tötungen in Zacapa lösten Verurteilungen durch Menschenrechtsorganisationen aus, während die Kraftstoffpreise nachgaben und Berichte über Bergbau und Investitionsförderung positiv waren.
summary.pt: Motins em presídios de Renovación 1 e El Boquerón fizeram guardas reféns, mas as autoridades conseguiram conter a situação e os guardas foram libertados. Outras notícias foram mistas: os assassinatos em Zacapa provocaram a condenação de organizações de direitos humanos, enquanto os preços dos combustíveis caíram e as notícias sobre mineração e promoção de investimentos foram positivas.
summary.ja: Renovación 1とEl Bocquerónの刑務所で暴動が発生し、看守が人質に取られたが、当局が事態を収拾し、看守は解放された。その他のニュースはまちまちで、Zacapaでの殺害事件に人権団体が非難を表明した一方、燃料価格は下落し、鉱業と投資促進に関する報道は前向きだった。
summary.ko: Renovación 1과 El Boquerón 교도소에서 폭동이 발생해 교도관들이 인질로 잡혔으나, 당국이 사태를 진압했고 교도관들은 석방되었다. 그 밖의 뉴스는 엇갈렸다. Zacapa에서 발생한 살인 사건에 대해 인권단체들이 규탄했고, 연료 가격은 하락했으며 광업 및 투자 유치 관련 소식은 긍정적이었다.
summary.hi: Renovación 1 और El Boquerón की जेलों में दंगे हुए, जिनमें गार्डों को बंधक बना लिया गया, लेकिन अधिकारियों ने स्थिति पर काबू पा लिया और गार्डों को रिहा कर दिया गया। अन्य समाचार मिले-जुले रहे: Zacapa में हत्याओं की मानवाधिकार समूहों ने निंदा की, जबकि ईंधन की कीमतों में गिरावट आई और खनन तथा निवेश-प्रोत्साहन से जुड़ी खबरें सकारात्मक रहीं।
summary.el: Ταραχές σε φυλακές στις Renovación 1 και El Boquerón είχαν ως αποτέλεσμα να πάρουν όμηρους φύλακες, ωστόσο οι αρχές περιόρισαν την κατάσταση και οι φύλακες αφέθηκαν ελεύθεροι. Άλλες ειδήσεις ήταν μικτές: οι δολοφονίες στη Zacapa προκάλεσαν καταδίκη από οργανώσεις ανθρωπίνων δικαιωμάτων, ενώ οι τιμές των καυσίμων υποχώρησαν και τα νέα για τα ορυχεία και την προώθηση επενδύσεων ήταν θετικά.

summary.it: Il periodo è per lo più di routine: notizie positive sullo sviluppo economico (stime di guadagni legati all'IA, il quarto anniversario di un'adesione e un programma di edilizia municipale finanziato da KfW), accanto a una vicenda in corso sulla violenza nella regione delle Savane. Il tono secondo GDELT è leggermente meno negativo della media mondiale, quindi il punteggio si colloca moderatamente al di sopra di una giornata tipica.
summary.ru: Период в целом типичный: позитивные новости об экономическом развитии (оценки возможного экономического роста благодаря ИИ, четвертая годовщина членства, программа модернизации муниципальных зданий при поддержке KfW) наряду с продолжающейся историей о насилии в регионе Савана. Тон GDELT немного менее негативен, чем в среднем по миру, поэтому показатель умеренно выше обычного дня.
summary.ar: الفترة روتينية في معظمها: تغطية إيجابية للتنمية الاقتصادية (تقديرات لمكاسب اقتصادية مرتبطة بالذكاء الاصطناعي، والذكرى الرابعة لعضوية، وبرنامج لتحديث مباني البلديات بتمويل من KfW)، إلى جانب قصة مستمرة عن العنف في منطقة سافان. نغمة GDELT أقل سلبية قليلاً من المتوسط العالمي، لذا تقع الدرجة أعلى بقدر معتدل من يوم عادي.
summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً روتین است: پوشش مثبت توسعه اقتصادی (برآوردهای دستاوردهای اقتصادی مرتبط با هوش مصنوعی، سالگرد چهارم عضویت، و برنامه نوسازی ساختمان‌های شهرداری با حمایت KfW) در کنار خبری در حال جریان درباره خشونت در منطقه ساوان. لحن GDELT کمی کمتر منفی از میانگین جهانی است، بنابراین امتیاز اندکی بالاتر از یک روز معمولی قرار دارد.
summary.zh: 本时段总体属于常规新闻：经济发展类报道较为积极（包括与人工智能相关的潜在经济增长估算、一项成员资格满四周年的纪念，以及由德国复兴信贷银行（KfW）资助的市政大楼改造计划），同时也有一则关于萨瓦讷大区暴力事件的持续报道。据GDELT测算，其语气略低于全球平均负面程度，因此得分比普通日子略高。
summary.ja: 今回の期間は概ね平常的な内容です。AIによる経済効果の試算、加盟4周年、KfW資金による市庁舎整備事業など、経済開発に関する明るい報道が中心で、一方でサバンヌ地域での暴力事件が継続して報じられています。GDELTのトーンは世界平均よりわずかに否定的でなく、スコアは通常の一日よりやや高めです。
summary.ko: 이번 기간은 대체로 일상적인 보도로 이루어져 있습니다. AI 관련 경제 효과 추정치, 가입 4주년, KfW 자금 지원 지방자치단체 청사 정비 사업 등 경제 발전에 관한 긍정적인 보도가 주를 이루는 가운데, 사바네 지역의 폭력 사태도 계속 보도되고 있습니다. GDELT 어조는 세계 평균보다 약간 덜 부정적이어서, 점수는 일반적인 하루보다 다소 높은 수준입니다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि की खबरें ज़्यादातर सामान्य हैं। इनमें AI से जुड़े संभावित आर्थिक लाभ के अनुमान, सदस्यता के चार वर्ष पूरे होने और KfW-वित्तपोषित नगरपालिका भवन आधुनिकीकरण कार्यक्रम जैसी आर्थिक विकास की सकारात्मक रिपोर्टें शामिल हैं, साथ ही सवाना क्षेत्र में जारी हिंसा की खबर भी है। GDELT का लहजा विश्व औसत से थोड़ा कम नकारात्मक है, इसलिए स्कोर एक सामान्य दिन से कुछ ऊपर है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος είναι κυρίως συνηθισμένη. Κυριαρχούν θετικές ειδήσεις για την οικονομική ανάπτυξη, όπως εκτιμήσεις για πιθανά οικονομικά οφέλη από την τεχνητή νοημοσύνη, η τετραετής επέτειος της συμμετοχής και ένα πρόγραμμα ανακαίνισης δημοτικών κτιρίων με χρηματοδότηση από την KfW, ενώ συνεχίζεται και η ιστορία της βίας στην περιοχή Savanes. Ο τόνος του GDELT είναι ελαφρώς λιγότερο αρνητικός από τον παγκόσμιο μέσο όρο, οπότε η βαθμολογία βρίσκεται μετρίως πάνω από μια τυπική ημέρα.

GDELT tonu dünya ortalamasına kıyasla biraz daha az olumsuz, dolayısıyla puan tipik bir günün biraz üzerinde.
summary.es: El periodo es en su mayoría rutinario: noticias optimistas sobre desarrollo económico (estimaciones de ganancias económicas vinculadas a la IA, un aniversario de cuatro años de pertenencia y un programa de edificios municipales financiado por KfW), junto con una historia en curso sobre la violencia en la región de Savanes. El tono de GDELT es ligeramente menos negativo que el promedio mundial, por lo que la puntuación se sitúa modestamente por encima de un día típico.

summary.pt: O período é, em grande parte, rotineiro: notícias otimistas sobre desenvolvimento econômico (estimativas de ganhos econômicos impulsionados pela IA, um aniversário de quatro anos de associação e um programa de edifícios municipais financiado pelo KfW), juntamente com uma matéria em andamento sobre violência na região de Savanes. O tom do GDELT é ligeiramente menos negativo que a média mundial, de modo que a pontuação fica modestamente acima de um dia típico.

summary.en: Mixed day in Burundi: flood displacement with reported refugee deaths and 98 university arrests weigh against a promised Qatari investment, a good maize harvest and refugee returns. Many items are routine or archival, and the negative GDELT tone is more pessimistic than the world average.
summary.tr: Burundi'de karışık bir gün: sel nedeniyle yerinden edilen aileler ve Busuma kampında bildirilen mülteci ölümleri ile üniversitede 98 kişinin gözaltına alınması, Katar yatırım vaadi, iyi mısır hasadı ve mülteci dönüşleri ile dengeleniyor. Birçok haber rutin veya arşiv niteliğinde olup, negatif GDELT tonu dünya ortalamasından daha karamsar.
summary.es: Jornada mixta en Burundi: los desplazamientos por inundaciones con muertes de refugiados reportadas y 98 arrestos en la universidad pesan frente a una promesa de inversión catarí, una buena cosecha de maíz y retornos de refugiados. Muchos artículos son rutinarios o de archivo, y el tono negativo de GDELT es más pesimista que el promedio mundial.
summary.fr: Journée contrastée au Burundi : les déplacements de population dus aux inondations, avec des décès de réfugiés signalés et 98 arrestations à l'université, pèsent face à une promesse d'investissement qatari, une bonne récolte de maïs et des retours de réfugiés. De nombreux articles sont de routine ou d'archive, et le ton négatif de GDELT est plus pessimiste que la moyenne mondiale.
summary.de: Ein gemischter Tag in Burundi: Überschwemmungsbedingte Vertreibungen mit gemeldeten Todesfällen unter Flüchtlingen und 98 Festnahmen an der Universität wiegen schwerer als eine zugesagte katarische Investition, eine gute Maisernte und Flüchtlingsrückkehr. Viele Meldungen sind Routine- oder Archivmeldungen, und der negative GDELT-Ton ist pessimistischer als der weltweite Durchschnitt.
summary.pt: Dia misto no Burundi: deslocamentos causados por inundações, com mortes de refugiados relatadas, e 98 prisões na universidade pesam mais que uma promessa de investimento do Catar, uma boa safra de milho e retornos de refugiados. Muitos itens são rotineiros ou de arquivo, e o tom negativo do GDELT é mais pessimista que a média mundial.
summary.it: Giornata mista in Burundi: gli sfollamenti causati dalle inondazioni, le morti di rifugiati segnalate e l'arresto di 98 persone all'università pesano contro una promessa di investimento qatariota, un buon raccolto di mais e i rientri di rifugiati. Molte notizie sono di routine o d'archivio, e il tono negativo di GDELT è più pessimista della media mondiale.

Многие сообщения носят рутинный или архивный характер, а отрицательный тон GDELT более пессимистичен, чем в среднем по миру.

summary.fa: روزی آمیخته در بوروندی: آوارگی خانواده‌ها بر اثر سیل و گزارش‌های مرگ پناهجویان در اردوگاه بوسوما، همراه با بازداشت ۹۸ نفر در دانشگاه، بر تعهد سرمایه‌گذاری قطر، برداشت خوب ذرت و بازگشت پناهجویان سنگینی می‌کند. بسیاری از موارد عادی یا بایگانی‌شده‌اند و لحن منفی GDELT بدبینانه‌تر از میانگین جهانی است.
summary.zh: 布隆迪的新闻喜忧参半：洪水导致民众流离失所、布苏马难民营据报有难民死亡、大学98人被捕，这些负面消息超过了卡塔尔承诺投资、玉米丰收和难民回返带来的积极面。许多报道属于例行或存档内容，GDELT的负面语气比全球平均水平更为悲观。
summary.ja: ブルンジでは複雑な一日となった。洪水による避難と、ブスマ難民キャンプでの難民死亡の報告、大学での98人の逮捕が、カタールによる投資の約束、良好なトウモロコシの収穫、難民の帰還と並んでいる。多くの記事は日常的なもの、または過去の記録であり、GDELTのトーンのマイナス値は世界平均よりも悲観的である。
summary.ko: 부룬디의 하루는 복합적이었다. 홍수로 인한 이재민 발생과 부수마 난민캠프에서 난민 사망이 보고된 사건, 대학에서 98명이 체포된 사건은 카타르의 투자 약속, 양호한 옥수수 수확, 난민 귀환과 대비된다. 많은 기사가 일상적이거나 기록성 내용이며, GDELT의 부정적 어조는 세계 평균보다 비관적이다.

Πολλά θέματα είναι ρουτινικά ή αρχειακά, και ο αρνητικός τόνος του GDELT είναι πιο απαισιόδοξος από τον παγκόσμιο μέσο όρο.
