summary.en: As winter approaches in Afghanistan, fuel prices are rising, food insecurity and child malnutrition are increasing, and the UN is warning of a humanitarian crisis. Restrictions on women and girls are being condemned by the EU, and the return of more than 1.2 million migrants is adding to the strain on the country. Limited positive signs, including railway and energy links with Central Asia, the start of a new UN representative's mandate, and a cricket victory, do not offset the humanitarian situation.

en: Fuel price increase before winter and acute food insecurity affecting approximately 40% of the population
UN and aid organization warnings of a humanitarian crisis and child malnutrition
Restrictions on women and girls and pressure on the press
Return of more than 1.2 million migrants in 9 months
Limited positive developments such as the CASA railway, the Herat railway, and the new UN representative

summary.en: The period is dominated by warnings of a deepening hunger crisis, with UN figures of up to 19.2 million facing acute food insecurity and reports of a polio resurgence. Partial offsets include a 13.4% rise in wheat output, a new railway link, and doubled transit of Afghan goods, which keep the score above the serious-problems band.

en: UN warnings of 19 million facing acute food insecurity this winter
Reports of six new polio cases, 42 in 2026
Wheat harvest up 13.4%, railway track and transit growth as positives

summary.en: The period mixes positive economic and infrastructure news (a record wheat harvest, export growth, a new railway, TAPI and power-line progress, resumed flights) with serious humanitarian signals (widespread food insecurity, rising polio cases, fuel costs, migrant deaths) and a report of militant training. Net, this is a fairly ordinary but strained day, with the negative tone of foreign coverage weighing slightly on the score.

en: Wheat harvest up 13.4% and Herat exports up 72%
Millions face acute food insecurity per UN and OCHA
New railway track and TAPI segment progress

summary.en: The period mixes routine governance, trade and aid news (cotton exports, EU humanitarian funding, a capital market meeting, prisoner returns) with ongoing strains such as six new polio cases, UN warnings over deportations, and cross-border security concerns. No single major crisis dominates, but the negative news tone is heavier than the world average, so the score sits slightly below an ordinary day.

en: Six new polio cases reported by WHO and Xinhua
UN experts warn EU against deporting Afghans
Cotton exports to Türkiye and EU humanitarian funding

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: infrastructure and trade deals (a China freight rail route, a 800 MW Turkmenistan power line, a gold mining project) sit alongside a continuing Pakistan trade halt, rising polio cases and Pakistan-Afghanistan tensions. GDELT tone is more negative than the world average, but the headlines describe no acute crisis, so the score stays near the ordinary baseline.

en: Pakistan-Afghanistan trade halt and border closure continue
China freight train route and Turkmenistan 800 MW power line
Gold mining project launch and cricket tri-series win

summary.en: The day mixed routine positives (cricket rankings, Iran easing export barriers, a mining contract, hospital construction, a new TV channel) with real strains: escalating accusations with Pakistan over militancy, mass deportations, a worsening water crisis and rising polio cases. GDELT tone is markedly more negative than the world average, so the score sits slightly below an ordinary day.

en: Pakistan-Afghanistan accusations over militants and alleged arming of fighters
Pakistan arrests of 517 Afghans in one week
UNICEF warns water crisis worsening; polio cases reach 42

summary.en: The period mixes ongoing cross-border hostilities with Pakistan, reports of humanitarian aid restrictions and hunger, and an earthquake and road accident. Modest positives include a new gold mine, gas pipeline talks and a record ILT20 auction, while GDELT tone is clearly negative.

en: Pakistan-Afghanistan cross-border attacks and warnings of action
UN-reported restrictions on humanitarian aid and female aid workers
Reports of poverty and hunger, with daily-life hardship

summary.en: The period is dominated by the Pakistan-Afghanistan dispute, with mutual accusations over strikes and claimed civilian casualties, plus deportations and harassment of returnees. Some economic and humanitarian steps, such as easing bank account restrictions, a water supply deal and a UNDP recovery programme, partly offset this.

en: Pakistan-Afghanistan dispute over strikes and 1,119 claimed civilian casualties
US plan to deport Afghan migrants to Pakistan; returnee police harassment reports
Central bank says account restrictions will be lifted by year-end

summary.en: Cross-border clashes with Pakistan, including shelling that killed one person, dominate the period alongside renewed restrictions on women and a strained economy hit by mass returns and falling exports. Modest positives include a central bank pledge to lift banking limits, Kuwaiti humanitarian aid and UNDP cooperation talks.

en: Heavy clashes and shelling on the Pakistan border, one killed
Mass refugee returns straining the economy; exports down over $125M
New Taliban restrictions on women and firearm permits draw international criticism

summary.en: Afghanistan's period was dominated by renewed cross-border clashes with Pakistan, including drone strikes, retaliatory attacks and civilian deaths. Alongside this, a UN-reported surge in poppy cultivation, deportations and restrictions on girls' education point to serious strain, partly offset by routine trade, mining and infrastructure news.

en: Pakistan-Afghanistan border clashes and drone strikes with fatalities
UN reports poppy cultivation surging despite Taliban ban
Deportations of Afghans from Germany, Turkey and Iran/Pakistan

summary.en: Cross-border fighting with Pakistan resumed, with civilians and children reported killed, alongside a UNODC report of a sharp rise in opium production and UN warnings on Taliban oppression. Positive items, including a cricket record, a mining expo, hospital construction and water projects, are routine and do not offset the security escalation.

en: Renewed Pakistan-Afghanistan cross-border clashes with civilian and child deaths
UNODC report of sharply rising opium poppy production
UN warnings on Taliban oppression and youth extremism risk

summary.en: Fighting near the Torkham border crossing threatens civilians and returning refugees, and US deportation plans and a reported fivefold rise in opium production add to the strain. Positive routine items (polio campaign, first cement plant, mining expo, cricket win) and a sharply negative press tone leave the score in the serious-problems range rather than the lowest band.

en: Clashes at Torkham border threaten civilians and returning refugees
Reported fivefold year-on-year rise in opium production
US plans to deport Afghans, including relatives of US allies

summary.en: Afghanistan's news over the period centres on strained relations with Pakistan, US plans to deport about 150 Afghans, continued mass returns, a market fire destroying over 200 shops, rising food prices and a fatal unexploded-ordnance blast. Modest positives include mining MoUs, health cooperation with Kazakhstan, and sports wins, and the GDELT tone is markedly negative.

en: Pakistan-Taliban dialogue rejected amid escalating bilateral tensions
US plans to deport about 150 Afghans via Pakistan
Fire destroys over 200 shops at Mazar-e-Sharif market

summary.en: Armed clashes with Pakistan persisted along the border, with Pakistan warning of 'unbearable punishment', alongside US deportation plans and reports of Taliban house demolitions. Diplomatic steps (ambassador credentials, Turkish consular services) and sporting wins offer some balance, but the security and humanitarian signals dominate.

en: Ongoing Pakistan-Afghanistan border clashes and punitive threats
US plans to deport Afghans via Pakistan; forced returns
Reported demolition of village homes in Sar-e Pol

summary.en: The period mixes routine positives, including a record ICC ODI ranking, a nationwide polio campaign, drug-lab destruction and a Belarus ambassador exchange, with concerns over US deportation plans, dengue deaths, drought-driven child marriage and pressure on journalists. Overall it reads as an ordinary day with a slightly negative tone, so the score sits just above the neutral baseline.

en: Record sixth-place ICC ODI team ranking, reported across several outlets
Nationwide polio vaccination campaign launched for 12.8 million children
Concern over US plan to deport Afghans via Pakistan

summary.en: The period mixes routine diplomacy and trade (Russia, Iran, Kyrgyzstan), a new water network and a plant opening, and a US court temporarily blocking deportations. Against this are OCHA warnings of rising hunger in Kandahar, Afghanistan-Pakistan tensions, and claims of armed attacks by anti-Taliban groups, with a markedly negative news tone.

en: US court temporarily blocks deportation of detained Afghans
OCHA warns of rising hunger and malnutrition in Kandahar
Afghanistan-Pakistan tensions threaten regional trade ambitions

summary.en: The period mixes positive developments, including the release of 416 Afghans from Pakistani prisons, a $275 million gas deal, and several economic agreements, with ongoing humanitarian strain such as malnutrition pressure in the south and fatal road accidents. GDELT tone is clearly negative, but the domestic headlines point to a routine-to-modestly-positive day.

en: 416 Afghans released from Pakistani prisons and returned home
$275 million natural gas and coal deals signed in Jawzjan
Hospitals in the south report severe malnutrition pressure

summary.en: The period mixes economic and diplomatic positives, such as doubled rail freight, a 416-prisoner release and gold contracts, with serious humanitarian and rights concerns, including mass deportations, Iranian executions of Afghans, continued restrictions on women and a school-exclusion report. The negative GDELT tone is notably worse than the world average, so the net reading sits slightly below an ordinary day.
summary.it: Il periodo combina elementi positivi sul piano economico e diplomatico, come il raddoppio del trasporto merci ferroviario, la liberazione di 416 detenuti e contratti per l'oro, con gravi preoccupazioni umanitarie e per i diritti, tra cui deportazioni di massa, esecuzioni di afghani da parte dell'Iran, persistenti restrizioni nei confronti delle donne e un rapporto sull'esclusione scolastica. Il tono negativo di GDELT è sensibilmente peggiore della media mondiale, pertanto la valutazione complessiva si colloca leggermente al di sotto di una giornata ordinaria.
summary.ru: Период сочетает экономические и дипломатические позитивные моменты, такие как более чем двукратный рост грузоперевозок по железной дороге, освобождение 416 заключённых и золотые контракты, с серьёзными гуманитарными проблемами и вопросами в области прав человека, включая массовые депортации, казни афганцев в Иране, сохраняющиеся ограничения в отношении женщин и доклад об исключении из школ. Негативная тональность GDELT заметно хуже среднемировой, поэтому общая оценка немного ниже, чем в обычный день.
summary.ar: تجمع الفترة بين إيجابيات اقتصادية ودبلوماسية، مثل تضاعف الشحن بالسكك الحديدية وإطلاق سراح 416 سجيناً وعقود للذهب، وبين مخاوف إنسانية وحقوقية خطيرة، تشمل عمليات ترحيل جماعي وإعدامات نفذتها إيران بحق أفغان، واستمرار القيود المفروضة على النساء وتقرير عن استبعاد من المدارس. والنبرة السلبية في GDELT أسوأ بوضوح من المتوسط العالمي، لذا فإن القراءة الصافية أدنى قليلاً من يوم عادي.
summary.fa: این دوره ترکیبی از نکات مثبت اقتصادی و دیپلماتیک، مانند افزایش بیش از دو برابری حمل‌ونقل ریلی بار، آزادی 416 زندانی و قراردادهای طلا، با نگرانی‌های جدی بشردوستانه و حقوق بشری است؛ از جمله اخراج‌های دسته‌جمعی، اعدام اتباع افغان توسط ایران، ادامه محدودیت‌ها برای زنان و گزارشی درباره محرومیت از تحصیل. لحن منفی GDELT به‌طور قابل‌توجهی بدتر از میانگین جهانی است، بنابراین برداشت کلی کمی پایین‌تر از یک روز عادی قرار می‌گیرد.
summary.zh: 该时期既有经济和外交方面的积极因素，例如铁路货运量翻倍、释放416名囚犯以及黄金合同，也存在严重的人道主义和人权问题，包括大规模驱逐出境、伊朗处决阿富汗人、对妇女的持续限制以及一份关于学校排斥的报告。GDELT的负面语气明显差于全球平均水平，因此综合来看略低于普通的一天。
summary.tr: Dönem, iki katına çıkan demiryolu yük taşımacılığı, 416 mahkûmun serbest bırakılması ve altın sözleşmeleri gibi ekonomik ve diplomatik olumlu gelişmelerle; toplu sınır dışı etmeler, İran'ın Afgan vatandaşları idam etmesi, kadınlara yönelik kısıtlamaların sürmesi ve bir okul dışılık raporu dahil ciddi insani ve hak kaygılarını bir arada içeriyor. GDELT'in negatif tonu dünya ortalamasının belirgin biçimde altında olup, genel değerlendirme sıradan bir günün biraz altında kalıyor.
summary.es: El período combina aspectos económicos y diplomáticos positivos, como la duplicación del transporte ferroviario de mercancías, la liberación de 416 presos y contratos de oro, con serias preocupaciones humanitarias y de derechos, incluidas deportaciones masivas, ejecuciones de afganos en Irán, restricciones continuas a las mujeres y un informe sobre la exclusión escolar. El tono negativo de GDELT es notablemente peor que el promedio mundial, por lo que la lectura neta se sitúa ligeramente por debajo de un día ordinario.
summary.fr: La période mêle des éléments positifs sur les plans économique et diplomatique, comme le doublement du fret ferroviaire, la libération de 416 prisonniers et des contrats d'or, à de graves préoccupations humanitaires et en matière de droits, notamment les expulsions massives, les exécutions d'Afghans par l'Iran, les restrictions persistantes imposées aux femmes et un rapport sur l'exclusion scolaire. Le ton négatif de GDELT est nettement plus sombre que la moyenne mondiale, de sorte que la lecture nette se situe légèrement en deçà d'une journée ordinaire.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum verbindet wirtschaftliche und diplomatische Pluspunkte, etwa die Verdopplung des Schienengüterverkehrs, die Freilassung von 416 Gefangenen und Goldverträge, mit ernsten humanitären und menschenrechtlichen Bedenken, darunter Massenabschiebungen, iranische Hinrichtungen afghanischer Staatsangehöriger, fortbestehende Einschränkungen für Frauen und ein Bericht über den Schulausschluss. Der negative GDELT-Tonwert liegt deutlich unter dem weltweiten Durchschnitt, sodass die Gesamtbewertung leicht unter einem gewöhnlichen Tag liegt.
summary.pt: O período combina aspectos econômicos e diplomáticos positivos, como a duplicação do transporte ferroviário de carga, a libertação de 416 prisioneiros e contratos de ouro, com sérias preocupações humanitárias e de direitos, incluindo deportações em massa, execuções de afegãos pelo Irã, restrições contínuas às mulheres e um relatório sobre exclusão escolar. O tom negativo do GDELT é notavelmente pior que a média mundial, por isso a leitura líquida fica ligeiramente abaixo de um dia comum.
summary.ja: この期間は、貨物鉄道輸送の倍増、416人の囚人の釈放、金取引の契約など、経済面と外交面で前向きな動きがある一方、大量国外追放、イランによるアフガニスタン人の処刑、女性への継続的な制限、学校からの排除に関する報告など、深刻な人道・人権上の懸念も含まれている。GDELTのネガティブなトーンは世界平均よりも顕著に悪く、総合的な評価は通常の一日をわずかに下回る水準にある。
summary.ko: 이번 기간에는 철도 화물 운송량의 두 배 이상 증가, 416명의 수감자 석방, 금 거래 계약 등 경제적·외교적 긍정적 사안이 있었던 반면, 대규모 강제 추방, 이란의 아프간인 처형, 여성에 대한 지속적인 제한, 학교 배제 관련 보고서 등 심각한 인도적·인권적 우려도 함께 나타났습니다. GDELT의 부정적 어조는 세계 평균보다 현저히 나빠, 종합적인 평가는 일상적인 하루보다 약간 낮은 수준입니다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में आर्थिक और कूटनीतिक सकारात्मक घटनाएँ भी हैं, जैसे रेल माल ढुलाई का दोगुने से अधिक होना, 416 कैदियों की रिहाई और सोने के अनुबंध, साथ ही गंभीर मानवीय और अधिकार संबंधी चिंताएँ भी हैं, जिनमें सामूहिक निर्वासन, ईरान द्वारा अफ़गानों को फाँसी, महिलाओं पर लगातार प्रतिबंध और स्कूलों से बहिष्कार की एक रिपोर्ट शामिल हैं। GDELT का नकारात्मक स्वर विश्व औसत से उल्लेखनीय रूप से खराब है, इसलिए कुल मिलाकर तस्वीर एक सामान्य दिन से थोड़ी नीचे है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος συνδυάζει οικονομικές και διπλωματικές θετικές εξελίξεις, όπως η διπλασιασμένη σιδηροδρομική μεταφορά εμπορευμάτων, η απελευθέρωση 416 κρατουμένων και συμβάσεις για χρυσό, με σοβαρές ανθρωπιστικές και ανησυχίες για τα δικαιώματα, μεταξύ των οποίων μαζικές απελάσεις, εκτελέσεις Αφγανών από το Ιράν, συνεχιζόμενοι περιορισμοί για τις γυναίκες και έκθεση για αποκλεισμό από το σχολείο. Ο αρνητικός τόνος του GDELT είναι αισθητά χειρότερος από τον παγκόσμιο μέσο όρο, επομένως η συνολική εικόνα βρίσκεται ελαφρώς κάτω από μια συνηθισμένη ημέρα.

summary.en: The period in Vietnam is calm and routine; news flow is dominated by diplomacy, trade, preparations for a defense fair, and tourism. Air pollution in Hanoi, a suspected gas leak that sent more than 40 people to hospital, and the outflow of foreign portfolio investors are minor negatives but not at crisis level. A new trade agreement with the EU, coffee prices at a peak, and foreign investment interest are having a slightly positive effect.

en: A new trade agreement with the EU and expanding bilateral relations with France, Liechtenstein and Laos
Coffee prices near their peak and rising foreign direct investment
Deterioration of air quality in Hanoi and more than 40 people hospitalized due to a suspected gas leak
Foreign portfolio investors withdrawing from the stock market
The human rights issue being raised by the EU

summary.en: The period is dominated by routine diplomacy, trade and tourism news, including a first-ever chicken-product export and preparations to host APEC 2027. Negatives are limited to reports criticising the suppression of independent trade unions and worsening air quality, which keep the score close to, but above, an ordinary day.

en: First export of processed chicken products to Vietnam market
Preparations for hosting APEC 2027 and strategic partnership diplomacy
Reports criticising suppression of independent trade unions

summary.en: The period is dominated by positive diplomatic and economic news: deepening EU and Denmark, Japan and Belgium ties, rising rice and spice exports, new flight routes, and foreign investment commitments. Offsetting concerns include a Human Rights Watch report on suppressed independent unions, emergency motorbike restrictions over severe air pollution, and mangrove threats from coastal construction.

en: Expanding EU, Denmark, Japan and Belgium cooperation and investment
Export growth in spices and rice, plus new flight routes
HRW report on suppressed independent trade unions

summary.en: The period is dominated by positive diplomatic and economic news: a state visit to a major European port, deeper EU strategic ties, new metro lines, and airline and business awards. Negatives are limited to a data leak, mangrove threats from coastal construction, and rights groups urging scrutiny of EU ties, which are routine concerns rather than a crisis.

en: State visit to Antwerp-Bruges and deeper EU strategic partnership
Metro line openings and urban redevelopment projects in Hanoi
Data leak exposing airline passenger records, a notable negative

summary.en: The period is dominated by routine but constructive government diplomacy, including the EFTA trade agreement, technology and logistics cooperation talks with Belgium, and UN engagement on green economy. Economic signals are upbeat, with a GDP growth forecast of up to 9.7% and a government pledge of uninterrupted power supply, though the GDP forecast is qualified by experts' concerns.

en: Vietnam-EFTA trade agreement framed as an opportunity for sustainable growth
Party leader's Belgium visit and cooperation deals in technology and logistics
GDP growth forecast up to 9.7% with expert caution on capital shortfalls

summary.en: The period was mostly routine to positive: a large cultural event drew tens of thousands of fans, foreign firms and airlines expanded hiring and routes, and a GDP growth forecast of up to 9.7% was reported. The only clearly negative items were a vaguely described explosion headline and a school violence story, with no details to weigh heavily.

en: BigBang concert draws tens of thousands of fans in Hanoi
Lotte hiring fair draws about 3,000 students from top universities
GDP growth forecast of up to 9.7% reported

summary.en: The period is mostly positive, led by a Polish PM visit that produced a strategic partnership, new direct flights and expanded diplomatic ties, plus new air routes and foreign investment items. Offsetting concerns include a chip plant that may miss its 2027 target, a weak property market, and a routine raid on illegal foreign workers.

en: Polish PM visit yields strategic partnership, direct flights, visa easing
New VietJet and Emirates routes and Lotte hiring signal investment
Chip plant likely to miss 2027 target, no ASML deal yet

summary.en: The period is dominated by routine governance and business news, plus a positive diplomatic highlight: Polish PM Tusk's visit concluded with a strategic partnership and expanded cooperation. Economic and development items (renewable energy export approval, AI water treatment tech export, MRI installation, social support funds) are constructive, while the chip plant delay is a minor negative.

en: Poland-Vietnam visit concluded with strategic partnership and expanded cooperation
Singapore conditionally approves renewable energy export project from Vietnam
Hanoi social support fund of over 77 billion dong for the poor

summary.en: The period was clearly positive, dominated by the Prime Minister's engagement with the World Economic Forum on investment and tech cooperation, plus new foreign investment deals and a more liberal investment-law draft. Minor negatives, such as the stalled chip plant and a Hanoi housing reform still under review, did not outweigh the positive flow.

en: PM Lê Minh Hưng's WEF engagements and calls for deeper investment partnership
Keppel's US$1bn Vietnam investment push and Konoike cold-storage plan
Draft investment-law amendment expanding foreign market access

summary.en: The period is dominated by routine business, culture and sports coverage, with several clearly positive items: Vietnam joining the Artemis Accords, a Michelin key for a Vietnamese-run hotel, new foreign investment and partnership announcements, and GDELT tone well above the world average. No crisis or unrest appears in the headlines.

en: Vietnam joins the Artemis Accords as a new signatory
Mia Saigon awarded a MICHELIN Key, reported in several outlets
JCB, CMA CGM and Turkish Airlines investment and route expansion news

summary.en: The period is dominated by routine positive news: Hanoi joining a UNESCO creative cities network, a planned high-level Laos parliamentary visit, progress on semiconductor training, and state enterprise restructuring. Tourism, investment and cultural items add to a mildly upbeat picture, and the GDELT tone is clearly positive.

en: Hanoi joins UNESCO Creative Cities Network
Semiconductor engineer training progress described as encouraging
Laos parliamentary chair to make official visit

summary.en: A largely routine day with clearly positive economic signals, including trade passing $1 trillion in the first ten months and an IMF projection of rising GDP per capita. Diplomatic engagement and achievements in education and sport add to the upbeat tone, while air pollution and an academic fraud case are minor negatives.

en: Trade surpassed $1 trillion in first ten months
IMF projects GDP per capita overtaking Indonesia in 2026
Diplomatic visits and parliamentary ties with Belarus and others

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: cultural and sporting events, tourism and EV launches, and a new resort opening. Positive signals (a revived Hanoi-Vung Tau high-speed rail bid, strong GDELT tone) are offset by a government inspection finding violations at Hanoi National University schools and a report of cancelled high-speed rail tender sections.

en: Revived Vietnam north-south high-speed rail bid reported by Korean media
Government inspection finds violations at eight Hanoi National University schools
Two core high-speed rail tender sections cancelled, per Chinese-language report

summary.en: The period is dominated by positive economic and diplomatic news: strong growth signals such as 44% e-commerce growth and 41% Vietjet revenue rise, the upcoming Long Thanh airport opening, and deepening defence and parliamentary ties with India. The main negative item is the US intellectual-property tariff probe, where Tesla and Samsung oppose new duties, but it is a trade-policy risk rather than a crisis.

en: Vietjet 9-month revenue up 41% with expanded international links
Vietnam e-commerce grew 44% in 2026 per report
Long Thanh airport set to open Dec 24

summary.en: The period was broadly positive, led by strong trade data (exports past $100 billion in 10 months, a record October surplus) and a high-profile India-Vietnam strategic partnership visit. Offsetting concerns were a worker-layoff case from the ECCO company's dissolution and US tariff pressure, so the score sits in the clearly positive band rather than the exceptional one.

en: Record October trade surplus and exports surpassing $100 billion after 10 months
Indian NSA visit deepening the Enhanced Comprehensive Strategic Partnership and defence ties
FPT semiconductor testing plant starting trial operations in Bac Ninh

summary.en: Coverage over the last 24 hours is dominated by routine but positive business, technology and diplomatic news: chip plant trial operations, Viettel and FPT tech launches, WTO support statements and foreign partnerships. Negative items such as villa construction violations and the Hanoi Hoan Kiem redevelopment debate are ordinary policy disputes, and GDELT tone is mildly positive.

en: FPT chip testing plant begins trial operations in Bac Ninh
Viettel and FPT unveil domestic chip and security capabilities
Vietnam reaffirms WTO-centred multilateral trade stance

summary.en: A routine-to-positive day dominated by economic milestones (a reported USD 49 billion benchmark), a new domestic semiconductor/secure-chip milestone, national unity celebrations, and continued party personnel and institutional decisions. Negative items are limited to traffic congestion and a drug-trafficking bust, which are ordinary issues; GDELT tone is mildly positive.

en: Reported USD 49 billion economic milestone, regional leadership claim
Domestic secure chip and semiconductor advance covered by foreign press
National Great Unity Day celebrations led by top leader

summary.en: The period is dominated by routine cultural, religious and economic news: festivals, a marathon, the Buddhist Church's 45th anniversary, and new cooperation deals with Japan, NCCN and others. A fatal school fire in Hanoi, which killed a Grade 6 pupil, is the main negative item, but it is a single local incident.
summary.tr: Bu dönemde rutin kültürel, dini ve ekonomik haberler öne çıkıyor: festivaller, bir maraton, Budist Kilisesi'nin 45. yıl dönümü ve Japonya, NCCN ile diğerleri arasında yeni iş birliği anlaşmaları. Hanoi'de bir 6. sınıf öğrencisinin ölümüne yol açan okul yangını ana olumsuz haber, ancak tek bir yerel olay.
summary.es: El período está dominado por noticias rutinarias de cultura, religión y economía: festivales, un maratón, el 45.º aniversario de la Iglesia Budista y nuevos acuerdos de cooperación con Japón, NCCN y otros. Un incendio mortal en una escuela de Hanói, en el que murió un alumno de sexto grado, es el principal hecho negativo, pero se trata de un incidente local único.
summary.fr: La période est dominée par des actualités courantes d'ordre culturel, religieux et économique : festivals, un marathon, le 45e anniversaire de l'Église bouddhique, ainsi que de nouveaux accords de coopération avec le Japon, NCCN et d'autres partenaires. Un incendie mortel dans un lycée de Hanoï, qui a coûté la vie à un élève de sixième, constitue le principal fait négatif, mais il s'agit d'un incident local isolé.
summary.de: Der Berichtszeitraum wird von routinemäßigen Kultur-, Religions- und Wirtschaftsnachrichten geprägt: Festivals, ein Marathon, der 45. Jahrestag der Buddhistischen Kirche sowie neue Kooperationsabkommen mit Japan, NCCN und anderen. Ein tödlicher Schulbrand in Hanoi, bei dem ein Schüler der 6. Klasse ums Leben kam, ist die wichtigste negative Meldung, doch handelt es sich um einen einzelnen lokalen Vorfall.
summary.pt: O período é dominado por notícias rotineiras de cultura, religião e economia: festivais, uma maratona, o 45.º aniversário da Igreja Budista e novos acordos de cooperação com o Japão, a NCCN e outros. Um incêndio fatal numa escola em Hanói, que matou um aluno do 6.º ano, é o principal fato negativo, mas trata-se de um incidente local isolado.
summary.ja: この期間は、祭り、マラソン、仏教教会の創立45周年、日本やNCCNなどとの新たな協力合意といった、日常的な文化・宗教・経済のニュースが中心となっています。ハノイの学校での火災により6年生の生徒が死亡したことが、主なネガティブな出来事ですが、これは地域における単一の事故です。
summary.ko: 이번 기간에는 축제, 마라톤, 불교 교회 창립 45주년, 일본 및 NCCN 등과의 새로운 협력 협정 등 일상적인 문화, 종교, 경제 뉴스가 주를 이룹니다. 하노이의 한 학교에서 발생한 화재로 6학년 학생이 사망한 사건이 주요 부정적 소식이지만, 이는 지역 내 단일 사고입니다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में नियमित सांस्कृतिक, धार्मिक और आर्थिक समाचारों का प्रभुत्व है: त्योहार, एक मैराथन, बौद्ध चर्च की 45वीं वर्षगांठ, और जापान, NCCN और अन्य के साथ नए सहयोग समझौते। हनोई में एक स्कूल में घातक आग, जिसमें कक्षा 6 के एक छात्र की मृत्यु हुई, मुख्य नकारात्मक समाचार है, लेकिन यह एक एकल स्थानीय घटना है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος κυριαρχείται από ρουτινιακές πολιτιστικές, θρησκευτικές και οικονομικές ειδήσεις: φεστιβάλ, έναν μαραθώνιο, την 45η επέτειο της Βουδιστικής Εκκλησίας και νέες συμφωνίες συνεργασίας με την Ιαπωνία, το NCCN και άλλους. Μια θανατηφόρα πυρκαγιά σε σχολείο στο Ανόι, που σκότωσε έναν μαθητή της Στ' Δημοτικού, αποτελεί το κύριο αρνητικό γεγονός, ωστόσο πρόκειται για ένα μεμονωμένο τοπικό περιστατικό.
summary.it: Il periodo è dominato da notizie culturali, religiose ed economiche di routine: festival, una maratona, il 45° anniversario della Chiesa buddhista e nuovi accordi di cooperazione con il Giappone, NCCN e altri. Un incendio mortale in una scuola di Hanoi, in cui è morto un alunno della sesta classe, è la principale notizia negativa, ma si tratta di un singolo episodio locale.
summary.ru: Период определяют рутинные культурные, религиозные и экономические новости: фестивали, марафон, 45-летие Буддийской церкви и новые соглашения о сотрудничестве с Японией, NCCN и другими. Главной негативной новостью стал смертельный пожар в школе Ханоя, в котором погиб ученик 6-го класса, но это единичный местный инцидент.
summary.ar: تهيمن على هذه الفترة أخبار ثقافية ودينية واقتصادية روتينية: مهرجانات، وماراثون، والذكرى الخامسة والأربعون لتأسيس الكنيسة البوذية، واتفاقيات تعاون جديدة مع اليابان و NCCN وغيرهما. ويُعد حريق مدرسة في هانوي أودى بحياة تلميذ في الصف السادس أبرز الأخبار السلبية، لكنه حادث محلي واحد.
summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً اخبار فرهنگی، مذهبی و اقتصادی معمول را در بر می‌گیرد: جشنواره‌ها، یک ماراتن، چهل و پنجمین سالگرد کلیسای بودایی، و توافق‌های همکاری جدید با ژاپن، NCCN و دیگران. آتش‌سوزی مرگبار در یک مدرسه در هانوی که منجر به مرگ یک دانش‌آموز پایه ششم شد، مهم‌ترین خبر منفی است، اما این یک حادثه محلی منفرد است.
summary.zh: 本时段的新闻以例行的文化、宗教和经济内容为主：节庆活动、一场马拉松、佛教会成立45周年，以及与日本、NCCN等达成的新合作协议。河内一所学校发生火灾致一名六年级学生死亡，这是最主要的负面新闻，但仅是一起孤立的地方事件。

en: Positive economic and cooperation news: Japan investment ties, NCCN cancer-care expansion
Routine cultural and civic events: Hanoi food festival, Culture Day, marathon
Fatal fire at a Hanoi secondary school, a single local tragedy

Rutin kültürel ve toplumsal etkinlikler: Hanoi yemek festivali, Kültür Günü, maraton

Événements culturels et civiques courants : festival gastronomique de Hanoï, Journée de la culture, marathon

summary.en: There is no clear crisis in Austria. The news agenda includes a bomb threat against an AUA flight (it turned out to be a false alarm), the closure of the Ardo factory, an upcoming severe weather event and a slight drop on the stock market. On the other hand, positive news such as fiber infrastructure investment, a record number of entrepreneurs and Vienna's success in public transport offset this, so the period is considered normal.

en: Bomb threat against the AUA Tel Aviv–Vienna flight; the plane landed in Bulgaria, then the alarm was lifted
Closure of Ardo and farmers halting spinach planting
Weather change warning bringing snow, storms and icing
About 5.6% decline in the ATX over the last month
225 million euro fiber investment, record number of entrepreneurs and Vienna's public transport success

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: national holiday traffic warnings, rising Klimaticket and e-car registration records, and a new head for the Haus der Geschichte. Negatives are minor, including an ATM bombing near Bratislava, a life sentence for a murder, weather disruption, and the ATX down 5.65% over the month, though it rose 0.89% on the day.

en: Burgenland record share of new private e-car registrations
Klimaticket annual pass holders rising sharply
ATX up 0.89% on the day, though down over the month

summary.en: The period is mostly routine, with several positive items: a reported release of an Austrian hostage held in Niger for 21 months, a Q3 revenue rise of 11.2% at Steyr Motors, and a record founding rate in Vienna. These are offset by the ATX falling 2.3% on the day and 7.3% over the month, plus the Ardo closure affecting Marchfeld jobs.

en: Austrian woman reportedly freed after 21 months in Niger captivity
Steyr Motors Q3 revenue up 11.2%, guidance confirmed
ATX down 2.32% on the day and 7.32% over the month

summary.en: The period is mostly routine news: holiday travel, national-day debates and local stories. Mixed signals include thousands protesting education budget cuts, a sharp drop in hydro power output, and a 9% monthly fall in the ATX, offset by record-low asylum applications and household financial wealth reaching a record high.

en: Thousands protest in Vienna over education budget cuts
ATX down 9.3% over one month
Lowest asylum applications and record deportations reported

summary.en: A largely routine news day in Austria: the expulsion of four Russian diplomats over espionage suspicions and student protests against university budget cuts are the main negative items. The ATX is down 4.4% over the week and 9.2% over the month, while the day's move was flat.

en: Expulsion of four Russian diplomats over espionage suspicions
Protests against planned university budget cuts in Vienna
ATX down 9.2% over the month, 4.4% over the week

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: sports wins, tourism and infrastructure investment, and everyday local news. Negative items include a sharp rise in security-service cases of Islamist offences, the expulsion of four Russian diplomats for espionage, and a month-long fall in the ATX, which together keep the score at a neutral level.

en: Staatsschutz figures show a 117% rise in Islamist offences
Austria expels four Russian diplomats over alleged espionage
Moltzan wins Sölden giant slalom, a positive sporting story

summary.en: The period is largely routine, with national-holiday coverage, tourism growth and ordinary politics. Tone is slightly less negative than the world average, but the ATX fell about 9% over the month and the EU budget veto dispute adds some tension.

en: ATX down 4.38% over the week and 9.24% over the month
Chancellor Stocker threatens veto over EU budget 2028-2034
Health system strain reported; tourism overnight stays up in Erzberg-Leoben

summary.en: The period is dominated by routine news: National Day commemorations, local events, lifestyle and weather stories. The ATX rose 1.19% on the day, though it is down 8.6% over the month, and the EU budget veto threat is a political friction point rather than a crisis.

en: ATX up 1.19% on the day, but down 8.62% over one month

summary.hi: यह अवधि सामान्य और हल्के सकारात्मक स्वर वाली है, जिसमें बेलारूस, तातारस्तान और वियतनाम के साथ कूटनीतिक एवं निवेश यात्राएँ, मैरियट होटल का शुभारंभ और रेल संपर्क परियोजना में प्रगति प्रमुख हैं। इस परिदृश्य में मेकांग में सोने की खान से जहरीले कचरे की आशंकाएँ और नशीले पदार्थों की जब्ती जैसी चिंताएँ मामूली हैं, और GDELT का स्वर सकारात्मक है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος είναι συνηθισμένη και ήπια θετική, με κυρίαρχες τις διπλωματικές και επενδυτικές επισκέψεις (Λευκορωσία, Ταταρστάν, Βιετνάμ), το άνοιγμα ξενοδοχείου της Marriott και την πρόοδο της σιδηροδρομικής σύνδεσης. Οι ανησυχίες για τα τοξικά απόβλητα του χρυσωρυχείου στον Μεκόγκ και η κατάσχεση ναρκωτικών είναι δευτερεύουσες σε αυτό το πλαίσιο, ενώ ο τόνος του GDELT είναι θετικός.
summary.it: Il periodo è di routine e moderatamente positivo, dominato da visite diplomatiche e di investimento (Bielorussia, Tatarstan, Vietnam), dall'apertura di un hotel Marriott e dai progressi del collegamento ferroviario. Le preoccupazioni, come i timori di rifiuti tossici da una miniera d'oro sul Mekong e un sequestro di droga, sono di minore entità in questo contesto, e il tono di GDELT è positivo.
summary.ru: Период носит рутинный и умеренно позитивный характер: его определяют дипломатические и инвестиционные визиты (Беларусь, Татарстан, Вьетнам), открытие отеля Marriott и продвижение железнодорожного сообщения. На этом фоне такие проблемы, как опасения по поводу токсичных отходов золотодобывающего рудника на Меконге и изъятие наркотиков, второстепенны; тон GDELT позитивный.
summary.ar: الفترة روتينية وإيجابية بقدر معتدل، وتهيمن عليها زيارات دبلوماسية واستثمارية (بيلاروس، وتتارستان، وفيتنام)، وافتتاح فندق ماريوت، والتقدم في مشروع ربط السكك الحديدية. وتبدو المخاوف، مثل مخاوف النفايات السامة من منجم ذهب على نهر الميكونغ ومصادرة مخدرات، ثانوية في هذا السياق، ونبرة GDELT إيجابية.
summary.fa: این دوره عادی و تا حدی مثبت است و دیدارهای دیپلماتیک و سرمایه‌گذاری (بلاروس، تاتارستان، ویتنام)، افتتاح هتل ماریوت و پیشرفت پروژه پیوند ریلی بر آن غالب‌اند. نگرانی‌ها، از جمله ترس از زباله‌های سمی معدن طلا در رودخانه مکونگ و توقیف مواد مخدر، در این زمینه جزئی‌اند و لحن GDELT مثبت است.
summary.zh: 该时期属于例行且略为积极的态势，主要由外交和投资访问（白俄罗斯、鞑靼斯坦、越南）、万豪酒店开业以及铁路联通项目的进展所主导。在此背景下，湄公河金矿有毒废料担忧和一起毒品查获等问题影响较小，GDELT 语气为正面。
summary.tr: Dönem rutin ve hafif olumlu seyrediyor; Belarus, Tataristan ve Vietnam ile diplomatik ve yatırım ziyaretleri, bir Marriott otelinin açılışı ve demiryolu bağlantısındaki ilerleme öne çıkıyor. Mekong'daki altın madeninin toksik atık kaygıları ve bir uyuşturucu operasyonu bu tablo karşısında küçük kalıyor ve GDELT tonu olumlu.
summary.es: El periodo es rutinario y levemente positivo, dominado por visitas diplomáticas y de inversión (Bielorrusia, Tartaristán y Vietnam), la apertura de un hotel Marriott y avances en el enlace ferroviario. Las preocupaciones, como los temores por residuos tóxicos de una mina de oro en el Mekong y una incautación de drogas, son menores en este contexto, y el tono de GDELT es positivo.
summary.fr: La période est routinière et légèrement positive, dominée par des visites diplomatiques et d'investissement (Biélorussie, Tatarstan et Viêt Nam), l'ouverture d'un hôtel Marriott et les progrès de la liaison ferroviaire. Les inquiétudes, comme les craintes de déchets toxiques liés à une mine d'or du Mékong ou une saisie de drogue, sont mineures dans ce contexte, et le ton de GDELT est positif.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum verläuft routinemäßig und leicht positiv, geprägt von diplomatischen Besuchen und Investitionsgesprächen (Belarus, Tatarstan und Vietnam), der Eröffnung eines Marriott-Hotels und Fortschritten bei der Bahnverbindung. Bedenken wie Befürchtungen über giftige Abfälle einer Goldmine am Mekong oder eine Drogenbeschlagnahmung fallen vor diesem Hintergrund gering aus, und der GDELT-Tonfall ist positiv.
summary.pt: O período é rotineiro e levemente positivo, dominado por visitas diplomáticas e de investimento (Bielorrússia, Tartaristão e Vietnã), a abertura de um hotel Marriott e avanços na ligação ferroviária. Preocupações como os receios de resíduos tóxicos de uma mina de ouro no Mekong e uma apreensão de drogas são menores neste contexto, e o tom do GDELT é positivo.

Marriott opens first Laos hotel, signalling tourism and investment
Thailand-China rail link progressing toward 2027 tender

summary.en: Curfews were imposed in Paris and other cities following widespread urban violence and unrest on October 17. Prime Minister Lecornu says the curfews helped the night pass calmly, but the government is under pressure. An orange alert is in force in 7 departments in the southeast due to flooding, the CAC 40 fell more than 3% on a monthly basis, and news coverage is very negative.

en: Violent incidents on October 17 and curfews in many cities
Flooding in the southeast and orange alert in 7 departments
Government under pressure, international echo of the events and Trump's harsh statements
Monthly decline of 3.29% in the CAC 40
Calm night after the curfews and reduced tension (mitigating)

summary.en: Violent protests over the weekend of 17 October have led to a large police and troop deployment, possible curfews and a military aircraft crash, which points to serious domestic strain. Partial offsets include the Code Noir repeal, solid Bureau Veritas and Atos results, and a broadly flat CAC 40.

en: Violent protests and riots; troops and police deployed, curfews considered
Military aircraft crash between Nancy and Pont-à-Mousson under search
Parliament approves symbolic repeal of Code Noir

summary.en: Violent unrest following the 17 October mobilisation dominates coverage, with local curfews, government crisis meetings, reports of soldiers possibly being deployed, and tourism cancellations. Markets fell 1.33% on the day, and a Mediterranean storm killed four people.

en: Violent protests and local curfews after the 17 October mobilisation
Government crisis meetings at Matignon and the Élysée over the unrest
Tourism cancellations and foreign travel advisories amid the riots

summary.en: France faces serious unrest: violent protests on 17 October, a Paris curfew, a court-lifted protest ban, government moves to restrict demonstrations, and widespread looting. A likely Moody's downgrade and a storm cutting power to 161,000 homes add to the strain.

en: Violent protests, looting and clashes; Paris curfew extended
Government tightening protest curbs and deploying military
Expected Moody's downgrade over debt and political crisis

summary.en: France faces serious unrest: riots on 17 October, a new weekend of protests under a 70,000-officer police deployment, museum closures, and a fatal racist shooting near Paris. Partial offsets include Moody's holding France's rating at Aa3 and storm damage that is still mostly restorable, but the CAC 40 is down 4.19% over the month.

en: Nationwide protests and riots, with 70,000 police deployed for the weekend
Fatal racist shooting near Paris; Macron calls it terrorism
Moody's keeps France's sovereign rating at Aa3

summary.en: France saw large nationwide cost-of-living protests (about 410,000 marchers) that turned violent in Paris, with roughly 1,000 detained, alongside a deadly shooting in the Yvelines. Press reports suggest calmer scenes in some places, but the government faces pressure for political answers, and debt concerns and a weaker CAC 40 add strain.

en: Nationwide cost-of-living protests with clashes and about 1,000 arrests
Deadly Yvelines shooting described by Macron as a racist terrorist attack
Government under pressure for political responses to protesters' demands

summary.en: France faces large, sometimes violent nationwide protests, with around 1,000 arrests, tear gas and police charges reported across several outlets. A mass shooting in Yvelines and a racist attack in Trappes add to the strain, while the CAC 40 rose 0.84% on the day.

en: Nationwide protests with about 410,000 participants and clashes with police
Around 1,000 arrests and police deployment of 70,000 officers
Mass shooting ('Tuerie') in Yvelines and racist attack in Trappes

summary.en: Mass cost-of-living and student protests continue, with about 1,000 arrests in Paris and 1,314 nationwide, and the government has vowed 'strong measures'. The CAC 40 is down 3.1% over the month, though the day and week moves are small, and routine news continues alongside.

en: Nationwide protests and mass arrests over cost of living
Student unrest and university closures, with reopening promised
Macron vows strong measures against protests

summary.en: France faces serious strain over the period: foreign outlets report riots and youth protests, bond yields near 5% and falling consumer confidence. Domestic coverage is mostly routine, and the CAC 40 is roughly flat over the day but down 2.4% over the month.

en: Riots and far-left unrest reported in foreign media
Bond yields near 5% raise debt-sustainability concerns
Student and social protests, with a strike planned for 5 November

summary.en: France faces broad social strain: student blockades, riots and planned general strikes, record drought, high fuel prices and a detained diplomat in Tehran. Markets were modestly up (CAC 40 +0.98% on the day), which partly offsets the picture.

en: Student blockades and protests, with riots reported in Paris and Lyon
Unprecedented drought heading toward worsening conditions
Fuel prices forcing Secours populaire to cut food distribution rounds

summary.en: France faces growing social tension, with Gilets jaunes and union mobilisations planned for 31 October, dockers striking over the budget, and authorities warning of a 'very high' violence risk and deploying 70,000 personnel. Strong corporate results (Crédit Agricole, Capgemini) and a firm CAC 40 partly offset the negative tone, so the score sits modestly below an ordinary day.

en: Gilets jaunes and union protests planned for 31 October nationwide
Authorities warn of 'very high' violence risk, deploying 70,000 personnel
Dockers strike against government budget

summary.en: France faces nationwide youth-led protests ('acte III') with 70,000 police deployed and warnings of violence, plus a negative outlook from Fitch on its credit rating. Markets were flat and much of the local news is routine, so the score sits in the serious-concern band but short of a crisis.

en: Nationwide protests with 70,000 police mobilised for Halloween weekend
Fitch turns credit outlook negative while Moody's stays stable
Government vows tough response to renewed unrest

summary.en: France faced a third weekend of large youth-led protests, with 320,000 participants and some violence on Halloween, met by a 70,000-strong police deployment. Fitch revised its outlook to negative, and GDELT tone is notably more negative than the world average, though the CAC 40 was flat and some foreign coverage called the unrest overstated.

en: Third weekend of large youth-led protests, about 320,000 participants
Violent unrest on Halloween and heavy 70,000-officer police deployment
Fitch revises France's rating outlook to negative

summary.en: Youth-led protests with police clashes and a Molotov attack on officers continued over the weekend, but foreign reports say violence was easing and schools were returning calmly. Domestic news is otherwise routine, and the CAC 40 rose modestly, so the day sits somewhat below an ordinary one.

en: Youth protests with violence easing as students return to school
779 arrests reported after weekend protests
Attempted murder probe into Molotov attack on police

summary.en: The period mixes routine news with moderate unrest: student school protests resumed on a smaller scale, and there were Paris riots and a racist attack in Trappes. Market data is steady (CAC 40 up 1.79% over the week) and one corporate update was strong, but the overall tone is more negative than the world average.

en: Student school protests resumed in dozens of schools after holidays
Paris riots with petrol bomb attack on an officer
Trappes racist attack and calls to ban a TV channel

summary.en: France faced student blockades of dozens of schools over education reforms ahead of a general strike, with reports of protesters injured by police weapons. Markets rose (CAC 40 +1.31% on the day) and the Mediterranean flood and drought stories are routine, so the overall picture is mildly negative.

en: Student blockades of dozens of schools over education reforms
Reports of protesters injured by weapons and tactics
CAC 40 up 1.31% on the day

summary.en: France faces a large nationwide strike and protests on 5 November, with about 800,000 expected and 70,000 police deployed, amid budget deadlock and controversy over house-arrest orders for protesters. Market indicators are positive (CAC 40 up 0.7% on the day) and some corporate results are strong, which keeps the score above the serious-crisis range.

en: Nationwide strike and mass protests with heavy police deployment
Budget deadlock and pressure on the Macron government
Controversy over house-arrest orders against protesters

summary.en: France saw its largest nationwide protests in years on 5 November, with about 1.6 million marching over wages and strikes, 448 arrests, and 53 police injured, though many marches were largely peaceful. Two deaths in Corsica floods and a one-day CAC 40 drop of 1.65% add to the strain.
summary.tr: Fransa, 5 Kasım'da yıllardır görülmemiş en büyük ulusal protestolarına sahne oldu; yaklaşık 1,6 milyon kişi ücretler ve grevler nedeniyle yürüdü, 448 gözaltı yapıldı ve 53 polis yaralandı, ancak yürüyüşlerin çoğu büyük ölçüde barışçıl geçti. Korsika'daki sel felaketinde iki kişinin ölmesi ve CAC 40'ın tek günde %1,65 düşüşü bu baskıyı artırdı.
summary.es: Francia vivió el 5 de noviembre sus mayores protestas nacionales en años, con unas 1,6 millones de personas marchando por salarios y huelgas, 448 detenidos y 53 policías heridos, aunque muchas marchas transcurrieron en gran medida pacíficamente. Dos muertes por las inundaciones en Córcega y una caída del 1,65 % del CAC 40 en una sola jornada agravan la presión.
summary.fr: La France a connu le 5 novembre ses plus importantes manifestations nationales depuis des années, avec environ 1,6 million de personnes défilant pour les salaires et les grèves, 448 interpellations et 53 policiers blessés, même si la plupart des cortèges se sont déroulés dans le calme. Deux décès dans les inondations en Corse et une baisse de 1,65 % du CAC 40 en une journée viennent alourdir la pression.
summary.de: Frankreich erlebte am 5. November die größten landesweiten Proteste seit Jahren: Rund 1,6 Millionen Menschen demonstrierten für höhere Löhne und gegen Streiks, 448 Personen wurden festgenommen und 53 Polizisten verletzt, auch wenn viele Demonstrationen weitgehend friedlich verliefen. Zwei Todesopfer bei den Überschwemmungen auf Korsika und ein Tagesverlust des CAC 40 von 1,65 Prozent verschärfen die Lage zusätzlich.
summary.pt: A França viveu em 5 de novembro os maiores protestos nacionais em anos, com cerca de 1,6 milhão de pessoas marchando por salários e greves, 448 prisões e 53 policiais feridos, embora muitas marchas tenham sido em grande parte pacíficas. Duas mortes nas inundações na Córsega e uma queda de 1,65% do CAC 40 em um único dia acentuam a pressão.
summary.ja: 11月5日、フランスでは数年ぶりとなる全国規模の抗議行動が行われ、賃金と ストライキを巡って約160万人がデモに参加した。逮捕者は448人、警察官53人が負傷したが、多くのデモは概ね平和的に行われた。コルシカ島の洪水で2人が死亡したほか、CAC 40が1日で1.65%下落し、情勢の緊張がさらに高まっている。
summary.ko: 11월 5일 프랑스에서는 수년 만에 가장 큰 규모의 전국적 시위가 열렸으며, 임금과 파업을 요구하며 약 160만 명이 행진에 참여했다. 448명이 체포되고 경찰 53명이 부상했으나, 많은 행진은 대체로 평화적으로 진행되었다. 코르시카섬의 홍수로 2명이 사망했고, CAC 40 지수는 하루 만에 1.65% 하락해 긴장이 더해지고 있다.
summary.hi: 5 नवंबर को फ्रांस में वर्षों बाद का सबसे बड़ा देशव्यापी विरोध प्रदर्शन हुआ, जिसमें वेतन और हड़तालों को लेकर लगभग 16 लाख लोगों ने मार्च किया। 448 लोग गिरफ्तार हुए और 53 पुलिसकर्मी घायल हुए, हालांकि कई मार्च काफी हद तक शांतिपूर्ण रहे। कोर्सिका में बाढ़ से दो मौतें हुईं और CAC 40 में एक ही दिन में 1.65% की गिरावट आई, जिससे दबाव और बढ़ गया है।
summary.el: Στις 5 Νοεμβρίου, η Γαλλία γνώρισε τις μεγαλύτερες πανεθνικές διαδηλώσεις εδώ και χρόνια, με περίπου 1,6 εκατομμύρια διαδηλωτές να βαδίζουν για μισθούς και απεργίες. Καταγράφηκαν 448 συλλήψεις και 53 τραυματίες αστυνομικοί, αν και πολλές πορείες ήταν σε μεγάλο βαθμό ειρηνικές. Δύο θάνατοι στην Κορσική από πλημμύρες και πτώση του CAC 40 κατά 1,65% σε μία μόνο μέρα επιβαρύνουν περαιτέρω την κατάσταση.
summary.it: La Francia ha registrato le più grandi proteste nazionali degli ultimi anni il 5 novembre, con circa 1,6 milioni di manifestanti in marcia per salari e scioperi, 448 arresti e 53 agenti di polizia feriti, anche se molti cortei si sono svolti in larga parte pacificamente. Due morti nelle alluvioni in Corsica e un calo dell'1,65% del CAC 40 in una sola giornata aggiungono ulteriori tensioni.
summary.ru: 5 ноября во Франции прошли самые масштабные общенациональные протесты за последние годы: около 1,6 миллиона человек вышли на марши из-за зарплат и забастовок. Задержано 448 человек, 53 полицейских получили ранения, хотя многие шествия в основном прошли мирно. Добавляют напряжённости две гибели в наводнениях на Корсике и падение индекса CAC 40 на 1,65% за один день.
summary.ar: شهدت فرنسا في 5 نوفمبر أكبر احتجاجات وطنية منذ سنوات، إذ خرج نحو 1.6 مليون شخص في مسيرات احتجاجاً على الأجور والإضرابات، وأُوقف 448 شخصاً وأُصيب 53 من رجال الشرطة، رغم أن معظم المسيرات كانت سلمية إلى حد كبير. وتزيد وفاتان في فيضانات كورسيكا وانخفاض مؤشر CAC 40 بنسبة 1.65% في يوم واحد من الضغوط.
summary.fa: فرانسه در ۵ نوامبر بزرگ‌ترین اعتراض‌های سراسری سال‌های اخیر را تجربه کرد؛ حدود ۱٫۶ میلیون نفر در اعتراض به دستمزدها و اعتصاب‌ها راهپیمایی کردند، ۴۴۸ نفر بازداشت و ۵۳ پلیس زخمی شدند، هرچند بسیاری از راهپیمایی‌ها تا حد زیادی مسالمت‌آمیز بود. دو کشته در سیل کورس و کاهش ۱٫۶۵ درصدی شاخص CAC 40 در یک روز نیز بر فشارها افزوده است.
summary.zh: 11月5日，法国爆发近年来规模最大的全国性抗议活动，约160万人上街游行，抗议工资与罢工问题；其间有448人被捕，53名警察受伤，不过许多游行总体上较为和平。科西嘉岛洪灾造成两人死亡，CAC 40指数当日下跌1.65%，进一步加剧了压力。

summary.en: The last 24 hours in Belarus show a routine news agenda: SCO meetings, economic growth (2% in January-September) and infrastructure news stand out. On the other hand, tension and the import ban with Latvia, speculation about a possible Russian attack on Ukraine from Belarusian territory, and criticism of neutrality have a slightly negative effect. Since there is no clear crisis or major positive development, the score is slightly below normal.

en: Belarus bans imports of some products from Latvia and tensions increase
Concerns that Belarusian territory could be used in attacks on Ukraine
GDP grows 2% in January-September and economic cooperation within the SCO framework
Energy flow agreements between Belarus and Russia and expansion of diplomatic relations
Temporary disruption on the Minsk-Orsha railway due to a crane accident

summary.en: The period was mostly routine: state media covered family awards, tourism forums, trade and regional personnel changes, while foreign outlets reported border migrant incidents and debate over succession. GDELT tone (-0.28) is less negative than the world average, so no clear crisis or clear positive turn stands out.

en: Unexpected replacement of Vitebsk regional executive head
Migrant border incidents on Latvian and Lithuanian frontiers
China-Belarus tourism forum and trade cooperation coverage

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: harvest reports, economic and cooperation news, and regional development. Foreign coverage stresses militarization, including plans for over 1,000 people's militia units, reported Russian ballistic missile deployments, and border tensions, while GDELT tone is less negative than the world average.

en: Plans for over 1,000 people's militia units dominate foreign coverage
Reports of Russian ballistic missiles deployed in Belarus
Routine harvest and grain threshing reports (10.3 million tonnes)

summary.en: The period mixes diplomatic and economic easing with rising military tension. Reports of US unblocking frozen transfers, potash shipments after sanctions relief, and a Poland-Belarus foreign minister meeting signal a thaw. These are offset by war-readiness rhetoric, the joint 'Shield of the Union' exercise, and NATO activity near the borders, while the GDELT tone is more negative than the world average.

en: US unblocking frozen transfers and potash shipments after sanctions relief
Belarus-US and Poland-Belarus diplomatic contacts described as a thaw
Joint Russia-Belarus 'Shield of the Union' exercise and war-readiness statements

summary.en: The period looks mostly routine on domestic state media, with local news on transport, agriculture and city life. Foreign coverage is more negative, citing hundreds of sentences for supporting Ukraine, accusations of drone-relay support for Russia, and new EU sanctions, partly offset by Polish hopes for a thaw after a prisoner release.

en: Reports of 419 people sentenced over support for Ukraine
Allegations that Belarus provides drone relay support to Russia
Hopes for a thaw with Poland after Poczobut's release

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: sports, weather, agriculture, a tree-planting campaign and a Mongolian presidential state visit. en: Mongolian president's official state visit and bilateral talks

Interview on political prisoners and Western pressure

summary.en: The period was dominated by a routine state visit from Mongolia's president, a record-scale harvest report and ordinary domestic administrative news. Talks with Washington on reopening the US embassy and a less negative tone than the world average tilt the score slightly above a typical day.

en: Mongolian president's state visit and bilateral cooperation talks

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: a Mongolia visit with about 50 million dollars in signed business agreements, and talk of renewed US dialogue on direct flights. Possible prisoner-release signals (Poczobut's return, Fridman's comments) and the Swiss conviction of a former security officer lean positive, while border-migrant and Russia defence rhetoric keep it from scoring higher.

Foreign coverage centres on Lukashenko's statements about the Ukraine war and critical reporting, and GDELT tone is more negative than the world average, so the score stays near neutral.

Minsk Eurasian security conference and Lavrov's visit
Lukashenko's statements on Ukraine war and negotiations

summary.en: The period is dominated by routine state-media coverage (agriculture, sport, regional visits) and diplomacy, including an OSCE Secretary General visit and calls for a Ukraine settlement. Foreign coverage flags border tensions and war warnings, and GDELT tone is more negative than average, which keeps the score only modestly above an ordinary day.

Lukashenko statements backing a Ukraine peace settlement within months
Foreign reports of border tensions and a difficult CSTO perimeter situation

summary.en: The period is largely routine: state media focus on diplomacy, regional development and culture, while foreign coverage centres on a Romanian presidential meeting with opposition leader Tsikhanouskaya and reports that drone relay activity was not recorded for a week. Tone is slightly more negative than the world average, but no acute crisis appears in the headlines.

summary.en: Domestic coverage is routine: harvest results, trade exhibitions and regional openings. Foreign media focus on a Catholic priest sentenced to three years for opposing the war, plus rights groups' claims about hidden political prisoners, which points to heavy pressure on civil liberties.
summary.it: La copertura nazionale è di routine: risultati del raccolto, fiere commerciali e inaugurazioni regionali. I media stranieri si concentrano su un sacerdote cattolico condannato a tre anni per aver espresso opposizione alla guerra, oltre che sulle denunce di organizzazioni per i diritti umani riguardo a detenuti politici nascosti, il che indica una forte pressione sulle libertà civili.
summary.ru: Внутреннее освещение носит рутинный характер: результаты урожая, торговые выставки и открытие объектов в регионах. Зарубежные СМИ сосредоточены на католическом священнике, приговорённом к трём годам лишения свободы за выступления против войны, а также на заявлениях правозащитных организаций о скрытых политических заключённых, что указывает на сильное давление на гражданские свободы.
summary.ar: التغطية المحلية روتينية: نتائج الحصاد والمعارض التجارية وافتتاح مشاريع في المناطق. وتركز وسائل الإعلام الأجنبية على كاهن كاثوليكي حُكم عليه بالسجن ثلاث سنوات بسبب معارضته للحرب، إضافةً إلى ادعاءات منظمات حقوقية بشأن سجناء سياسيين مخفيين، مما يشير إلى ضغوط كبيرة على الحريات المدنية.
summary.fa: پوشش داخلی خبری معمول است: نتایج برداشت محصول، نمایشگاه‌های تجاری و افتتاح پروژه‌ها در مناطق. رسانه‌های خارجی بر یک کشیش کاتولیک متمرکز شده‌اند که به دلیل مخالفت با جنگ به سه سال زندان محکوم شده است، و همچنین بر ادعاهای سازمان‌های حقوق بشری درباره زندانیان سیاسی پنهان‌شده، که حاکی از فشار شدید بر آزادی‌های مدنی است.
summary.zh: 国内报道多为例行新闻：收获成果、贸易展览和地区开业等。外国媒体则关注一名天主教神父因反对战争被判处三年徒刑，以及人权组织关于隐匿政治犯的指控，这表明公民自由面临严重压力。
summary.ja: 国内の報道は、収穫結果、見本市、地域での施設開所などの定例的な内容が中心である。海外メディアは、戦争に反対したとしてカトリックの司祭が懲役3年の判決を受けた事件と、人権団体による政治犯の情報隠蔽疑惑に注目しており、市民的自由に対する強い圧力を示唆している。
summary.ko: 국내 보도는 수확 결과, 무역 박람회, 지역 시설 개소 등 일상적인 내용이 주를 이룬다. 해외 언론은 전쟁에 반대했다는 이유로 징역 3년을 선고받은 가톨릭 사제와, 인권단체가 제기한 은폐된 정치범 관련 의혹에 주목하고 있으며, 이는 시민적 자유에 대한 강한 압박을 시사한다.
summary.hi: घरेलू कवरेज सामान्य और नियमित है: फसल के नतीजे, व्यापार प्रदर्शनियाँ और क्षेत्रीय उद्घाटन। विदेशी मीडिया युद्ध का विरोध करने के लिए तीन साल की सज़ा पाए एक कैथोलिक पादरी और मानवाधिकार समूहों के उस दावे पर केंद्रित है कि छिपे हुए राजनीतिक कैदी मौजूद हैं, जो नागरिक स्वतंत्रता पर भारी दबाव का संकेत देता है।
summary.el: Η εγχώρια κάλυψη είναι συνηθισμένη: αποτελέσματα συγκομιδής, εμπορικές εκθέσεις και εγκαινιάσεις σε περιφέρειες. Τα ξένα μέσα ενημέρωσης εστιάζουν σε έναν Καθολικό ιερέα που καταδικάστηκε σε τρία χρόνια φυλάκισης για την αντίθεσή του στον πόλεμο, καθώς και στους ισχυρισμούς οργανώσεων ανθρωπίνων δικαιωμάτων για κρυφούς πολιτικούς κρατούμενους, κάτι που υποδηλώνει έντονη πίεση στις πολιτικές ελευθερίες.
summary.tr: Yerel haberler rutin nitelikte: hasat sonuçları, ticaret fuarları ve bölgesel açılışlar. Yabancı medya ise savaşa karşı çıktığı için üç yıl hapse mahkûm edilen bir Katolik rahibe ve rights gruplarının gizlenen siyasi mahkûm verilerine ilişkin iddialarına odaklanıyor; bu da sivil özgürlükler üzerinde ağır bir baskıya işaret ediyor.
summary.es: La cobertura nacional es rutinaria: resultados de la cosecha, ferias comerciales e inauguraciones regionales. Los medios extranjeros se centran en un sacerdote católico condenado a tres años de prisión por oponerse a la guerra, así como en las denuncias de grupos de derechos humanos sobre presos políticos ocultos, lo que apunta a una fuerte presión sobre las libertades civiles.
summary.fr: La couverture nationale est routinière : résultats des récoltes, salons commerciaux et inaugurations régionales. Les médias étrangers se concentrent sur un prêtre catholique condamné à trois ans de prison pour s'être opposé à la guerre, ainsi que sur les allégations de groupes de défense des droits selon lesquelles des prisonniers politiques seraient dissimulés, ce qui laisse supposer une forte pression sur les libertés civiles.
summary.de: Die inländische Berichterstattung ist routinemäßig: Erntebilanzen, Handelsmessen und regionale Eröffnungen. Ausländische Medien konzentrieren sich auf einen katholischen Priester, der wegen seiner Ablehnung des Krieges zu drei Jahren Haft verurteilt wurde, sowie auf Behauptungen von Menschenrechtsgruppen über verborgene politische Gefangene, was auf einen starken Druck auf die bürgerlichen Freiheiten hindeutet.
summary.pt: A cobertura nacional é rotineira: resultados da colheita, feiras comerciais e inaugurações regionais. A mídia estrangeira concentra-se em um padre católico condenado a três anos de prisão por se opor à guerra, além de denúncias de grupos de direitos humanos sobre presos políticos ocultos, o que aponta para forte pressão sobre as liberdades civis.

en: Catholic priest sentenced to three years over anti-war views
Rights group report alleging concealment of political prisoner data
Routine domestic economic and agricultural news, such as record grain harvest

summary.en: In Lebanon, Israeli strikes in the south, accusations against the Lebanese army over Hezbollah's weapons, and domestic tension in Beirut (Fanar tunnel) continue. Positive signs include Qatar's proposal for a power plant and gas agreement, Arab League and international diplomatic support, and increased army patrols. However, the fragile post-war situation, concern over a security gap after the end of UNIFIL, and economic difficulties keep the score low.

en: Israeli strikes in the south and accusations that the Lebanese army is responsible for Hezbollah's weapons
Domestic tension in Beirut around the Fanar tunnel and security measures against armed appearances
Diplomatic and energy investment support from the Arab League and Qatar
Concern over a security gap after UNIFIL and the need for reconstruction
Poverty and economic fragility, with warnings of economic risk linked to the Gulf

summary.en: The period is dominated by Israeli strikes in south Lebanon, escalating Hezbollah disarmament disputes, US-mediated military talks, and the looming end of the UNIFIL mission with job losses. Some positive economic and diplomatic items, such as a Qatari power and LNG plan and Saudi trade talks, do not offset the serious security pressure.

en: Israeli strikes in south Lebanon and escalating Hezbollah disarmament disputes
UNIFIL mandate ending, with hundreds of jobs lost in the south
US-mediated Israel-Lebanon military talks amid rising tensions

summary.en: Lebanon's day was dominated by Israeli strikes in the south despite a nominal ceasefire, threats against Beirut's southern suburbs, and a domestic standoff over a seized Hezbollah explosives shipment. Diplomatic activity (Florida military talks, a planned French army support conference) and routine governance news partly offset this, and GDELT tone is markedly more negative than the world average.

en: Israeli strikes in south Lebanon despite ceasefire
Hezbollah explosives case and judicial warrants raise domestic tension
Florida Lebanon-Israel talks and planned French army conference

summary.en: Israeli airstrikes, shelling and ground advances in the south continue despite a nominal ceasefire, and Lebanon-Israel talks in Florida/Tampa have made no breakthrough, raising fears of renewed war. Domestic institutions are still functioning, with cabinet debate on the Hezbollah explosives case and calls for dialogue, which keeps the score above the crisis band.

en: Israeli strikes and ground incursions in southern Lebanon despite ceasefire
Lebanon-Israel talks show no breakthrough; fears of renewed war
Cabinet dispute over referring Hezbollah explosives shipment to judiciary

summary.en: Israeli strikes, drone activity and a reported 700 sq km 'security belt' in the south, plus UN peacekeepers preparing to leave, point to serious security strain. Domestic political tensions over seized Hezbollah explosives and a rift in the government add pressure, partly offset by IMF engagement, a Qatari electricity financing proposal and transport planning.

en: Israeli strikes and drone flights over southern Lebanon and Beirut
Reported Israeli-held 'security belt' and UN peacekeeper withdrawal
Political standoff over seized Hezbollah explosives and government rifts

summary.en: Israeli strikes continued in southern Lebanon despite a ceasefire, with reports of a 700 sq km occupation zone and new US travel warnings about escalation. Some positives, such as Qatar's aid lighting and Tripoli joining an economic corridor, and a framework agreement stalled by disputes, do not offset the security strain.

en: Israeli strikes in south continue despite ceasefire
700 sq km Israeli 'security belt' occupation reported
US embassy renews travel warnings citing regional escalation

summary.en: Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon continued despite a ceasefire, with troops massed at the border and UN peacekeepers preparing to leave, while the framework agreement stalled amid domestic political tension. Some positives appeared (Qatari economic cooperation, a youth football win, routine services), but the security escalation dominates.

en: Israeli strikes in south Lebanon despite ceasefire
Israeli troops massed along the border
UN peacekeepers preparing to exit Lebanon

summary.en: The period is dominated by renewed war fears: reports say Hezbollah is preparing for a new regional war with Iranian funding, and Israel is striking southern Lebanon in ceasefire violations. Modest positives, such as joining the IMEC ports expansion and carbon-market re-entry, do not offset the security risk and the sharply negative news tone.

en: Reports of Hezbollah rearming and preparing for new regional war
Israeli strikes and incursions in southern Lebanon despite ceasefire
Lebanon joins IMEC ports club, expanding Beirut and Tripoli ports

summary.en: Lebanon's day was dominated by continued Israeli strikes and demolitions in the south, a stalled ceasefire framework, and fears of renewed Hezbollah-Israel fighting ahead of the UNIFIL drawdown. Diplomacy on a European replacement force and a successful ship rescue offset some of the strain, and no mass violence or institutional collapse was reported.

en: Israeli strikes and demolitions in south Lebanon continue
Ceasefire framework stalled; Aoun warns of security vacuum after UNIFIL
Olive harvest hampered by access limits and drone activity

summary.en: Israeli artillery fire, demolitions and strikes in south Lebanon continue despite a ceasefire and framework arrangement, and disarmament of Hezbollah remains deadlocked. Economic and institutional news is routine, with some reform and export initiatives, so the overall picture is serious but short of full war.

en: Continued Israeli artillery and strikes in south Lebanon despite ceasefire
Hezbollah rejects disarmament and the US-brokered framework
UNIFIL withdrawal raises questions about future protection

summary.en: Lebanon faces heavy pressure: Israeli attacks and troops in the south, fears of renewed war with Hezbollah, a stalled negotiation track, and a cabinet boycott over an explosives case. Some positives, such as reported reform progress and continued European support, do not offset the security and political strain.

en: Fears of renewed war and Hezbollah preparations for battle
Aoun reports no progress in talks; Israeli attacks continue
Cabinet ministers boycott over Hezbollah explosives case

summary.en: Israeli strikes, demolitions and home burnings in southern Lebanon continue, and exports fell 16.5%. Partly offsetting this, state institutions advanced a military-court case on Hezbollah explosives and launched a process on Palestinian camp weapons.

en: Israeli bombing and home demolitions in southern Lebanon
Military court charges 13 over seized explosives truck
Lebanon exports down 16.5%

summary.en: Israeli airstrikes, house demolitions and new military roads in the south, plus fears of a 'third war', dominate the period and show serious pressure on Lebanese sovereignty and civilians. Partial positives, such as state charges over Hezbollah explosives, a hospital funded by Kuwait and pharmaceutical sector progress, do not offset them.

en: Israeli airstrikes and demolitions in southern Lebanon continue
Residents of 58 towns reportedly barred from returning
Widespread domestic fear of a 'third war'

summary.en: Lebanon faces continued Israeli artillery fire and strikes in the south despite a US-brokered deal, alongside fears of renewed war, the murder of a priest, and rising energy and food costs. Positive items such as a record cocaine seizure and a 22.5% agricultural-land damage estimate do not offset the security and economic strain.

en: Israeli shelling and strikes in south Lebanon despite US deal
Reports of possible renewed Israel-Hezbollah war fuel fears
Priest murder sparks anti-Syrian backlash; Hezbollah explosives dispute

summary.en: Lebanon faces ongoing Israeli strikes in the south despite a ceasefire, renewed war threats, displacement from Dahieh, and a food poisoning outbreak. Electricity cutoffs and the Al Habtoor asset sale add economic strain, though Doha talks and the 2027 budget framing offer limited counterweights.

en: Israeli strikes continue in south Lebanon despite ceasefire
Renewed war threats; residents fleeing Beirut's Dahieh
Electricity cutoffs to state institutions over unpaid bills

summary.en: Lebanon faces ongoing Israeli strikes in the south, warnings of renewed regional war tied to Iran, and an electricity crisis, with a sharply negative news tone. Diplomatic efforts to keep Lebanon out of new fighting and a national disability-rights strategy offer some offsetting positives.

en: Israeli strikes and demolitions in southern Lebanese villages
US warning that Hezbollah joining an Iran war would trigger strikes on Beirut
Government cuts power to public bodies amid electricity crisis

summary.en: Lebanon faces renewed border tensions: Israeli strikes in the south killed at least one person and drew warnings of a wider war, while UN peacekeepers draw down and officials urge the state to avoid conflict. Some routine governance and diplomacy continues, and the water-cut and security-vacuum stories add to the strain.

en: Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon, including heavy strikes and a fatality
UN warnings of a security vacuum as peacekeepers leave
Officials warning against being dragged into a new war

summary.en: Israeli shelling, incursions and drone violations continue in the south and around Beirut, with residents stockpiling over fears of escalation and the death toll still rising. Partial positives include state moves to assert arms control, judicial action in the explosives case, and restored water services.
summary.it: Bombardamenti israeliani, incursioni e violazioni con droni continuano nel sud e nei dintorni di Beirut, mentre i residenti fanno scorte per timore di un'escalation e il bilancio delle vittime continua a salire. Tra i segnali parzialmente positivi figurano le iniziative dello Stato per affermare il controllo sugli armamenti, l'azione giudiziaria nel caso degli esplosivi e il ripristino dei servizi idrici.
summary.ru: Израильские обстрелы, рейды и нарушения с помощью дронов продолжаются на юге и в районах вокруг Бейрута, жители запасаются продуктами из-за опасений эскалации, а число погибших продолжает расти. Частично позитивные моменты включают шаги государства по установлению контроля над вооружениями, судебные действия по делу о взрывчатых веществах и восстановление водоснабжения.
summary.ar: تتواصل القصف الإسرائيلي والتوغلات والانتهاكات بالطائرات المسيّرة في الجنوب وحول بيروت، فيما يخزّن السكان المؤن خشية تصعيد جديد، ويواصل عدد القتلى الارتفاع. ومن الإيجابيات الجزئية خطوات الدولة لفرض السيطرة على السلاح، والإجراءات القضائية في قضية المتفجرات، وإعادة خدمات المياه.
summary.fa: بمباران، تجاوزهای زمینی و نقض حریم هوایی با پهپادهای اسرائیلی در جنوب و اطراف بیروت ادامه دارد؛ ساکنان به دلیل نگرانی از تشدید تنش ذخیره‌سازی می‌کنند و شمار قربانیان همچنان رو به افزایش است. از جمله نکات مثبت نسبی، اقدامات دولت برای اعمال کنترل بر سلاح‌ها، اقدام قضایی در پرونده مواد منفجره و بازگشت خدمات آب است.
summary.zh: 以色列的炮击、越境行动和无人机侵犯在南部及贝鲁特周边地区持续发生，居民因担心局势升级而囤积物资，死亡人数仍在上升。部分积极迹象包括国家为确立武器管控而采取的行动、爆炸物案件的司法处理以及供水服务的恢复。
summary.ja: イスラエルによる砲撃、侵入、ドローンによる領空侵犯が南部およびベイルート周辺で続いており、住民はエスカレートへの懸念から物資を備蓄しています。死者数も増え続けています。一部前向きな動きとして、国家による武器管理の取り組み、爆発物事件に関する司法措置、水道サービスの復旧があります。
summary.ko: 이스라엘의 포격, 침입 및 드론 영공 침범이 남부와 베이루트 주변에서 계속되고 있으며, 주민들은 확전 우려 속에 생필품을 비축하고 있습니다. 사망자 수도 계속 늘고 있습니다. 일부 긍정적인 움직임으로는 국가의 무기 통제 조치, 폭발물 사건에 대한 사법 조치, 수도 서비스 복구가 있습니다.
summary.hi: दक्षिण और बेरूत के आसपास इज़रायली गोलाबारी, घुसपैठ और ड्रोन उल्लंघन जारी हैं, और तनाव बढ़ने की आशंका से निवासी सामान जमा कर रहे हैं। मृतकों की संख्या लगातार बढ़ रही है। आंशिक सकारात्मक घटनाक्रमों में हथियार नियंत्रण लागू करने के राज्य के कदम, विस्फोटक मामले में न्यायिक कार्रवाई और जल सेवाओं की बहाली शामिल हैं।
summary.el: Οι ισραηλινοί βομβαρδισμοί, οι εισβολές και οι παραβιάσεις με drones συνεχίζονται στον νότο και γύρω από τη Βηρυτό, ενώ οι κάτοικοι αποθηκεύουν προμήθειες από φόβο κλιμάκωσης και ο αριθμός των θυμάτων συνεχίζει να αυξάνεται. Μερικές θετικές εξελίξεις περιλαμβάνουν κρατικές κινήσεις για επιβολή ελέγχου των όπλων, δικαστική δράση στην υπόθεση των εκρηκτικών και αποκατάσταση των υπηρεσιών ύδρευσης.
summary.tr: Güney Lübnan'da ve Beyrut çevresinde İsrail bombardımanı, sızma harekâtları ve dron ihlalleri sürüyor; tırmanma korkusuyla sakinler stok yapıyor ve can kaybı rakamı yükselmeye devam ediyor. Kısmi olumlu gelişmeler arasında devletin silah kontrolünü sağlama adımları, patlayıcı davasında yargısal işlemler ve su hizmetlerinin yeniden sağlanması yer alıyor.
summary.es: Los bombardeos israelíes, las incursiones y las violaciones con drones continúan en el sur y alrededor de Beirut, mientras los residentes acumulan provisiones por temor a una escalada y la cifra de muertos sigue aumentando. Entre los avances parciales figuran las medidas del Estado para afianzar el control de armas, las acciones judiciales en el caso de los explosivos y el restablecimiento de los servicios de agua.
summary.fr: Les tirs d'artillerie israéliens, les incursions et les violations par drones se poursuivent dans le sud et autour de Beyrouth, tandis que les habitants font des réserves par crainte d'une escalade et que le bilan des morts continue de s'alourdir. Parmi les avancées partielles figurent les mesures de l'État pour affirmer le contrôle des armes, les poursuites judiciaires dans l'affaire des explosifs et le rétablissement des services d'eau.
summary.de: Israelischer Beschuss, Vorstöße und Drohnenverletzungen des Luftraums halten im Süden und rund um Beirut an, Anwohner legen aus Furcht vor einer Eskalation Vorräte an, und die Zahl der Todesopfer steigt weiter. Teilweise positive Entwicklungen sind staatliche Schritte zur Durchsetzung der Waffenkontrolle, juristische Maßnahmen im Sprengstofffall und die Wiederherstellung der Wasserversorgung.
summary.pt: Bombardeios israelenses, incursões e violações com drones continuam no sul e nos arredores de Beirute, com moradores acumulando suprimentos por temor de escalada e o número de mortos ainda em alta. Entre os avanços parciais estão as medidas do Estado para afirmar o controle de armas, ações judiciais no caso dos explosivos e o restabelecimento dos serviços de água.
