summary.en: In the last 24 hours, Damascus has been concerned about a possible clash with Israeli-backed Druze groups in As-Suwayda, while Israeli forces continue raids on villages in Quneitra. Local media focus on normalization news such as reconstruction, school reopenings, and talks with Lebanon and on refugee returns, but security tension and the GDELT tone (-1.75) are clearly negative. A fragile post-war period is described, and the near-conflict risk score remains below normal.

en: Concern over a possible attack by Israeli-backed Druze groups in As-Suwayda and claims of arming and force buildup
Israeli raids on villages in Quneitra (Taranja) and the buffer zone in southern Syria
Signs of recovery such as school reopenings, FAO participation, and the agreement with Lebanon on refugee returns
Dollar rise in the parallel market and İHD/HRW criticism of the discriminatory university admission policy
Soldier killed while destroying war remnants

summary.en: Economic and reconstruction news was mildly positive: a first Saudi Aramco diesel shipment reached Baniyas, a Saudi reconstruction-investment meeting was reported, and DNA identifications of missing persons began. These were offset by continued Israeli incursions in Quneitra and Daraa and fears of Druze unrest in Suwayda, with GDELT tone clearly negative.

en: First Saudi Aramco diesel shipment arrives at Baniyas terminal
Israeli tanks and troops operate in Quneitra and Daraa
Damascus alarmed by potential Druze insurgency in Suwayda

summary.en: The period mixes diplomatic and economic gains, including US envoy talks, the JPMorgan move to restore international bank financing, and the return of 645 displaced families to Ras al-Ain, with ongoing Israeli incursions and shelling in the south. Security incidents such as a mine blast and an ISIS cell operation add to the strain, and the negative news tone is somewhat worse than the global average.

en: JPMorgan restores Syria to international banking financing
Sixth return convoy brings 645 families back to Ras al-Ain
Israeli incursions and shelling in southern Syria continue

summary.en: The period mixes security violence, including an Israeli incursion that killed a disabled civilian in Daraa and an ISIS-cell raid near Damascus that killed two security officers, with Sweida front-line tensions. Diplomatic and reconstruction news was also active, including a Syria-Jordan strategic partnership decision, UN mine-clearance cooperation and road rehabilitation, so the score sits somewhat below an ordinary day.

en: Israeli forces killed a disabled man in southern Syria
Two security officers killed in anti-ISIS raid near Damascus
Syria-Jordan agreement to upgrade ties to strategic partnership

summary.en: Israeli incursions in southern Syria, including the killing of a disabled man in Daraa, drove nationwide protests and a UN appeal for protection. Routine reconstruction, agriculture and humanitarian-cooperation news partly offsets the security strain, so the day sits in the serious-problems range but short of crisis.

en: Israeli incursions and killing of a disabled man in Daraa
Nationwide protests against Israeli attacks and UN appeal
Rubble removal, road projects and UN mine-clearance cooperation

summary.en: Armed groups blocked the Sweida-Damascus highway, leaving hundreds stranded, and an Israeli raid that killed a disabled man sparked protests across Syria. Recovery signals (post offices reopening, DNA identification of missing persons, returnee legal aid, energy sector talk) partly offset these security problems, and tone is more negative than the world average.

en: Armed groups closed the Sweida-Damascus highway, stranding hundreds
Protests across Syria after fatal Israeli raid in Daraa
Israeli incursions and detentions in Quneitra and Daraa

summary.en: The period mixes modest positives, such as refugee families returning from Idlib camps, road rehabilitation and the national science olympiad, with serious security strain. Israeli incursions and bulldozing in the south, a fatal shooting in Daraa, explosions near Damascus and a diesel shortage in Aleppo and Idlib weigh the score down.

en: Hundreds of displaced families returning home from camps
Israeli forces advancing into Quneitra and bulldozing farmland
Fatal shooting of security member in Daraa countryside

summary.en: The period combined a serious security shock, with Jordanian airstrikes in southern Syria killing at least seven to eight people after a church attack, alongside Israeli incursions and Suwayda tensions. Positive economic and institutional news, including the ICAO airspace warning withdrawal, a $147m road deal and a planned landmine map, partly offset this.

en: Jordanian airstrikes in southern Syria killed at least seven people
Israeli incursions and Suwayda tensions continue to raise security risks
ICAO withdrew 13-year-old airspace warning on Syria

summary.en: Jordanian strikes in Daraa killed civilians and briefly closed the Nasib crossing, a serious cross-border incident. It was followed by a joint security committee, reopened border traffic, and routine reconstruction and new Saudi, Iraqi and German cooperation items, so the day is roughly ordinary with a de-escalation trend.

en: Jordanian strikes in Daraa killed civilians; border closure then reopening
Syria-Jordan agreement to form joint security or probe committee
Restored electricity, reopened schools and new Berlin flights

summary.en: The period mixes diplomatic and recovery gains, including the Iraqi PM's visit, a Jordan border reopening with a joint security committee, refugee returns and new flights, with serious strain from deadly Jordanian airstrikes in Daraa, Israeli incursions and flooding that forced evacuations. Net, the diplomatic and recovery signals outweigh the security and weather setbacks, so the score sits modestly above a typical day.

en: Iraqi PM visit and Syria-Iraq economic and security cooperation pledges
Jordan border reopening and joint security committee after deadly airstrikes
Deadly Jordanian airstrikes in Daraa and Israeli incursions in the south

summary.en: Flash floods killed at least five people, including four children, left five missing, collapsed a bridge and forced hundreds of families from camps. Routine positive developments continued alongside the disaster: displaced families returned home, new Turkey-Syria infrastructure and airline links were announced, and a militant was sentenced.

en: Flash floods killed five, including four children, and five are missing
Floods collapsed a bridge and cut the Raqqa-Aleppo highway
Hundreds of displaced families returning home from camps

summary.en: Deadly flash floods killed several people and disrupted infrastructure across multiple provinces, and cross-border strikes in Daraa and Quneitra strained relations with Jordan. Positive signals included refugee returns, Saudi energy talks, and Dutch technical cooperation, but overall the period is well below a typical day.

en: Flash floods killed at least seven people, including children
Israeli strikes in Daraa and Quneitra prompted protests and strained Jordan ties
Economic hardship reports, including electricity and food shortages

summary.en: The period mixes positive institutional and diplomatic news (FATF anti-money-laundering review, talks on re-linking to the European financial system, Gulf and regional security engagement, a reopened Damascus mosque) with serious strains. Israeli incursions in Quneitra and Daraa, flash floods that killed at least seven or eight people, and border infiltration into Jordan weigh against it, and GDELT tone is more negative than the world average.

en: Talks on rejoining the European financial system and FATF review
Regional security and Gulf/Mecca pact diplomacy advancing
Flash floods killing 7-8 people across multiple provinces

summary.en: The period mixes positive developments, including a reopened mosque, new Damascus-Jeddah flights, Iraq water talks, FATF commitments and reconstruction projects, with negatives such as deadly floods, landmine casualties, a foiled ISIS plot and falling purchasing power. Net, it reads as close to an ordinary day with a slight positive tilt.

en: Reopening of Sulaymaniyya takiyya mosque and new Damascus-Jeddah flights
Syria-Iraq water cooperation talks and FATF reform commitment
Deadly floods and landmine casualties weigh on the period

summary.en: The period mixes routine economic and cultural activity (a Damascus-China investment forum, a digitization project, a Lebanese delegation on refugee returns) with security and humanitarian strain (floods with fatalities, a foiled attack on the Homs refinery and an ISIS cell dismantled, and reported Israeli pressure). Positive institutional and economic steps slightly outweigh the negatives, so the score sits modestly above an ordinary day.

en: Damascus economic forum and China investment partnership talks
Syrian-Lebanese talks on refugee returns and security
Floods damaging farmland and killing victims in the east

summary.en: The period is mostly routine, with steady trade, transport, reconstruction and health-sector announcements and a foiled alleged Hezbollah-linked plot against the Homs refinery. Offsetting this, Israeli incursions in the south and a reported 395 violations keep the security picture tense, and GDELT tone is more negative than the world average.

en: Foiled alleged Hezbollah-linked plot against Homs refinery, with arrests
Israeli incursions and reported 395 violations in southern Syria
Trade, transit and investment talks with Türkiye, Uzbekistan and Saudi businesses

summary.en: Syria's period was mixed but leaned positive, led by a $403 million Saudi development financing package, new investment and academic cooperation, and compensation for farmers hit by disasters. Security concerns remained, including Israeli incursions in the south, a foiled Hezbollah-linked plot against an oil refinery, and reports of abductions.

en: Saudi development loans worth over $403 million signed
Foreign investment and academic cooperation talks with China, Germany, IFC
Israeli incursions in southern Syria and foiled refinery plot

summary.en: The period mixes positive reconstruction and diplomacy, including a $403m Saudi loan package, Chinese investment talks, returns of 209 displaced families from Idlib camps and a security cell dismantled in Aleppo, with ongoing violence such as an explosion at a Hasakah school, an RPG attack in Maarat al-Numan and Israeli shelling and incursion at the Mantara dam. The GDELT tone is slightly more negative than the world average, so the score sits modestly above a routine day.
summary.it: Il periodo combina ricostruzione positiva e diplomazia, tra cui un pacchetto di prestiti saudita da $403m, colloqui sugli investimenti cinesi, il rientro di 209 famiglie sfollate dai campi di Idlib e lo smantellamento di una cellula di sicurezza ad Aleppo, con violenze in corso come un'esplosione in una scuola di Hasakah, un attacco con RPG a Maarat al-Numan e bombardamenti e incursioni israeliane presso la diga di Mantara. Il tono di GDELT è leggermente più negativo della media mondiale, quindi il punteggio si colloca moderatamente sopra una giornata ordinaria.
summary.ru: Период сочетает позитивное восстановление и дипломатию, включая пакет займов Саудовской Аравии на сумму $403m, переговоры об китайских инвестициях, возвращение 209 семей переселенцев из лагерей в Идлибе и ликвидацию ячейки службы безопасности в Алеппо. При этом продолжается насилие: взрыв у школы в Хасаке, атака из РПГ в Маарат-эн-Нуман, израильский обстрел и вторжение у плотины Мантара. Тон GDELT немного более негативен, чем в среднем по миру, поэтому оценка умеренно выше обычного дня.
summary.ar: تجمع هذه الفترة بين إعادة الإعمار الإيجابية والدبلوماسية، ومن ذلك حزمة قروض سعودية بقيمة $403m ومحادثات حول الاستثمارات الصينية وعودة 209 أسر نازحة من مخيمات إدلب وتفكيك خلية أمنية في حلب، مع استمرار أعمال العنف مثل انفجار في مدرسة بالحسكة وهجوم بقاذفة RPG في معرة النعمان وقصف إسرائيلي وتوغل عند سد مانترة. ونبرة GDELT أكثر سلبية قليلاً من المتوسط العالمي، لذلك تقع الدرجة أعلى بقدر معتدل من يوم روتيني.
summary.fa: این دوره ترکیبی از بازسازی مثبت و دیپلماسی است، از جمله بسته وام $403m عربستان سعودی، گفت‌وگو درباره سرمایه‌گذاری چین، بازگشت 209 خانواده آواره از اردوگاه‌های ادلب و متلاشی شدن یک سلول امنیتی در حلب، همراه با خشونت‌های جاری مانند انفجار در مدرسه‌ای در حسکه، حمله با RPG در معره‌النعمان و گلوله‌باران و تجاوز اسرائیل در سد منطقه مانطره. لحن GDELT کمی منفی‌تر از میانگین جهانی است، بنابراین امتیاز به‌طور متوسط بالاتر از یک روز عادی قرار دارد.
summary.zh: 该时段兼有积极的重建与外交活动，包括沙特提供的$403m贷款方案、中国投资洽谈、209个来自伊德利卜营地的流离失所家庭返回，以及阿勒颇一个安全小组被瓦解；同时暴力事件仍在持续，如哈塞克一所学校发生爆炸、马阿拉特努曼遭RPG袭击，以及以色列在曼塔拉大坝的炮击和越境行动。GDELT语气比全球平均水平略为负面，因此分数略高于普通日子。
summary.ja: 今回の期間には、4億300万ドルのサウジ融資策、中国との投資協議、イドリブの避難民キャンプから209世帯が帰還したこと、アレッポで治安組織の細胞が解体されたことなど、復興と外交に関する前向きな動きが含まれている。一方で、ハサカの学校での爆発、マアラト・アル・ヌーマンでのRPG攻撃、マンタラダムでのイスラエルによる砲撃と侵入など、暴力も続いている。GDELTのトーンは世界平均よりわずかに否定的であるため、スコアは通常の一日よりやや高めに位置している。
summary.ko: 이번 기간에는 4억 300만 달러 규모의 사우디 대출 패키지, 중국과의 투자 협상, 이들리브 난민촌에서 209개 가구가 귀환한 소식, 알레포에서 보안 조직 세포가 해체된 일 등 재건과 외교에 관한 긍정적인 움직임이 포함되어 있다. 한편 하사카 학교 폭발, 마아랏 알 누만에서의 RPG 공격, 만타라 댐에 대한 이스라엘의 포격과 침입 등 폭력 사태도 계속되고 있다. GDELT 어조는 세계 평균보다 약간 부정적이어서, 점수는 일상적인 하루보다 다소 높게 나타난다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में सकारात्मक पुनर्निर्माण और कूटनीति के साथ-साथ कई घटनाएँ शामिल हैं, जिनमें 403 मिलियन डॉलर का सऊदी ऋण पैकेज, चीन के साथ निवेश वार्ता, इदलिब शिविरों से 209 विस्थापित परिवारों की वापसी और अलेप्पो में एक सुरक्षा सेल का ध्वस्त किया जाना शामिल है। वहीं हसाका के एक स्कूल में विस्फोट, मारात अल-नुमान में RPG हमला और मंतारा बांध पर इज़राइली गोलाबारी और घुसपैठ जैसी हिंसा भी जारी है। GDELT का लहजा विश्व औसत से थोड़ा अधिक नकारात्मक है, इसलिए स्कोर एक सामान्य दिन से कुछ हद तक ऊपर है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος συνδυάζει θετικές εξελίξεις στην ανασυγκρότηση και τη διπλωματία, όπως το πακέτο δανείων ύψους 403 εκατ. δολαρίων από τη Σαουδική Αραβία, συνομιλίες για κινεζικές επενδύσεις, την επιστροφή 209 οικογενειών εκτοπισμένων από τους καταυλισμούς του Ιντλίμπ και την εξάρθρωση κυττάρου ασφαλείας στο Χαλέπι, με συνεχιζόμενη βία, όπως έκρηξη σε σχολείο της Χασάκα, επίθεση με RPG στο Μααρατ αλ-Νουμάν και ισραηλινούς βομβαρδισμούς και εισβολή στο φράγμα Μαντάρα. Ο τόνος του GDELT είναι ελαφρώς αρνητικότερος από τον παγκόσμιο μέσο όρο, γι' αυτό η βαθμολογία βρίσκεται μετρίως πάνω από μια συνηθισμένη ημέρα.
summary.tr: Dönem, 403 milyon dolarlık bir Suudi kredi paketi, Çin yatırım görüşmeleri, İdlib kamplarından 209 yerinden edilmiş ailenin dönüşü ve Halep'te çökertilen bir güvenlik hücresi dahil olmak üzere olumlu yeniden yapılanma ve diplomasiyi bir araya getiriyor; bunun yanında Hasake'deki bir okulda patlama, Maarat al-Numan'da RPG saldırısı ve Mantara barajındaki İsrail topçu ateşi ve sızma gibi süregelen şiddet olayları da yaşanıyor. GDELT tonu dünya ortalamasından biraz daha olumsuz, bu nedenle puan rutin bir günün biraz üzerinde seyrediyor.
summary.es: El periodo combina reconstrucción y diplomacia positivas, incluido un paquete de préstamos saudí de 403 millones de dólares, conversaciones de inversión china, el regreso de 209 familias desplazadas desde los campamentos de Idlib y una célula de seguridad desmantelada en Alepo, junto con violencia en curso, como una explosión en una escuela de Hasaka, un ataque con RPG en Maarat al-Numan y bombardeos e incursión israelíes en la presa de Mantara. El tono de GDELT es ligeramente más negativo que la media mundial, por lo que la puntuación se sitúa moderadamente por encima de un día rutinario.
summary.fr: La période mêle reconstruction et diplomatie positives, dont un ensemble de prêts saoudiens de 403 millions de dollars, des discussions d'investissement chinoises, le retour de 209 familles déplacées des camps d'Idlib et le démantèlement d'une cellule de sécurité à Alep, tout en étant marquée par des violences persistantes, comme une explosion dans une école de Hassaké, une attaque au RPG à Maarat al-Numan et des tirs d'obus et une incursion israéliens au barrage de Mantara. Le ton de GDELT est légèrement plus négatif que la moyenne mondiale, si bien que le score se situe modérément au-dessus d'une journée ordinaire.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum verbindet positive Wiederaufbau- und Diplomatieereignisse, darunter ein saudisches Kreditpaket über 403 Mio. US-Dollar, chinesische Investitionsgespräche, die Rückkehr von 209 vertriebenen Familien aus den Lagern in Idlib und die Zerschlagung einer Sicherheitszelle in Aleppo, während anhaltende Gewalt zu verzeichnen ist, etwa eine Explosion an einer Schule in Hasaka, ein RPG-Angriff in Maarat al-Numan sowie israelischer Beschuss und ein Eindringen am Mantara-Damm. Der GDELT-Tonwert ist etwas negativer als der Weltdurchschnitt, weshalb der Wert leicht über einem gewöhnlichen Tag liegt.

O tom do GDELT é ligeiramente mais negativo que a média mundial, de modo que a pontuação fica moderadamente acima de um dia de rotina.

summary.ru: Период определяется продолжающейся войной: атаки беспилотников на Ростов и Таганрог, пожар на НПЗ и заявленные потери Украины, а также конфискация активов Japan Tobacco и Nestlé и дипломатическая перепалка с Венгрией. Gli aspetti negativi si limitano alle conseguenze della crisi di frontiera di Ceuta, alle pressioni sui prezzi di alimentari e carburanti e a una protesta programmata dei dipendenti pubblici, mentre il tono di GDELT è meno negativo della media mondiale.

summary.pt: O período transcorre em grande parte de forma rotineira: consultas de políticas, planos rodoviários e elétricos e contatos com doadores ou parceiros comerciais. Os protestos de importadores contra a congestão portuária, uma questão sobre a credibilidade da governança e um alerta sobre a reforma eleitoral pesam levemente de forma negativa, e o tom do GDELT é mais negativo que a média mundial.
summary.ja: 今期は概ね定例的な動きで、政策協議、道路・電力計画、ドナーおよび通商面での取り組みが中心となっている。港湾混雑に対する輸入業者の抗議、ガバナンスの信頼性に関する疑問、選挙制度改革への警告が、やや否定的な方向に作用している。GDELTのトーンは世界平均よりも否定的である。
summary.ko: 이번 기간은 대체로 일상적인 흐름으로, 정책 협의, 도로 및 전력 계획, 공여국 및 무역 관련 협력이 주를 이룹니다. 항만 혼잡에 대한 수입업체들의 항의, 거버넌스 신뢰성에 관한 의문, 선거제도 개혁에 대한 경고는 다소 부정적인 영향을 미치고 있으며, GDELT 어조는 세계 평균보다 더 부정적입니다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि की अधिकतर गतिविधियाँ नियमित प्रकृति की हैं: नीतिगत परामर्श, सड़क और बिजली योजनाएँ, तथा दाता एवं व्यापार से जुड़ी गतिविधियाँ। बंदरगाह पर भीड़ को लेकर आयातकों के विरोध, शासन की विश्वसनीयता पर सवाल और चुनाव सुधार पर चेतावनी से हल्का नकारात्मक प्रभाव है, और GDELT का स्वर विश्व औसत से अधिक नकारात्मक है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος είναι κυρίως ρουτινική: διαβουλεύσεις πολιτικής, σχέδια για δρόμους και ηλεκτρισμό, καθώς και συμμετοχή δωρητών και εμπορικές δραστηριότητες. Οι διαμαρτυρίες εισαγωγέων για τη συμφόρηση στα λιμάνια, το ζήτημα της αξιοπιστίας της διακυβέρνησης και η προειδοποίηση για την εκλογική μεταρρύθμιση σταθμίζουν ελαφρώς αρνητικά, ενώ ο τόνος του GDELT είναι αρνητικότερος από τον παγκόσμιο μέσο όρο.
summary.it: Il periodo è per lo più di routine: consultazioni sulle politiche, piani stradali ed elettrici, e impegno con donatori e nel commercio. Le proteste degli importatori per la congestione dei porti, un interrogativo sulla credibilità della governance e un avvertimento sulla riforma elettorale pesano leggermente in senso negativo, e il tono di GDELT è più negativo della media mondiale.
summary.ru: Период в основном рутинный: консультации по политике, планы строительства дорог и энергетики, а также взаимодействие с донорами и в сфере торговли. Протесты импортеров из-за перегруженности портов, вопрос о доверии к системе управления и предупреждение о реформе избирательной системы слегка сказываются негативно, а тон GDELT более негативен, чем в среднем по миру.
summary.ar: الفترة روتينية في معظمها: مشاورات حول السياسات، وخطط للطرق والكهرباء، وتفاعل مع المانحين والتجارة. تضغط احتجاجات المستوردين على خلفية ازدحام الموانئ، وتساؤلات حول مصداقية الحوكمة، وتحذير بشأن الإصلاح الانتخابي نحو السلبية بشكل طفيف، وتكون نبرة GDELT أكثر سلبية من المتوسط العالمي.
summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً عادی است: مشاوره‌های سیاستی، برنامه‌های جاده‌سازی و برق، و تعامل با اهداکنندگان و تجارت. اعتراض واردکنندگان به ازدحام بنادر، پرسش درباره اعتبار حکمرانی و هشداری درباره اصلاحات انتخاباتی اندکی منفی‌اند و لحن GDELT منفی‌تر از میانگین جهانی است.
summary.zh: 本时段总体属于常规事务：政策磋商、公路和电力规划，以及与捐助方和贸易的互动。进口商因港口拥堵抗议、对治理可信度的质疑以及对选举改革的警告，使局势略显消极，GDELT的语气也比全球平均水平更为负面。

summary.en: Record rice exports, reduced losses from mines, confidence-building measures in the maritime dispute with Thailand, and diplomatic agreements with Croatia stood out as positive developments in the last 24 hours. In contrast, the operation against fraud centers was tested by claims of links to political elites, while an 11% drop in international air passengers and a rise in fuel prices had a limited negative impact. Overall, the picture is slightly more positive than during a typical period.

en: Record rice exports
Agreement on confidence-building measures in the maritime dispute with Thailand
Visa exemption and diplomatic cooperation agreements with Croatia
Operation against fraud networks tested by claims of links to elites
Decline in international air passengers and rise in fuel prices

summary.en: The period was mostly positive: Cambodia reported record rice exports above 1 million tonnes, signed a diplomatic agreement with Croatia, and received development and conservation news. Offsetting concerns included an 11% drop in air passengers, trade strain from the Thai border conflict, and scam-centre cases.

en: Record milled rice exports, first time above 1 million tonnes
Diplomatic deals signed with Croatia on visas and training
Six new Irrawaddy dolphin calves reported

summary.en: Cambodia's coverage is mostly routine or mildly positive: a new 5-year MSME strategy, aviation and sports achievements, and an anti-scam asset freeze. Offsetting concerns include rising household debt, fuel price spikes, scam-compound victims and renewed friction with Thailand, and the GDELT tone is less negative than the world average.

en: Five-year MSME strategy launched to drive economic growth
Prince Group assets frozen in anti-scam action with INTERPOL notices
Rising household debt and fuel price spike concerns

summary.en: The period is largely routine: cooperation pledges, SME policy, a statistics project completion and an anti-scam asset freeze, offset by trafficking warnings and a more negative GDELT tone than the world average. Enforcement against the Prince Group and steady institutional activity keep the score near a typical day.

en: Anti-scam action freezing about US$1b in Prince Group assets
Arrest of a senior Prince Group official, with others reportedly abroad
Launch of a five-year SME development strategy and PM support call

summary.en: The period mixes routine positive institutional news (a UN peacekeeping anniversary, a fintech cooperation deal, and a 2027 budget passed) with a notable enforcement step: about $1 billion in Prince Group-linked assets frozen and a senior figure arrested. Warnings from the IMF and ADB on scam and climate risks temper the score, and GDELT tone is slightly above the world average.

en: Crackdown on Prince Group: nearly $1bn in assets frozen
Arrest of a senior Prince Group member
UN peacekeeping 20-year anniversary and fintech cooperation deal

summary.en: The period looks mostly routine, with positive items such as UN peacekeeping anniversary celebrations, economic restructuring coverage and a Russia-Cambodia citizen-protection agreement sent for ratification. Negative items, including online scam arrests, cross-border smuggling busts and a film controversy with Thailand, are typical rather than crisis-level, and GDELT tone is mildly positive.

en: Economic growth reset toward small industries and smart agriculture
Cambodia marks 20 years of UN peacekeeping contributions
Russia-Cambodia citizen-protection agreement submitted for ratification

summary.en: The period mixes positive economic and institutional news, including an ADB rural farming package, a hydropower project nearing generation, and the freezing of nearly $1B in Prince Group assets. Border fence tensions and scam-related concerns keep it from being clearly positive, and GDELT tone is less negative than the world average.

en: ADB approves $72M package for rural farming resilience
Nearly $1B in Prince Group assets frozen
Pursat hydropower project nearing generation and flood mitigation

summary.en: The period mixes routine development news (ADB financing, a water conference, defense ties with the Philippines, Vietnam friendship events) with notable negatives: a 43.7% drop in tourist arrivals, a border conflict with Thailand whose peace is described as uncertain, and reports of a murdered scam whistleblower. Overall this is close to an ordinary day, with a slight negative lean.

en: Tourist arrivals down 43.7% in January-September
ADB approves $72M package for rural farming resilience
Kuala Lumpur Accord anniversary; peace described as uncertain

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: a Japanese loan extension, a $166 million port contract and anti-scam cooperation point to modest positives. Offsetting this are a new conscription quota, a murder linked to a scam-network case, and about 200 cruise passengers stranded by fuel costs, with GDELT tone more negative than the world average.

en: Japanese loan extension and $166M Sihanoukville port contract
Anti-scam cooperation and extradition of scam boss Liu Ren
New conscription quota of 10,000 under military service law

summary.en: The period is dominated by a foreign-media story about a US cruise ship stranding 200 passengers in Cambodia over fuel costs, which is a private commercial event with limited national impact. Negative signals include an Amnesty allegation about police and soldiers guarding scam compounds and a landmine blast injuring Thai soldiers near the border, partly offset by new air links to Siem Reap.

en: Cruise ship stranding 200 passengers over fuel costs
Amnesty allegations on scam compounds and security forces
Landmine injures Thai soldiers near Thai-Cambodia border

summary.en: The period is mixed: a widely covered cruise-ship stranding in Cambodia over fuel costs and an Amnesty report on abuses in scam compounds weigh negative, while Vietnam-Cambodia border cooperation and a $12.8M scam-fraud recovery offer modest positives. Tone is more negative than the world average, but no national-scale crisis is evident.

en: Cruise ship stranded over fuel costs, referenced as an energy crisis
Amnesty report on slavery and abuse in scamming compounds
Vietnam-Cambodia border management and cooperation agreements

summary.en: The period is mostly routine, with positive cultural, diplomatic and development news such as the return of looted antiquities, a rice seed donation and a customs cooperation plan. Negatives include a stranded cruise ship with crew reporting seized passports and unpaid wages, plus reports of scam centres and illegal border crossings, which keep the score near neutral.

en: Stranded cruise ship; crew allege seized passports and withheld wages
Return of 18 looted Khmer antiquities from Britain
Vietnam-Cambodia customs cooperation plan for 2027–2028

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: cultural events, Vietnamese medical aid, and investment outreach. Negative items include a stranded cruise ship over fuel costs, scam-network relocation with 148 repatriations to China, and revived conscription, which roughly offset each other.

en: Scam networks reportedly relocating to Africa; 148 suspects repatriated to China
Cruise ship stranded in Cambodia after suspending voyage over fuel costs
Routine cultural, medical-aid and investment-promotion news

summary.en: The period mixes a notable economic setback, a double-digit drop in Angkor tourist arrivals and revenue, with routine positives such as the return of 18 looted antiquities and free medical exams in remote areas. Scam-network crackdowns and rising drug arrests add some negative tone, but there is no crisis, so the score sits slightly below an ordinary day.

en: Double-digit fall in Angkor tourist arrivals and revenue
Return of 18 looted Khmer antiquities from Britain
Scam networks shifting out of Cambodia amid crackdown

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: insurance premiums rose, France and Cambodia pledged anti-scam cooperation, and dolphin numbers grew. Offsetting these, Angkor tourism fell double digits and scam-related and trafficking stories continued, with GDELT tone slightly more negative than the world average.

en: Insurance gross premiums rose in first nine months
Angkor tourist arrivals and revenue fell double digits
Cambodia-France cooperation against online scams announced

summary.en: The period was mostly routine: a cruise ship left after stranding passengers over fuel costs, and traffic deaths were reported. Modest positives included rising rice exports and the recovery of war-dead remains, offset by an Amnesty report on abuses at scam compounds and a slightly more negative news tone than the world average.

en: Cruise ship stranded 200+ passengers, then left Cambodia after fuel-cost suspension
Amnesty report alleging slavery and abuse at scam-center security firms
Rice exports to the Philippines boosted by demand

summary.en: The period is dominated by problems: about 8,000 residents still cannot return to homes near the border, stranded workers remain after the scam-operation crackdown, and foreign media report kidnappings and a student death linked to travel-alert delays. Positive items, such as China's diplomatic backing and an Etihad tourism partnership, are minor by comparison, and the cruise-ship stranding is a commercial dispute rather than a national crisis.

en: Nearly 8,000 border residents still unable to return home
Stranded workers after crackdown on scam operations
Reports of kidnappings and a Korean student's death

summary.en: The period mixes routine positives (a dolphin protection centre, a $600 million fuel and electricity subsidy, tech and education MoUs) with negative items: new US sanctions on scam-group affiliates, a Thai military post moving near a bombed bridge, and stranded cruise passengers. Taken together this is an ordinary news day with some tension, and the more negative GDELT tone does not by itself justify a lower score.
summary.it: Il periodo mescola notizie positive di routine (un centro per la protezione dei delfini, un sussidio da 600 milioni di dollari per carburante ed elettricità, protocolli d'intesa in campo tecnologico e dell'istruzione) con elementi negativi: nuove sanzioni statunitensi contro affiliati di gruppi di truffatori, lo spostamento di una postazione militare thailandese vicino a un ponte bombardato e passeggeri di crociera bloccati. Nel complesso si tratta di una giornata di notizie ordinaria con qualche tensione, e il tono più negativo di GDELT non giustifica da solo un punteggio più basso.
summary.ru: Период сочетает обычные позитивные новости (центр защиты дельфинов, субсидия на топливо и электроэнергию на 600 миллионов долларов, меморандумы в сфере технологий и образования) с негативными событиями: новые санкции США против аффилированных структур мошеннических групп, перемещение тайской военной позиции вблизи разрушенного моста и застрявших пассажиров круизного лайнера. В целом это обычный новостной день с некоторым напряжением, и более негативная тональность GDELT сама по себе не оправдывает более низкой оценки.
summary.ar: تجمع الفترة بين أخبار إيجابية روتينية (مركز لحماية الدلافين، ودعم حكومي للوقود والكهرباء بقيمة 600 مليون دولار، ومذكرات تفاهم في مجالي التقنية والتعليم) وأخبار سلبية: عقوبات أمريكية جديدة على شركات تابعة لمجموعات احتيال، ونقل موقع عسكري تايلاندي قرب جسر تعرض للقصف، وركاب سفينة سياحية عالقين. وبالمجمل، هو يوم إخباري عادي مع بعض التوتر، ولا يبرر نبرة GDELT الأكثر سلبية وحدها انخفاض التقييم.
summary.fa: این دوره ترکیبی از اخبار مثبت معمول (یک مرکز حفاظت از دلفین‌ها، یارانه ۶۰۰ میلیون دلاری برای سوخت و برق، تفاهم‌نامه‌های فناوری و آموزشی) و اخبار منفی است: تحریم‌های جدید آمریکا علیه وابستگان گروه‌های کلاهبرداری، جابه‌جایی یک پست نظامی تایلند نزدیک پلی که بمباران شده، و مسافران گیرافتادهٔ یک کشتی کروز. در مجموع این یک روز خبری عادی با کمی تنش است و لحن منفی‌تر GDELT به تنهایی کاهش امتیاز را توجیه نمی‌کند.
summary.zh: 该时段既有例行的正面新闻（海豚保护中心、6亿美元燃料和电力补贴、科技与教育领域的谅解备忘录），也有负面事件：美国对诈骗团伙关联方实施新制裁、泰国军方哨所迁至一座被炸毁的桥梁附近，以及邮轮乘客滞留。综合来看，这是一个有一定紧张气氛的普通新闻日，而GDELT更为负面的语气本身并不足以支持降低评分。
summary.tr: Dönem, rutin olumlu haberleri (bir yunus koruma merkezi, 600 milyon dolarlık yakıt ve elektrik sübvansiyonu, teknoloji ve eğitim alanlarında mutabakat muhtıraları) olumsuz gelişmelerle (dolandırıcılık gruplarının uzantılarına yönelik yeni ABD yaptırımları, bombalanmış bir köprünün yakınına taşınan bir Tayland askeri karakolu ve mahsur kalan kruvaziyer yolcuları) bir araya getiriyor. Bütün bunlar bir miktar gerilimin bulunduğu sıradan bir haber günü oluşturuyor; GDELT'in daha olumsuz tonu tek başına daha düşük bir puanı haklı çıkarmıyor.
summary.es: El período combina aspectos positivos habituales (un centro de protección de delfines, un subsidio de 600 millones de dólares para combustible y electricidad, memorandos de entendimiento en tecnología y educación) con elementos negativos: nuevas sanciones de EE. UU. contra afiliados de grupos de estafas, el traslado de un puesto militar tailandés cerca de un puente bombardeado y pasajeros de crucero varados. En conjunto, es un día de noticias corriente con cierta tensión, y el tono más negativo de GDELT no justifica por sí solo una puntuación más baja.
summary.fr: La période mêle des éléments positifs de routine (un centre de protection des dauphins, une subvention de 600 millions de dollars pour les coûts du carburant et de l'électricité, des protocoles d'accord dans la technologie et l'éducation) à des éléments négatifs : de nouvelles sanctions américaines contre des affiliés de groupes d'escroquerie, le déplacement signalé d'un poste militaire thaïlandais près d'un pont bombardé, et des passagers de croisière bloqués. Dans l'ensemble, il s'agit d'une journée d'actualité ordinaire avec une certaine tension, et le ton plus négatif de GDELT ne justifie pas à lui seul une note plus basse.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum vereint routinemäßig positive Meldungen (ein Delfinschutzzentrum, eine Subvention von 600 Millionen US-Dollar zur Senkung der Kosten für Kraftstoff und Strom, Absichtserklärungen in Technologie und Bildung) mit negativen Nachrichten: neue US-Sanktionen gegen Verbundene von Betrugsgruppen, die Verlegung eines thailändischen Militärpostens in die Nähe einer zerbombten Brücke und festsitzende Kreuzfahrtpassagiere. Insgesamt ist es ein gewöhnlicher Nachrichtentag mit etwas Spannung, und der negativere GDELT-Ton allein rechtfertigt keine niedrigere Bewertung.
summary.pt: O período combina aspectos positivos rotineiros (um centro de proteção de golfinhos, um subsídio de 600 milhões de dólares para combustível e eletricidade, memorandos de entendimento em tecnologia e educação) com itens negativos: novas sanções dos EUA contra afiliados de grupos de golpes, o deslocamento relatado de um posto militar tailandês para perto de uma ponte bombardeada e passageiros de cruzeiro retidos. No conjunto, é um dia de notícias comum com alguma tensão, e o tom mais negativo do GDELT não justifica sozinho uma pontuação mais baixa.
summary.ja: この期間には、イルカ保護センターの設立、6億ドル規模の燃料・電気料金補助金、技術・教育分野の覚書など日常的な前向きな出来事と、詐欺グループ関連者に対する米国の新たな制裁、爆撃された橋の近くへのタイ軍部隊の移動、クルーズ船の乗客が足止めされた件などの否定的な出来事が混在しています。全体としては緊張感を伴う通常のニュース日であり、GDELTのより否定的なトーンだけを理由に評価を下げる根拠にはなりません。

summary.el: Η περίοδος είναι κυρίως ρουτίνα: ειδήσεις για καταναλωτές και κοινωνικά θέματα, ανακοινώσεις πολιτικής υγείας και χρονοδιάγραμμα για μια νέα θεραπεία του καρκίνου. Η τριβή με τη Σερβία για έναν καθηγητή του Ζάγκρεμπ που συμβούλευε σερβική φοιτητές και ένας συναγερμός για πιθανή απειλή με αεροσκάφη Rafale προσθέτουν κάποια ένταση, ενώ ο τόνος στο GDELT είναι πιο αρνητικός από τον παγκόσμιο μέσο όρο.
summary.it: Il periodo è per lo più di routine: notizie di consumo e di società, annunci di politica sanitaria e una nuova tempistica per una terapia contro il cancro. Le tensioni con la Serbia per un professore di Zagabria che consiglia studenti serbi e un allarme per i caccia Rafale aggiungono un po' di tensione, e il tono di GDELT è più negativo della media mondiale.
summary.ru: Период в основном рутинный: новости потребительского и социального характера, объявления в сфере health-политики и новые сроки внедрения терапии против рака. Напряжённость с Сербией из-за профессора из Загреба, который консультирует сербских студентов, и тревога с истребителями Rafale добавляют определённого напряжения, а тональность GDELT более негативна, чем в среднем по миру.

summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً عادی است: اخبار مصرف‌کننده و اجتماعی، اعلام‌های سیاست بهداشتی، و جدولی زمانی برای یک درمان جدید سرطان. اصطکاک با صربستان بر سر استادی از زاگرب که به دانشجویان صرب مشاوره می‌دهد و هشدار هواپیماهای رافال کمی تنش می‌افزاید و لحن GDELT منفی‌تر از میانگین جهانی است.
summary.zh: 这一时期大体属于常规新闻：消费与社会新闻、卫生政策公告以及一项新癌症疗法的时间表。与塞尔维亚因一名为塞尔维亚学生提供建议的萨格勒布教授而产生的摩擦，以及一次阵风战机警报，增添了一些紧张气氛；GDELT的语气比全球平均水平更为负面。

summary.es: El periodo es en su mayoría rutinario: noticias de consumo y sociales, anuncios de política sanitaria y un nuevo calendario para una terapia contra el cáncer. La fricción con Serbia por un profesor de Zagreb que asesora a estudiantes serbios y una alerta de aviones Rafale añaden cierta tensión; el tono de GDELT es más negativo que la media mundial.
summary.fr: La période est dans l'ensemble routinière : actualités de consommation et sociales, annonces de politique de santé et calendrier d'une nouvelle thérapie contre le cancer. Des tensions avec la Serbie, liées à un professeur de Zagreb conseillant des étudiants serbes, ainsi qu'une alerte impliquant des avions Rafale, ajoutent un peu de tension ; le ton GDELT est plus négatif que la moyenne mondiale.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum verläuft überwiegend routinemäßig: Verbraucher- und Gesellschaftsnachrichten, gesundheitspolitische Ankündigungen und ein neuer Zeitplan für eine Krebstherapie. Spannungen mit Serbien wegen eines Zagreber Professors, der serbische Studierende berät, sowie ein Alarm bezüglich Rafale-Kampfflugzeugen sorgen für etwas Anspannung; der GDELT-Ton ist negativer als der Weltdurchschnitt.
summary.pt: O período é, em grande parte, de rotina: notícias de consumo e sociais, anúncios de políticas de saúde e um novo cronograma para uma terapia contra o câncer. O atrito com a Sérvia por causa de um professor de Zagreb que orienta estudantes sérvios e um alerta envolvendo aviões Rafale acrescentam alguma tensão; o tom do GDELT é mais negativo que a média mundial.

summary.en: The period looks mostly routine: a record-deletion error, false bomb threats at Copenhagen Airport, and a legal challenge to a housing policy weigh against a day-to-day stock dip of 1.49%. Offsetting positives include stronger airport passenger numbers, new cooperation agreements, and a 9.3% monthly gain in the OMX Copenhagen 25.
summary.tr: Dönem büyük ölçüde olağan görünüyor: bir sabıka kaydı silme hatası, Kopenhag Havalimanı'ndaki sahte bomba ihbarları ve bir konut politikasına yönelik yasal itiraz, günlük %1,49'luk hisse senedi düşüşüyle birlikte olumsuz etki yaratıyor. Dengeleyici olumlu gelişmeler arasında havalimanı yolcu sayılarındaki artış, yeni iş birliği anlaşmaları ve OMX Copenhagen 25'teki aylık %9,3'lük kazanç yer alıyor.
summary.es: El periodo parece en su mayoría rutinario: un error en la eliminación de registros, amenazas de bomba falsas en el aeropuerto de Copenhague y una impugnación legal de una política de vivienda pesan frente a una caída diaria de la acción del 1,49 %. Entre los factores positivos que compensan están el aumento del número de pasajeros del aeropuerto, nuevos acuerdos de cooperación y una ganancia mensual del 9,3 % en el OMX Copenhagen 25.
summary.fr: La période semble globalement routinière : une erreur de suppression de casiers judiciaires, de fausses menaces d'attentat à l'aéroport de Copenhague et une contestation juridique d'une politique du logement pèsent face à une baisse quotidienne du cours de 1,49 %. Les facteurs positifs compensateurs comprennent la hausse du nombre de passagers de l'aéroport, de nouveaux accords de coopération et une hausse mensuelle de 9,3 % de l'OMX Copenhagen 25.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum verläuft überwiegend routinemäßig: Ein Fehler bei der Löschung von Strafregistereinträgen, falsche Bombendrohungen am Flughafen Kopenhagen und eine rechtliche Anfechtung einer Wohnungspolitik wiegen schwerer als der tägliche Kursrückgang der Aktie um 1,49 %. Ausgleichend wirken höhere Passagierzahlen am Flughafen, neue Kooperationsvereinbarungen und ein monatlicher Zuwachs von 9,3 % beim OMX Copenhagen 25.
summary.pt: O período parece em grande parte rotineiro: um erro na eliminação de registos criminais, ameaças de bomba falsas no Aeroporto de Copenhaga e uma contestação judicial de uma política de habitação pesam contra uma queda diária de 1,49% nas ações. Como fatores positivos compensatórios, destacam-se o aumento do número de passageiros no aeroporto, novos acordos de cooperação e um ganho mensal de 9,3% no OMX Copenhagen 25.
summary.ja: この期間は概ね平常の範囲に見えます。記録の誤削除、コペンハーゲン空港での虚偽の爆破予告、住宅政策に対する法的異議申し立てが、株価の1日あたり1.49%の下落要因となっています。一方、空港の旅客数増加、新たな協力協定、OMXコペンハーゲン25の月間9.3%上昇がこれを相殺する好材料です。
summary.ko: 이번 기간은 대체로 평이해 보입니다. 기록 삭제 오류, 코펜하겐 공항의 허위 폭탄 위협, 주택 정책에 대한 법적 이의 제기가 일일 주가 1.49% 하락과 함께 부정적 요인으로 작용하고 있습니다. 반면 공항 여객 수 증가, 새로운 협력 협정, OMX 코펜하겐 25의 월간 9.3% 상승은 긍정적 요인으로 이를 상쇄하고 있습니다.
summary.hi: यह अवधि ज़्यादातर सामान्य दिखती है: रिकॉर्ड हटाने की एक त्रुटि, कोपेनहेगन हवाई अड्डे पर झूठी बम धमकियाँ और एक आवास नीति को दी गई कानूनी चुनौती, दैनिक शेयर में 1.49% की गिरावट के कारण बनीं। इन्हें संतुलित करने वाले सकारात्मक पहलुओं में हवाई अड्डे पर बढ़ी यात्री संख्या, नए सहयोग समझौते और OMX कोपेनहेगन 25 में मासिक 9.3% की बढ़ोतरी शामिल हैं।
summary.el: Η περίοδος φαίνεται κυρίως συνηθισμένη: ένα σφάλμα διαγραφής αρχείων, ψευδείς απειλές βομβών στο αεροδρόμιο της Κοπεγχάγης και μια νομική αμφισβήτηση πολιτικής στέγασης συμβάλλουν σε μια καθημερινή πτώση της μετοχής κατά 1,49%. Θετικά στοιχεία που το αντισταθμίζουν είναι οι αυξημένοι αριθμοί επιβατών στο αεροδρόμιο, νέες συμφωνίες συνεργασίας και η μηνιαία άνοδος του OMX Copenhagen 25 κατά 9,3%.
summary.it: Il periodo appare per lo più di routine: un errore di cancellazione di registri penali, false minacce di bomba all'aeroporto di Copenaghen e una contestazione legale su una politica abitativa pesano su un calo quotidiano del titolo dell'1,49%. Tra gli elementi positivi compensativi figurano i numeri più elevati di passeggeri negli aeroporti, nuovi accordi di cooperazione e un guadagno mensile del 9,3% dell'OMX Copenhagen 25.
summary.ru: Период выглядит в целом рутинным: ошибка при удалении записей о судимостях, ложные угрозы взрыва в аэропорту Копенгагена и судебное оспаривание жилищной политики перевешивают ежедневное снижение акций на 1,49%. Компенсирующими позитивными факторами выступают более высокие показатели пассажиропотока аэропортов, новые соглашения о сотрудничестве и месячный рост OMX Copenhagen 25 на 9,3%.
summary.ar: تبدو الفترة روتينية في معظمها: خطأ في حذف السجلات، وتهديدات كاذبة بوجود قنابل في مطار كوبنهاغن، وطعن قانوني في سياسة الإسكان، تقابلها انخفاضات يومية في السهم بنسبة 1.49%. وتشمل العوامل الإيجابية المعوضة ارتفاع أعداد المسافرين في المطارات، واتفاقيات تعاون جديدة، وزيادة شهرية بنسبة 9.3% في مؤشر OMX Copenhagen 25.
summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً عادی به نظر می‌رسد: خطای حذف سوابق کیفری، تهدیدهای جعلی بمب‌گذاری در فرودگاه کپنهاگ و اعتراض حقوقی به یک سیاست مسکن، در برابر افت روزانه سهام به میزان ۱٫۴۹ درصد قرار دارند. عوامل مثبت جبرانی شامل افزایش تعداد مسافران فرودگاه‌ها، توافق‌نامه‌های همکاری جدید و افزایش ماهانه ۹٫۳ درصدی شاخص OMX Copenhagen 25 است.
summary.zh: 这一时期总体看似平常：一起刑事记录误删事件、哥本哈根机场的虚假炸弹威胁以及对一项住房政策的法律挑战，抵消了股票当日1.49%的小幅下跌。抵消性的积极因素包括机场客流量增加、新的合作协议，以及OMX哥本哈根25指数当月上涨9.3%。

en: Historic Romania–Moldova defence agreement and first joint SAFE military purchase
Massive drone attacks near Tulcea prompted RO-Alert and F-16 scrambles
Orange storm warnings and cyclone-driven weather across several counties

summary.en: Romania's day mixes positive signals, including a successful €8.5 billion external bond placement after the political crisis and a defence procurement deal with Moldova, with security strain from drone incidents and Black Sea attacks. Weather warnings and heating and energy-cost problems add to the mostly routine picture, and the news tone is less negative than the world average.

en: €8.5bn external bond demand after political crisis
Romania-Moldova joint military procurement agreement under SAFE
Drone incursions and Black Sea attacks raising escalation concerns

summary.en: The day's coverage is mostly routine: a minor 3.5-magnitude Vrancea earthquake, a rail embankment collapse, and weather warnings, offset by positive rail modernisation (Alstom ETCS Level 2 launch) and corporate deals. Drone incidents near NATO airspace and a new government add some tension, and GDELT tone is slightly less negative than the world average.

en: Alstom ETCS Level 2 passenger service launched, a positive infrastructure step
Minor 3.5-magnitude earthquake in Vrancea with no reported damage
Rail embankment collapse blocks traffic toward Mangalia

summary.en: The day's coverage is mixed and mostly routine: a legal process around Călin Georgescu, debate over US troops and fiscal consolidation, and market volatility. Negative items include Black Sea ship incidents and a tugboat distress call, partly offset by the Cernavoda reactor restart and a new motorway section opening, and the GDELT tone is clearly more negative than the world average.

en: Georgescu detention decision pending; legal process, no clear crisis
Cernavoda reactor restarting after Danube low-water outage
Black Sea ship attacks and Turkish tugboat distress at sea

summary.en: The period is mixed and leans negative: Romania faces the EU's largest electricity price increase, Russian strikes on Ukrainian Danube ports prompted Ro-Alert warnings in Tulcea, and GDELT tone is more negative than the world average. Partly offsetting this are routine cultural and diplomatic items, a reported drop in Vaslui's poverty ranking, and PNRR absorption progress.
summary.it: Il quadro del periodo è misto e tende al negativo: la Romania registra il maggiore aumento dei prezzi dell'elettricità nell'UE, gli attacchi russi ai porti ucraini sul Danubio hanno portato ai avvisi Ro-Alert a Tulcea, e il tono di GDELT è più negativo della media mondiale. Parzialmente controbilanciano questo le notizie culturali e diplomatiche di routine, un calo segnalato nella graduatoria della povertà di Vaslui e i progressi nell'assorbimento dei fondi PNRR.
summary.ru: Картина за период смешанная и скорее негативная: в Румынии зафиксирован самый большой рост цен на электроэнергию в ЕС, российские удары по украинским портам на Дунае вызвали предупреждения Ro-Alert в Тулче, а тон GDELT более негативный, чем в среднем по миру. Частично это уравновешивают рутинные культурные и дипломатические новости, сообщение о снижении места Васлуя в рейтинге бедности и прогресс в освоении средств PNRR.
summary.ar: الصورة العامة للفترة مختلطة وتميل إلى السلبية: تسجل رومانيا أكبر ارتفاع في أسعار الكهرباء في الاتحاد الأوروبي، وأدت الهجمات الروسية على الموانئ الأوكرانية على نهر الدانوب إلى تحذيرات Ro-Alert في طولتشا، ونغمة GDELT أكثر سلبية من المتوسط العالمي. ويخفف من ذلك جزئياً بنود ثقافية ودبلوماسية روتينية، وتقرير عن تراجع ترتيب فاسلوي في مؤشر الفقر، وتقدم في امتصاص أموال PNRR.
summary.fa: وضعیت این دوره مخلوط است و بیشتر منفی است: رومانی بیشترین افزایش قیمت برق در اتحادیه اروپا را ثبت کرده است، حملات روسیه به بندرهای اوکراین در رود دانوب هشدارهای Ro-Alert را در تولچا برانگیخته، و لحن GDELT منفی‌تر از میانگین جهانی است. بخشی از این اثر را اخبار فرهنگی و دیپلماتیک معمول، گزارش کاهش رتبه فقر در واسلوی و پیشرفت در جذب بودجه PNRR تعدیل می‌کند.
summary.zh: 该时期整体喜忧参半，偏向负面：罗马尼亚出现欧盟内最大幅度的电价上涨；俄罗斯对乌克兰多瑙河港口的袭击促使图尔恰发出Ro-Alert预警；GDELT语气比全球平均水平更为负面。例行的文化和外交新闻、瓦斯卢伊贫困排名下降的报道以及PNRR资金使用进展，在一定程度上抵消了这些负面因素。
summary.tr: Dönem karışık ve olumsuza yakın seyrediyor: Romanya, AB'nin en büyük elektrik fiyatı artışıyla karşı karşıya; Rusya'nın Ukrayna Tuna limanlarına yönelik saldırıları Tulcea'da Ro-Alert uyarılarına yol açtı ve GDELT tonu dünya ortalamasından daha olumsuz. Bunu kısmen dengeleyen, rutin kültürel ve diplomatik haberler, Vaslui'nin yoksulluk sıralamasında bildirilen bir düşüş ve PNRR fon kullanımındaki ilerleme.
summary.es: El periodo es mixto y se inclina hacia lo negativo: Rumanía enfrenta el mayor aumento de precios de la electricidad de la UE, los ataques rusos contra los puertos ucranianos del Danubio provocaron alertas Ro-Alert en Tulcea, y el tono de GDELT es más negativo que el promedio mundial. En parte lo compensan noticias culturales y diplomáticas rutinarias, una caída informada en el ranking de pobreza de Vaslui y avances en la absorción del PNRR.
summary.fr: La période est contrastée et penche vers le négatif : la Roumanie fait face à la plus forte hausse des prix de l'électricité de l'UE, les frappes russes sur les ports ukrainiens du Danube ont déclenché des alertes Ro-Alert à Tulcea, et le ton de GDELT est plus négatif que la moyenne mondiale. En partie compensés par des informations culturelles et diplomatiques de routine, une baisse signalée du classement de la pauvreté de Vaslui et les progrès de l'absorption du PNRR.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum ist gemischt und neigt ins Negative: Rumänien verzeichnet den größten Strompreisanstieg in der EU, russische Angriffe auf ukrainische Donauhäfen lösten Ro-Alert-Warnungen in Tulcea aus, und der GDELT-Tonwert ist negativer als der Weltdurchschnitt. Teilweise ausgeglichen wird dies durch routinemäßige kulturelle und diplomatische Meldungen, einen gemeldeten Rückgang im Armutsranking von Vaslui und Fortschritte bei der Ausschöpfung des PNRR.
summary.pt: O período é misto e tende ao negativo: a Roménia enfrenta o maior aumento do preço da eletricidade da UE, ataques russos a portos ucranianos no Danúbio provocaram alertas Ro-Alert em Tulcea, e o tom do GDELT é mais negativo do que a média mundial. Em parte compensado por notícias culturais e diplomáticas de rotina, uma queda reportada no ranking de pobreza de Vaslui e progressos na absorção do PRR.
summary.ja: この期間は全体として中立よりややネガティブな傾向にあります。ルーマニアではEU最大の電気料金上昇が起き、ウクライナのドナウ川港湾へのロシアの攻撃を受けてトゥルチャでRo-Alertの警報が出されました。GDELTのトーンは世界平均よりネガティブです。一方で、定例の文化・外交関連の記事、ヴァスルイの貧困順位の低下が報じられたこと、PNRR(復興・レジリエンス計画)の資金吸収の進展が、これをある程度相殺しています。
summary.ko: 이 기간의 전반적인 분위기는 혼재되어 있으며 부정적인 쪽에 가깝습니다. 루마니아는 EU에서 가장 큰 전기요금 인상에 직면해 있고, 우크라이나 도나우강 항구에 대한 러시아의 공격으로 툴체아에 Ro-Alert 경보가 발령되었습니다. GDELT 어조도 세계 평균보다 부정적입니다. 반면 일상적인 문화 및 외교 관련 기사, 바술루이의 빈곤 순위 하락 보도, PNRR 자금 집행 진전이 이를 일부 상쇄합니다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि का रुझान मिश्रित है और नकारात्मक की ओर झुका हुआ है: रोमानिया में यूरोपीय संघ में बिजली की सबसे बड़ी कीमत वृद्धि हुई है, यूक्रेन के डैन्यूब बंदरगाहों पर रूसी हमलों के बाद तुल्चा में Ro-Alert चेतावनी जारी की गई, और GDELT का स्वर विश्व औसत से अधिक नकारात्मक है। इसके विपरीत, नियमित सांस्कृतिक और कूटनीतिक समाचार, वासलुई की गरीबी रैंकिंग में गिरावट की रिपोर्ट और PNRR निधि उपयोग में प्रगति इसे कुछ हद तक संतुलित करते हैं।
summary.el: Η περίοδος είναι μικτή και γέρνει προς το αρνητικό: η Ρουμανία αντιμετωπίζει τη μεγαλύτερη αύξηση τιμών ηλεκτρικής ενέργειας στην ΕΕ, οι ρωσικές επιθέσεις σε λιμάνια του Δούναβη στην Ουκρανία προκάλεσαν προειδοποιήσεις Ro-Alert στην Τούλτσεα, και ο τόνος του GDELT είναι πιο αρνητικός από τον παγκόσμιο μέσο όρο. Ως ένα βαθμό αντισταθμίζουν αυτή την εικόνα τα συνηθισμένα πολιτιστικά και διπλωματικά θέματα, η αναφερόμενη πτώση της θέσης του Βασλούι στην κατάταξη φτώχειας και η πρόοδος στην απορρόφηση των πόρων του PNRR.

summary.en: The disappearance of four Salvadoran air force members after a gang ambush in Haiti is the main negative development of the period. Otherwise, routine news continues: port traffic, budget and investment stories, and heavy sentences handed to gang members. A survey showing economic hardship and uncertainty over TPS add further pressure, but no serious crisis is evident within the country.

en: Disappearance of four Salvadoran soldiers in Haiti after an ambush, with claims that a gang took them hostage
Economic hardship revealed by the survey and uncertainty over TPS (Temporary Protected Status)
Doubling of container traffic at the Acajutla port, along with border modernization and investment funds
Bukele's security criticisms directed at international organizations and heavy prison sentences for gang members

summary.en: Mostly routine news: positive security polling and court convictions of gang members sit alongside a serious incident in which four Salvadoran soldiers went missing after a gang ambush in Haiti. A swarm of earthquakes in Usulután and an Ebola-related travel restriction add to the strain, and the GDELT tone is more negative than the world average.

en: Four Salvadoran soldiers missing after gang ambush in Haiti
UN demands release of kidnapped Salvadoran soldiers
Dozens of earthquakes swarm Usulután within hours

summary.en: Four Salvadoran soldiers were kidnapped by gangs in Haiti, and the government launched a military rescue operation while threatening retaliation, dominating coverage. Domestic routine items (a tax amnesty, trade funding, an extended security regime, an insurer rating) are modest offsets, and the news tone is markedly more negative than the world average.

en: Four Salvadoran soldiers held hostage by gangs in Haiti
Military rescue operation launched in Haiti; Bukele threatens reprisals
Security state-of-exception extended; tax amnesty and trade funds approved

summary.en: The period is dominated by the kidnapping of four Salvadoran soldiers by gangs in Haiti and a special-forces rescue mission, with heavy international coverage and tense rhetoric from the president. This is a serious security episode, partly offset by ECLAC raising its growth forecast to 4.5% and otherwise routine domestic news.

en: Four soldiers kidnapped in Haiti; special forces deployed for rescue
Presidential threats toward Haitian gangs dominate foreign coverage
ECLAC raises El Salvador growth forecast to 4.5%

summary.en: The period is dominated by a foreign-facing crisis: four Salvadoran soldiers reportedly captured or missing after an ambush in Haiti, with special forces deployed to find them. en: Four Salvadoran soldiers missing or held by gangs in Haiti

Basic food basket at its highest price of 2026

summary.en: The period is dominated by the fallout from an ambush of Salvadoran soldiers in Haiti, with four soldiers still missing and bodies found that the president says are not theirs, plus a UN condemnation. Domestic routine stories, a reported pension payment stoppage and a push for life sentences for Barrio 18 leaders add to a tense but not crisis-level picture.

en: Four Salvadoran soldiers missing after ambush in Haiti
UN condemns attack on Salvadoran military in Haiti
Reported pension payments stopped in October

summary.en: The period mixes routine local crime and traffic news with a tense, unresolved story over four missing Salvadoran soldiers in Haiti, where remains were found but not confirmed. Moody's saying a pension deal eases fiscal pressure and a 10-hour power-cut notice are the main other developments, so the picture is close to an ordinary day.

en: Remains found in Haiti; identity of missing soldiers unconfirmed
Moody's: pension deal eases El Salvador fiscal pressure
10-hour power outages announced for several zones

en: NGO allegations of hundreds of prison deaths under emergency rule
Mass detentions without warrants reported (about 93,000 people)
Soldiers reportedly kidnapped in Haiti during deployment

summary.en: Domestic news is routine, with high reported approval, budget and social-program items, and a minor drowning. Bukele disputes that found bodies belong to missing soldiers

Over 2,000 troops deployed to Haiti for rescue

Mass convictions of gang members with long prison terms
Groundbreaking of Chinese-backed international conference centre

summary.tr: Salvadorlu askerler, sivillere zarar verileceği uyarılarına rağmen Haiti'de bir harekât başlattı ve kayıp dört askere ait olduğu belirlenen bir aracın yanmış halde bulunması skoru olumsuz etkiliyor. Yurt içi ekonomi haberleri hafif olumluydu (kahve ihracatında artış, yatırım anlaşmaları) ve çete davalarında mahkûmiyetler rutin biçimde sürdü.
summary.es: Tropas salvadoreñas lanzaron una ofensiva en Haití pese a advertencias sobre daños a civiles, y se encontró quemado un vehículo de cuatro soldados desaparecidos, lo que pesa sobre la puntuación. summary.fr: Des troupes salvadoriennes ont lancé une offensive en Haïti malgré des mises en garde concernant des dommages aux civils, et un véhicule transportant quatre soldats portés disparus a été retrouvé incendié, ce qui pèse sur le score. Les nouvelles économiques nationales étaient légèrement positives (hausse des exportations de café, accords d'investissement) et les condamnations de gangs se sont poursuivies de manière routinière.

Die inländischen Wirtschaftsnachrichten waren leicht positiv (Wachstum der Kaffeeexporte, Investitionsabkommen), und Verurteilungen von Bandenmitgliedern erfolgten weiterhin routinemäßig.
summary.pt: Tropas salvadorenhas lançaram uma ofensiva no Haiti apesar de alertas sobre danos a civis, e um veículo com quatro soldados desaparecidos foi encontrado queimado, o que pesa na pontuação. As notícias econômicas domésticas foram levemente positivas (crescimento das exportações de café, acordos de investimento) e as condenações de integrantes de gangues continuaram de forma rotineira.
summary.ja: エルサルバドル軍がハイチで攻勢を開始し、民間人被害への警告が出される中、行方不明となっていた兵士4人の乗った車両が焼けた状態で発見され、この件はスコアを押し下げている。国内経済ニュースは穏やかに好材料（コーヒー輸出の増加、投資協定）で、ギャングに対する有罪判決も引き続き定期的に出された。
summary.ko: 엘살바도르 군대가 민간인 피해 경고가 나오는 가운데 아이티에서 공세를 시작했으며, 실종된 병사 4명이 탄 것으로 보이는 차량이 불에 탄 채 발견되어 점수에 부정적 영향을 주고 있다. 국내 경제 소식은 완만하게 긍정적이었으며(커피 수출 증가, 투자 협정), 갱단 관련 유죄 판결도 계속해서 정기적으로 이어졌다.
summary.hi: एल साल्वाडोर के सैनिकों ने नागरिकों को नुकसान की चेतावनियों के बीच हैती में एक अभियान शुरू किया, और लापता चार सैनिकों का एक वाहन जला हुआ मिला, जो स्कोर पर भारी पड़ रहा है। घरेलू आर्थिक समाचार हल्के सकारात्मक रहे (कॉफ़ी निर्यात वृद्धि, निवेश समझौते), और गिरोह संबंधी दोषसिद्धि नियमित रूप से जारी रही।
summary.el: Στρατεύματα της Ελ Σαλβαδόρ ξεκίνησαν επιχείρηση στην Αϊτή παρά τις προειδοποιήσεις για βλάβη σε αμάχους, ενώ βρέθηκε καμένο όχημα με τέσσερις αγνοούμενους στρατιώτες, κάτι που βαρύνει το σκορ. Τα εγχώρια οικονομικά νέα ήταν ήπια θετικά (αύξηση εξαγωγών καφέ, συμφωνίες επενδύσεων), και οι καταδίκες συμμοριών συνεχίστηκαν τακτικά.
summary.it: Le truppe salvadoregne hanno lanciato un'offensiva ad Haiti nonostante avvertimenti su danni ai civili, e un veicolo con quattro soldati dispersi è stato ritrovato bruciato, il che pesa sul punteggio. Le notizie economiche interne sono state moderatamente positive (crescita delle esportazioni di caffè, accordi di investimento), mentre le condanne per appartenenza a bande sono proseguite di routine.
summary.ru: Сальвадорские военные начали наступательную операцию на Гаити, несмотря на предупреждения о вреде для гражданского населения, а сгоревший автомобиль с четырьмя пропавшими военнослужащими был обнаружен, что снижает оценку. Внутренние экономические новости были умеренно позитивными (рост экспорта кофе, инвестиционные соглашения), а обвинительные приговоры членам банд продолжали выноситься в обычном порядке.
summary.ar: أطلقت القوات السلفادورية هجوماً في هايتي وسط تحذيرات من إلحاق الضرر بالمدنيين، كما عُثر على مركبة تابعة لأربعة جنود مفقودين محترقة، وهو ما يثقل كاهل التقييم. كانت الأخبار الاقتصادية المحلية إيجابية بشكل طفيف (نمو صادرات البن، واتفاقيات استثمار)، واستمرت أحكام الإدانة المتعلقة بالعصابات بشكل روتيني.
summary.fa: نیروهای السالوادور در هائیتی عملیات تهاجمی آغاز کردند، با وجود هشدارها درباره آسیب به غیرنظامیان، و خودروی متعلق به چهار سرباز مفقود‌شده سوخته پیدا شد که بر امتیاز اثر منفی دارد. اخبار اقتصادی داخلی اندکی مثبت بود (رشد صادرات قهوه، توافقنامه‌های سرمایه‌گذاری)، و احکام محکومیت باندهای تبهکار همچنان به‌طور معمول ادامه داشت.
summary.zh: 萨尔瓦多部队在海地发动进攻，尽管有关于可能伤害平民的警告；一辆载有四名失踪士兵的车辆被发现烧毁，这对评分构成拖累。国内经济新闻略为正面（咖啡出口增长、投资协议），帮派定罪案件照常进行。

summary.ru: За этот период преобладают рутинные деловые новости и новости об энергетике: соглашение о солнечной энергетике на 750 млн долларов и подготовка к переговорам с Chevron добавляют умеренно позитивный вес. summary.ar: تُظهر الفترة في معظمها أخباراً روتينية عن الأعمال والطاقة، إذ تضيف صفقة الطاقة الشمسية بقيمة 750 مليون دولار والتحضيرات لمحادثات مع شيفرون ثقلاً إيجابياً معتدلاً. لا تمثل العناوين المتعلقة بالرياضة وقضية أحد الجنود مصدر قلق منهجياً، ومؤشر نبرة GDELT سلبي بشكل خفيف فقط، ولا تتوفر تغطية من وسائل الإعلام المحلية.
summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً شامل اخبار روتین تجاری و انرژی است؛ قرارداد انرژی خورشیدی ۷۵۰ میلیون دلاری و آماده‌سازی برای مذاکرات با شورون وزن مثبت اندکی به آن می‌دهند. تیترهای مرتبط با ورزش و پرونده یک سرباز نگرانی سیستمی نیستند و لحن GDELT تنها اندکی منفی است و پوشش رسانه‌های داخلی در دسترس نیست.
summary.zh: 该时期的新闻以常规商业和能源报道为主，一项7.5亿美元的太阳能协议以及为与雪佛龙会谈所做的准备带来了适度的正面影响。体育相关标题和一名士兵的案件并非系统性问题，GDELT语气仅轻微负面，且无法获取国内媒体报道。
summary.tr: Dönemde ağırlıklı olarak rutin iş ve enerji haberleri yer alıyor; 750 milyon dolarlık bir güneş enerjisi anlaşması ve Chevron ile yapılacak görüşmelere hazırlık, mütevazı ölçüde olumlu bir etki yaratıyor. Spor temalı başlıklar ve bir askerin davası sistemik bir sorun niteliği taşımıyor; GDELT tonu yalnızca hafif olumsuz ve yerel medya haberleri mevcut değil.
summary.es: El período muestra en su mayoría noticias empresariales y energéticas de rutina, con un acuerdo solar de 750 millones de dólares y los preparativos para las conversaciones con Chevron, que aportan un peso positivo moderado. Los titulares deportivos y el caso de un soldado no constituyen preocupaciones sistémicas, y el tono de GDELT es solo levemente negativo, sin cobertura de medios nacionales disponible.
summary.fr: La période est marquée principalement par des actualités commerciales et énergétiques courantes, avec un accord solaire de 750 millions de dollars et les préparatifs de négociations avec Chevron, qui apportent un poids positif modeste. Les gros titres liés au sport et l'affaire impliquant un soldat ne constituent pas des préoccupations systémiques, et le ton de GDELT n'est que légèrement négatif, sans couverture des médias nationaux disponible.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum ist überwiegend von routinemäßigen Wirtschafts- und Energienachrichten geprägt; ein Solarabkommen über 750 Mio. USD und die Vorbereitungen für Gespräche mit Chevron sorgen für einen moderat positiven Effekt. Sportbezogene Schlagzeilen und der Fall eines Soldaten stellen keine systemischen Probleme dar, und der GDELT-Tonwert ist nur leicht negativ; inländische Medienberichterstattung ist nicht verfügbar.
summary.pt: O período apresenta majoritariamente notícias rotineiras de negócios e energia, com um acordo solar de US$ 750 milhões e os preparativos para negociações com a Chevron, o que acrescenta um peso positivo moderado. Manchetes ligadas ao esporte e o caso de um soldado não representam preocupações sistêmicas, e o tom do GDELT é apenas levemente negativo, sem cobertura da mídia doméstica disponível.
summary.ja: この期間は主に日常的なビジネスおよびエネルギー関連のニュースが中心で、7億5000万ドルの太陽光発電契約とシェブロンとの交渉準備が、やや前向きな要素として加わっている。スポーツ関連の見出しや兵士の事件は体系的な懸念ではなく、GDELTのトーンはわずかにネガティブな程度にとどまる。国内メディアの報道は入手できない。
summary.ko: 이 기간에는 대체로 일상적인 비즈니스 및 에너지 뉴스가 주를 이루며, 7억 5천만 달러 규모의 태양광 계약과 셰브론과의 협상 준비가 완만한 긍정적 요인으로 작용하고 있다. 스포츠 관련 헤드라인과 한 군인의 사건은 체계적인 우려 사항이 아니며, GDELT 어조는 약간 부정적인 수준에 그치고 국내 언론 보도는 확인되지 않는다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में मुख्यतः नियमित व्यावसायिक और ऊर्जा समाचार हैं, जिनमें 75 करोड़ डॉलर का सौर ऊर्जा सौदा और शेवरॉन के साथ वार्ता की तैयारी मामूली सकारात्मक प्रभाव जोड़ते हैं। खेल से जुड़ी सुर्खियाँ और एक सैनिक का मामला कोई व्यवस्थित चिंता नहीं हैं, और GDELT का लहजा केवल हल्का नकारात्मक है, तथा घरेलू मीडिया कवरेज उपलब्ध नहीं है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος παρουσιάζει κυρίως συνηθισμένες επιχειρηματικές και ενεργειακές ειδήσεις, με τη συμφωνία ηλιακής ενέργειας ύψους 750 εκατ. δολαρίων και τις προετοιμασίες για συνομιλίες με τη Chevron να προσθέτουν μέτριο θετικό βάρος. Οι ειδήσεις σχετικές με τον αθλητισμό και η υπόθεση ενός στρατιώτη δεν αποτελούν συστημικές ανησυχίες, ενώ ο τόνος του GDELT είναι μόνο ελαφρώς αρνητικός και δεν υπάρχει διαθέσιμη κάλυψη από εγχώρια μέσα ενημέρωσης.

summary.ja: 報道量は少なく、大半は無関係でスパムやマヨット関連の記事が中心である。関連性のある数少ない報道はいずれも否定的な内容で、拘留中の被拘禁者の死亡や、コモロ船籍の船舶がルーマニア沖で沈没した可能性があるとの報告が含まれる。GDELTのトーンは世界平均を下回っている。
summary.ko: 보도량이 적고 대부분 무관하며, 스팸이나 마요트 관련 기사가 주를 이룬다. 관련성이 있는 몇 안 되는 보도는 모두 부정적이다. 구금 중 피구금자의 사망과 코모로 국기를 단 선박이 루마니아 앞바다에서 침몰했을 가능성이 있다는 보도가 그것이다. GDELT 어조는 세계 평균보다 낮다.
summary.hi: कवरेज कम है और अधिकतर अप्रासंगिक है, जिसमें स्पैम और मायोट पर केंद्रित सामग्री शामिल है। कुछ प्रासंगिक खबरें नकारात्मक हैं: हिरासत में एक बंदी की मौत, और कोमोरोस-ध्वजांकित एक जहाज़ के रोमानिया के तट पर डूबने की संभावना की रिपोर्ट। GDELT लहजा विश्व औसत से नीचे है।
summary.el: Η κάλυψη είναι περιορισμένη και κυρίως άσχετη, με spam και στοιχεία που επικεντρώνονται στη Μαγιότ. Οι λίγες σχετικές ειδήσεις είναι αρνητικές: ο θάνατος ενός κρατουμένου σε κράτηση και αναφορά ότι πλοίο με σημαία Κομορών ενδέχεται να βυθίστηκε ανοιχτά της Ρουμανίας. Ο τόνος του GDELT βρίσκεται κάτω από τον παγκόσμιο μέσο όρο.
summary.tr: Haber kapsamı zayıf ve çoğunlukla alakasız; spam içerikler ve Mayotte odaklı haberler var. İlgili birkaç haber olumsuz: bir tutuklunun gözaltında ölümü ve Romanya açıklarında batmış olabileceği bildirilen Komorlar bayraklı bir gemi. GDELT tonu dünya ortalamasının çok altında.
summary.es: La cobertura es escasa y en su mayoría irrelevante, con contenido de spam y artículos centrados en Mayotte. Las pocas noticias relevantes son negativas: la muerte de un detenido bajo custodia y un informe sobre un buque con pabellón de Comoras que posiblemente se hundió frente a Rumanía, con un tono de GDELT por debajo del promedio mundial.
summary.fr: La couverture est maigre et largement hors sujet, avec du spam et des articles centrés sur Mayotte. Les rares articles pertinents sont négatifs : le décès d'un détenu en garde à vue et un rapport selon lequel un navire battant pavillon des Comores aurait possiblement coulé au large de la Roumanie, avec un ton GDELT nettement inférieur à la moyenne mondiale.
summary.de: Die Berichterstattung ist dünn und größtenteils irrelevant, mit Spam und Beiträgen, die sich auf Mayotte konzentrieren. Die wenigen relevanten Meldungen sind negativ: der Tod eines Häftlings in Haft und ein Bericht über ein unter komorischer Flagge fahrendes Schiff, das möglicherweise vor Rumänien gesunken ist. Der GDELT-Ton liegt deutlich unter dem weltweiten Durchschnitt.
summary.pt: A cobertura é escassa e, em sua maioria, irrelevante, com spam e itens centrados em Mayotte. As poucas notícias relevantes são negativas: a morte de um detento sob custódia e um relatório sobre um navio com bandeira das Comores possivelmente afundado ao largo da Romênia, com tom do GDELT abaixo da média mundial.
summary.it: La copertura è scarsa e per lo più irrilevante, con spam e notizie incentrate su Mayotte. Le poche storie pertinenti sono negative: il decesso di un detenuto in custodia e la segnalazione di una nave battente bandiera comoriana possibilmente affondata al largo della Romania, con un tono GDELT al di sotto della media mondiale.
summary.ru: Освещение скудное и в основном не относится к делу: здесь есть спам и материалы, посвящённые Майотте. Немногие релевантные сообщения носят негативный характер: смерть заключённого под стражей и сообщение о судне под флагом Коморских Островов, которое, возможно, затонуло у берегов Румынии; тон по GDELT ниже среднемирового уровня.
summary.ar: التغطية ضئيلة وغير ذات صلة في معظمها، وتتضمن رسائل مزعجة (spam) ومواد تركز على مايوت. القصص القليلة ذات الصلة سلبية: وفاة سجين محتجز، وتقرير عن سفينة ترفع علم جزر القمر ربما غرقت قبالة سواحل رومانيا، مع نبرة GDELT أدنى بكثير من المتوسط العالمي.
summary.fa: پوشش خبری اندک و عمدتاً نامرتبط است، با محتوای هرزنامه و مطالبی درباره مایوت. داستان‌های اندک مرتبط منفی‌اند: مرگ یک زندانی در بازداشت، و گزارشی از کشتی با پرچم کومور که احتمالاً در نزدیکی سواحل رومانی غرق شده است؛ لحن GDELT به‌طور قابل توجهی پایین‌تر از میانگین جهانی است.
summary.zh: 报道稀少且大多不相关，包括垃圾信息和聚焦马约特的内容。少数相关报道均为负面：一名在押人员死亡，以及一艘悬挂科摩罗旗的船只据报道可能在罗马尼亚近海沉没；GDELT语气远低于全球平均水平。
